FUEL1.name: Carbon
FUEL1.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element
FUEL1.description: The building block of all organic life. Of critical importance to space travellers, as Carbon is used to recharge mining equipment. The Mining Laser will harvest Carbon from trees, plants, and all other forms of vegetable.

FUEL2.name: Condensed Carbon
FUEL2.subtitle: Refined Organic Element
FUEL2.description: Advanced material, processed from regular carbon in a Refiner. The increased molecule density offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio. Occasionally found in crystalline form. Harvesting large crystals may require a Advanced Mining Laser.

OXYGEN.name: Oxygen
OXYGEN.subtitle: Concentrated Liquid Fuel
OXYGEN.description: Integral to the atmospheric filtering technology at the heart of the exosuit life support system. Exosuit material processing allows oxygen to be harvested directly from appropriate planetary flora. Other plantlife may be scanned with the Analysis Visor to reveal alternative oxygen supplies.

LAUNCHSUB.name: Di-hydrogen
LAUNCHSUB.subtitle: High Energy Substance
LAUNCHSUB.description: A stable, crystalline form of hydrogen remarkable both for its extreme energy density and its stability at atmospheric pressures. Common to all worlds, Di-hydrogen is found in the form of large blue crystals. It is a key component of Starship Launch Fuel.

LAUNCHSUB2.name: Deuterium
LAUNCHSUB2.subtitle: High Energy Substance
LAUNCHSUB2.description: A stable hydrogen isotope used heavily in both small-scale fusion reactors and neutron-scattering shield technology. Deuterium very rarely occurs naturally. Most of the galaxy's supply comes from the processing of Di-hydrogen and Tritium in Refiners.

ROCKETSUB.name: Tritium
ROCKETSUB.subtitle: Neutron-Rich Fuel Element
ROCKETSUB.description: Radioactive isotope commonly used to fuel the fusion reactor at the heart of starship Pulse Engines. Abundant in interstellar asteroid fields, Tritium can be mined from asteroids using starship weaponry. Scan (SCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids.

LAND1.name: Ferrite Dust
LAND1.subtitle: Metallic Mineral Extract
LAND1.description: An abundant mineral element, found in rock formations and other areas of geological interest. Easily extracted using a Mining Laser. Typically requires processing in a Refiner before use in construction or technology manufacture.

LAND2.name: Pure Ferrite
LAND2.subtitle: Processed Metallic Minerals
LAND2.description: Processed metal, free of dust and pebbles. Used to construct a wide variety of structures and technologies. Typically purified from Ferrite dust using a Refiner, but can occasionally be found in large deposits. Collection may require an Advanced Mining Laser.

LAND3.name: Magnetised Ferrite
LAND3.subtitle: Charged Metallic Element
LAND3.description: Highly processed metal, requiring several stages of processing in a Refiner. Used in the creation of advanced structures and technologies. Avoid ingestion.

SAND1.name: Silicate Powder
SAND1.subtitle: Abundant Mineral
SAND1.description: An abundant mineral element, found within the geological strata of all rocky worlds. Easily extracted using a Terrain Manipulator. Create a tunnel anywhere to begin extraction. Process in a Refiner to create Glass.

CATALYST1.name: Sodium
CATALYST1.subtitle: Unrefined Catalytic Element
CATALYST1.description: A powerful catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection. Exosuit material handling technology allows automatic harvesting from appropriate sodium-rich flora. A vital ingredient in the creation of many advanced devices, products and components.

CATALYST2.name: Sodium Nitrate
CATALYST2.subtitle: Refined Catalytic Element
CATALYST2.description: An advanced catalyst, useful for charging defensive technologies such as shields or hazard protection. Created in a Refiner, or occasionally found in crystalline form on a planet's surface. Offers a substantially improved energy-per-gram ratio over regular Sodium.

CAVE1.name: Cobalt
CAVE1.subtitle: Subterranean Mineral
CAVE1.description: Mined from underground minerals, cobalt is found in plentiful supply in caves and caverns. Useful in the manufacture of Ion Batteries. It is used in the creation of several technologies and structures, and can be processed in a Refiner to make the most of its inherent charge.

CAVE2.name: Ionised Cobalt
CAVE2.subtitle: Processed Subterranean Mineral
CAVE2.description: A highly energised form of Cobalt, this processed metal can be used to create Advanced Ion Batteries, a conveniently portable source of energy for the Exosuit. In widespread use as a key component in the creation of advanced technologies and structures.

WATER1.name: Salt
WATER1.subtitle: Aquatic Mineral Extract
WATER1.description: A naturally occuring salt, found in abundance in underwater minerals. Can be processed in a Refiner to create Chlorine. This refined form is used in the manufacture of advanced products and technologies.

WATER2.name: Chlorine
WATER2.subtitle: Processed Aquatic Mineral
WATER2.description: A reactive element most easily harvested by processing the salt-infused minerals found in oceans. Used in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

WATERPLANT.name: Cyto-Phosphate
WATERPLANT.subtitle: Organic Compound
WATERPLANT.description: A blue-green organic compound produced during the metabolic cycle of deep-sea plantlife. Rich in soluble energy, cyto-phosphates are crucial in many submarine technologies. The Mining Laser will harvest cyto-phosphate compounds from underwater flora.

YELLOW2.name: Copper
YELLOW2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Yellow
YELLOW2.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

RED2.name: Cadmium
RED2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Red
RED2.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

GREEN2.name: Emeril
GREEN2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Green
GREEN2.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

BLUE2.name: Indium
BLUE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Blue
BLUE2.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Indium is found on planets orbiting blue stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

PURPLE2.name: Quartzite
PURPLE2.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Purple
PURPLE2.description: A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Such stellar material ends up forming deposits in the crust of local planets. Quartzite is found on planets orbiting purple stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal for use in the manufacture of advanced technologies.

STELLAR2.name: Chromatic Metal
STELLAR2.subtitle: Highly Refined Stellar Metal
STELLAR2.description: A processed metal alloy, created in a Refiner from the stellar metals: Copper, Cadmium, Emeril and Indium. The rarer the stellar metal, the more Chromatic Metal it will produce. This valuable metal is used in the creation of many advanced technologies.

TECHFRAG.name: Nanite Cluster
TECHFRAG.subtitle: Technological Currency
TECHFRAG.description: A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter. Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.

LUSH1.name: Paraffinium
LUSH1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
LUSH1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a tropical environment.

DUSTY1.name: Pyrite
DUSTY1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
DUSTY1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a desert environment.

TOXIC1.name: Ammonia
TOXIC1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
TOXIC1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a toxic environment.

RADIO1.name: Uranium
RADIO1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
RADIO1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a radioactive environment.

COLD1.name: Dioxite
COLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
COLD1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a frozen environment.

HOT1.name: Phosphorus
HOT1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
HOT1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a scorched environment.

LAVA1.name: Basalt
LAVA1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
LAVA1.description: Local mineral extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from common minerals after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on planets with a volcanic environment.

RUINSUB.name: Polished Stone
RUINSUB.subtitle: Recycled Minerals
RUINSUB.description: The powdery remains of a highly polished mineral surface. It glitters as it catches the light, like fiery grains of sand. Acquired by applying the Mining Laser to the structral remnants located on ruined worlds.

WATERWORLD1.name: Lithium
WATERWORLD1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
WATERWORLD1.description: Local metallic extract, typically found in large deposits or harvested from common mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Typically found on ocean planets.

GASGIANT1.name: Crystallised Helium
GASGIANT1.subtitle: Localised Earth Element
GASGIANT1.description: A supercooled chemical extract, typically found in large deposits or extracted from smaller mineral formations after inspection with an Analysis Visor. Extracted from deposits formed in the hostile conditions of gas giants.

CREATURE1.name: Mordite
CREATURE1.subtitle: Harvested Substance
CREATURE1.description: Despite much study, little is known about this haunting, crystalline compound. It is released from the cadavers of dying creatures, but can also be specifically cultivated and harvested from the Mordite Root plant.

ROBOT1.name: Pugneum
ROBOT1.subtitle: Anomalous Material
ROBOT1.description: This oily, unsettling liquid leaks from the circuitry of Sentinels. Prized by the Vy'keen, Pugneum is thought to share some essential properties with Nanites. It hums in a sinister fashion upon contact with organic matter.

ROBOT2.name: Atlantideum
ROBOT2.subtitle: Disharmonic Metal
ROBOT2.description: This ethereal substance spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall, a shower of prismatic grains seeking out their next host. It evades all attempts to contain it, as if it had a will of its own, a strong desire for its own freedom. It possesses a crystalline beauty that cannot be reconciled with the corruption from whence it flows.

ASTEROID1.name: Silver
ASTEROID1.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral
ASTEROID1.description: Valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Prized by people in all systems for its lustre and shine.

ASTEROID2.name: Gold
ASTEROID2.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral
ASTEROID2.description: Highly valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Universally prized for its beauty and versatility.

ASTEROID3.name: Platinum
ASTEROID3.subtitle: Valuable Asteroid Mineral
ASTEROID3.description: Extremely valuable interstellar trading mineral, typically mined from asteroids. Occasionally found in underground planetary deposits. Universally prized for its hardiness and versatility.

GAS1.name: Sulphurine
GAS1.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas
GAS1.description: A pungent atmospheric gas. High concentrations are extremely hazardous to organic life. With the aid of specialised machinery, can be extracted from the atmospheres of Scorched and Desert planets.

GAS2.name: Radon
GAS2.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas
GAS2.description: A colourless, odourless gas with a relatively short half-life. Found in both Radioactive and Frozen atmospheres, this gas is produced by the decay of other high-energy elements.

GAS3.name: Nitrogen
GAS3.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas
GAS3.description: A reactive atmospheric gas found wherever there is organic life. Nitrogen is readily harvested from the atmospheres of Lush and Toxic planets.

GAS4.name: Methane
GAS4.subtitle: Compressed Atmospheric Gas
GAS4.description: An atmospheric gas found in the hostile conditions of gas giants. Methane is readily harvested from equipment deployed on gas worlds.

EX_YELLOW.name: Activated Copper
EX_YELLOW.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Yellow
EX_YELLOW.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. This Copper has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable. Copper is found on planets orbiting yellow stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

EX_RED.name: Activated Cadmium
EX_RED.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Red
EX_RED.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. This Cadmium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable. Cadmium is found on planets orbiting red stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

EX_GREEN.name: Activated Emeril
EX_GREEN.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Green
EX_GREEN.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. This Emeril has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable. Emeril is found on planets orbiting green stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal.

EX_BLUE.name: Activated Indium
EX_BLUE.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Blue
EX_BLUE.description: A chromatic metal, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Indium is found on planets orbiting blue stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal. This Indium has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

EX_PURPLE.name: Activated Quartzite
EX_PURPLE.subtitle: Refined Stellar Metal: Purple
EX_PURPLE.description: A chromatic mineral, generated by fusion in the heart of a star. Quartzite is found on planets orbiting purple stars, and can be placed in a Refiner to create purified Chromatic Metal. This quartzite has been activated by the extreme conditions in which it was formed, and is highly valuable.

PLANT_TOXIC.name: Fungal Mould
PLANT_TOXIC.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_TOXIC.description: An oddly-glowing substance, harvested from the gills of Fungal Clusters. The host plant requires a toxic climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

PLANT_SNOW.name: Frost Crystal
PLANT_SNOW.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_SNOW.description: A beautiful blue crystal, this organic compound possesses both great hardiness and a shimmering translucence. It is harvested from the leaves of Frostwort. Frostwort requires frozen conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

PLANT_RADIO.name: Gamma Root
PLANT_RADIO.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_RADIO.description: A strange substance that seems to slowly shift the air around it. It is found in the roots of the Gamma Weed plant. Gamma Weed requires high background radiation to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

PLANT_DUST.name: Cactus Flesh
PLANT_DUST.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_DUST.description: Succulent, edible cactus flesh from the Echinocactus plant. As well as being juicy on the tongue, the flesh has many industrial uses. The Echinocactus thrives only on desert planets, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray..

PLANT_HOT.name: Solanium
PLANT_HOT.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_HOT.description: A powerful chemical that has resisted attempts at synthesis. It can be harvested from the bark of the Solar Vine. The vine requires a hot climate to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

PLANT_LUSH.name: Star Bulb
PLANT_LUSH.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_LUSH.description: A beautiful gemstone, this prized product is the engorged, luminescent berry of the Star Bramble. The host plant requires lush conditions to thrive in the wild, but can be farmed in all environments with the aid of a Hydroponics Tray.

PLANT_CAVE.name: Marrow Bulb
PLANT_CAVE.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_CAVE.description: A glowing organic bulb, harvested from the Cave Marrow plant found growing underground. The Cave Marrow has proved resistant to domestication, and no farmable cultivars are known to exist. As such, marrow bulbs must be harvested by hand in the wild.

PLANT_WATER.name: Kelp Sac
PLANT_WATER.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_WATER.description: A rubbery, luminescent sac harvested from underwater Candle Kelp plants. Agricultural science has not yet tamed the Candle Kelp. As such, these sacs cannot be farmed.

PLANT_POOP.name: Faecium
PLANT_POOP.subtitle: Harvested Agricultural Substance
PLANT_POOP.description: A foul-smelling compound that can be harvested from the Gutrot Flower, or less desirably from the faecal matter of some species. Creatures can be fed to encourage the formation and deposition of faecium crystals.

SPACEGUNK1.name: Residual Goop
SPACEGUNK1.subtitle: Junk
SPACEGUNK1.description: A pulsating, foul smelling goop that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery. Skin contact is not advised.

SPACEGUNK2.name: Runaway Mould
SPACEGUNK2.subtitle: Junk
SPACEGUNK2.description: An out of control mould growth that builds up in poorly-maintained machinery. Likely to be several different species of mould, merged together into one super-colony.

SPACEGUNK3.name: Rusted Metal
SPACEGUNK3.subtitle: Junk
SPACEGUNK3.description: Handfuls of corroded metal, distorted by years of exposure to the harsh environment. Handle with care.

SPACEGUNK4.name: Living Slime
SPACEGUNK4.subtitle: Junk
SPACEGUNK4.description: A heavy, oozing slime. It is moving gently, as if it has a heartbeat of its own. Nutrient source: unknown.

SPACEGUNK5.name: Viscous Fluids
SPACEGUNK5.subtitle: Junk
SPACEGUNK5.description: An unnaturally thick liquid of dubious colour. Its origins are impossible to fathom. Appears to have some mild magnetic properties.

AF_METAL.name: Tainted Metal
AF_METAL.subtitle: Salvaged Scrap
AF_METAL.description: Shredded fragments of a soft, grey metal. Its surface is porous, and when touched it oozes ever-so-slightly. Found in the creaking wreck of a derelict freighter. The space station Scrap Dealer may find this interesting...

BUI_SCRAP.name: Void Mote
BUI_SCRAP.subtitle: Essence of Atlantid
BUI_SCRAP.description: A purified drop of Atlantideum, refined to its very essence. This precious material is acquired by earning favour with and assisting the Autophage. Visit the Autophage Synthesis Terminal found at all Autophage camps to exchange Void Motes for unique customisation options.

SPECIAL_POOP.name: Hexite
SPECIAL_POOP.subtitle: Unrefined Organic Element
SPECIAL_POOP.description: An odourless, mineral-rich substance with a hexagonal crystalline structure, harvested from the faecal matter of a creature.

TECHFRAG_R.name: Nanites
TECHFRAG_R.subtitle: Technological Currency
TECHFRAG_R.description: A dense miasma of Nanites, undulating in its potentiality. These clusters are stable, but unrestricted nanite foam can produce undesirable runaway reactions in the presence of organic matter. Used in the construction of advanced technologies. Highly valuable to specialist traders.

QUICKSILVER.subtitle: Reward Item
QUICKSILVER.description: Currency or faction standing, given as a reward.
