SUNGOLD.name: Liquid Sun
SUNGOLD.subtitle: Transmuted Metal
SUNGOLD.description: Conventional planetary metal, superheated and then held in a stabilised plasmatic form. Extracted from metallic terrain deposits using a Solar Ray. Enormously energetic.

SOULFRAG.name: Fragmented Qualia
SOULFRAG.subtitle: Soul Fragment
SOULFRAG.description: A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into the surface of a tiny metallic shard. This fragment of data represents a recording of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience. Generated by the interaction of the Animus Beam with a living target.

SQUIDFRAG.name: Shattered Qualia
SQUIDFRAG.subtitle: Soul Fragment
SQUIDFRAG.description: A pattern, no more than a mere waveform, etched into an ethereal shard of glass. This fragment of data represents a trace of the electrical impulses running across a neural network. Many fragments would be required to recreate any sensible experience. Released upon the destruction of a boundary horror.

WORMDUST.name: Cursed Dust
WORMDUST.subtitle: Ashes of Despair
WORMDUST.description: A powdery desert soil, slick with the gland expressions of a colossal sandworm. Historically, some have regarded this dust as the divine parent of such worms. It smells curiously sweet. Cursed Dust gathers in the terrain deposits of planets blighted by titan worm activity.

TIMEDUST.name: Somnal Dust
TIMEDUST.subtitle: Decayed Spacetime Remnant
TIMEDUST.description: Grey, dead, sparkling with life and colour, singing as it shimmers. This impossibly fine dust is the accumulated decay of time and memories. Collected from the fine layers it forms around hotspots in the loop. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

TIMEMILK.name: Ancestral Memories
TIMEMILK.subtitle: Recessive Creature Genes
TIMEMILK.description: The echo of a genetic possibility, forgotten by evolution. It twitches with a wild energy. Extracted from a creature caught within a repeating circuit of time. Of great value to Specialist Polo as they research the loop.

CASING.name: Metal Plating
CASING.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
CASING.description: A lightweight metal product, heavily used in the manufacture of starship parts and deployable technology. A mainstay of the construction industries of all known primary species. Crafted from Ferrite Dust.

NANOTUBES.name: Carbon Nanotubes
NANOTUBES.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
NANOTUBES.description: Metres and metres of high capacity carbon nanotubes. Their high tensile strength and mild conductivity make these a key component in many advanced technologies.

CARBON_SEAL.name: Hermetic Seal
CARBON_SEAL.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
CARBON_SEAL.description: A high-performance carbon seal, able to withstand both the harsh interstellar environment and the rigours of intensive, high-energy industrial use. User is advised to regularly check seal integrity after installation.

MICROCHIP.name: Microprocessor
MICROCHIP.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
MICROCHIP.description: A compact, low-heat microchip. Assembled from processed Chromatic Metal, created from one of several specialised terrain metals. Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

HYDRALIC.name: Hydraulic Wiring
HYDRALIC.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
HYDRALIC.description: Specialist wiring and control threads, this flexible material allows the transmission of power and signals, as well as offering direct manipulation of remote components. Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

COMPUTER.name: Quantum Computer
COMPUTER.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
COMPUTER.description: An extremely fast advanced processing unit. Allows real-time solving of otherwise impossible calculations. However, protection against decoherence is not guaranteed. Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

MAGNET.name: Magnetic Resonator
MAGNET.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
MAGNET.description: An electromagnetic frequency oscillator, able to function in a wide-range of conditions thanks to both ferrous and non-ferrous magnetic properties. Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

MIRROR.name: Solar Mirror
MIRROR.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
MIRROR.description: A specialist optical component. Employing an impossibly polished surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields. Used in the creation of a wide range of advanced technologies.

BIO.name: Amino Chamber
BIO.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
BIO.description: A specialist biological catalysation device. This unit takes advantage of naturally occurring enzymes in order to facilitate increased energy yields and faster processing in a wide range of advanced technologies.

TECH_COMP.name: Wiring Loom
TECH_COMP.subtitle: Universal Technology Platform
TECH_COMP.description: A prefabricated circuit board, designed for flexible use in a large range of technology components. The module features an integrated nanite processor, allowing it to be quickly configured for a wide variety of uses.

REPAIRKIT.name: Repair Kit
REPAIRKIT.subtitle: Automatic Patching Unit
REPAIRKIT.description: A highly useful piece of survival technology, the Repair Kit allows damaged equipment to be quickly and efficiently restored to working order. While repairing a piece of techology, the Repair Kit can be applied to any damaged subcomponent in place of the usual requirements.

PRODFUEL2.name: Life Support Gel
PRODFUEL2.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
PRODFUEL2.description: Emergency life support fuel. Synthesised from rocket fuel crystals and carbon, this gel offers a temporary boost to life support systems. Long-term impact on user's lungs is currently unknown.

POWERCELL.name: Ion Battery
POWERCELL.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
POWERCELL.description: Convenient and optimised power storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems. Constructed by fusing Ferrite Dust with underground Cobalt. Frequently found ready-made in cylindrical metal containers.

SHIPCHARGE.name: Starshield Battery
SHIPCHARGE.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
SHIPCHARGE.description: A power storage unit optimised for use in starship defensive systems. Tritium-fuelled capacitors provide quick-release charge for the Deflector Shield, but would overload smaller-scale equipment.

JELLY.name: Di-hydrogen Jelly
JELLY.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
JELLY.description: A faintly-glowing jelly. Its gentle light and soft wobble belie the fact that this sticky gel is both highly toxic and highly flammable. Skin contact is to be avoided at all costs. Synthesised from Di-hydrogen.

LAUNCHFUEL.name: Starship Launch Fuel
LAUNCHFUEL.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
LAUNCHFUEL.description: Highly reactive solid-state fuel, required to fuel Starship Launch Thrusters. Created from crystallised Di-hydrogen, found in blue deposits on all worlds.

SUBFUEL.name: Hydrothermal Fuel Cell
SUBFUEL.subtitle: Submarine Reactor Fuel
SUBFUEL.description: A high thermal energy fuel, contained within a standardised fuel cell. Used to fuel the Humboldt Drive that powers the Nautilon submarine. Created with a mix of organic compounds (Carbon and cyto-phosphates) and localised mineral salts.

GRENFUEL1.name: Unstable Plasma
GRENFUEL1.subtitle: Plasma Launcher Recharge
GRENFUEL1.description: Densely-packed fuel capsule for use in the Plasma Launcher. Contained highly-pressurised electro-thermal energy for use in land disruption grenade technology.

AMMO.name: Projectile Ammunition
AMMO.subtitle: Universal Ammo Module
AMMO.description: Advanced munition fragments, constructed to fit Universal Multi-Tool Standard 07/FF1. Easily inserted into the Boltcaster, Pulse Spitter and Scatter Blaster via the Multi-Tool clip reloading system.

AM_HOUSING.name: Antimatter Housing
AM_HOUSING.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
AM_HOUSING.description: Secure antimatter containment device, required before Antimatter can be safely secured as Warp Cells. Rebound Oxygen forms a protective gas pocket, preventing the antimatter from reacting with the surrounding casing.

ANTIMATTER.name: Antimatter
ANTIMATTER.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
ANTIMATTER.description: Contained negative matter and baryogenesis antiparticles. The vast energy potential of antimatter makes it highly valuable. 95% of existing antimatter consumption is in the powering of starship hyperdrives. WARNING: uncontained usage is not recommended.

HYPERFUEL1.name: Warp Cell
HYPERFUEL1.subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit
HYPERFUEL1.description: This antimatter-based fuel is one of the few power sources capable of meeting the incredible energy requirements of a starship hyperdrive. Secured within a robust housing, the cell is guaranteed paradox-free during FTL travel.

HYPERFUEL2.name: Warp Hypercore
HYPERFUEL2.subtitle: Hyperdrive Charging Unit
HYPERFUEL2.description: A high-capacity antimatter-based fuel, this cell harnesses an internal black hole generator to power starship hyperdrives across multiple warp jumps. Cell walls are specially designed to reflect any reality paradoxes back towards the heart of the unit, where they generate additional power.

SENTINEL_LOOT.name: Salvaged Glass
SENTINEL_LOOT.subtitle: Recovered Sentinel Components
SENTINEL_LOOT.description: A sinister shard of purple glass, salvaged from the destroyed remains of Sentinel machinery. Its walls are thin, and it may be broken down to access valuable Sentinel components. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and shatter with FE_ALT1.

QUAD_PROD.name: Quad Servo
QUAD_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material
QUAD_PROD.description: A highly sprung motor arm salvaged from inside of a Sentinel patrol unit. It occasionally twitches, as if experiencing the echo of combat.

SPIDER_PROD.name: Crystallised Heart
SPIDER_PROD.subtitle: Corrupted Aeronic Core
SPIDER_PROD.description: The functional core of a Sentinel quadruped unit, but warped beyond all recognition. The entire machine is infested with a crystalline material that pulses wildy upon inspection. A close analysis reveals the machinery itself appears to have been reconfigured, stretching and warping into a whole new form, writhing in the presence of these radiant shards of glass.

MECH_PROD.name: Hardframe Engine
MECH_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material
MECH_PROD.description: This complex mechanical unit was once the central combustion chamber at the heart of a Sentinel Hardframe unit. Though now cool to the touch, it still glows with a sinister red heat...

WALKER_PROD.name: Walker Brain
WALKER_PROD.subtitle: Anomalous Material
WALKER_PROD.description: Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder.

QUEEN_PROD.name: Vile Cortex
QUEEN_PROD.subtitle: Glorious Trophy
QUEEN_PROD.description: The brain stem of a brood mother, pulled from its malignant corpse. This is a valuable trophy, signifying victory in the quest to purge the infestations of the vile brood. Turn it over to an envoy of the Mercenaries Guild to mark your triumph.

PIRATE_PROD.name: Pirate Transponder
PIRATE_PROD.subtitle: Salvaged Identification Device
PIRATE_PROD.description: A unique ID transponder, ripped from the internal signal array of an outlaw starship. Possesion of such a device implies the destruction of the vessel in question. Turn it over to an envoy of the Mercenaries Guild to collect any associated bounties.

DEEPSEA_PROD.name: Sea Glass
DEEPSEA_PROD.subtitle: Precious Material
DEEPSEA_PROD.description: A etheral shard, this translucent plane is both mineral and alive, both of the water and of another realm. Of high value to collectors across the universe.

SHIPBRAIN.name: Hyaline Brain
SHIPBRAIN.subtitle: Sentience Vessel
SHIPBRAIN.description: The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry writhes microscopically, constantly rearranging itself as it scans for anomalies. A vital component for any entity wishing to construct their own Pilot Interface for a Sentinel Interceptor. Status: VOLATILE

SENTFREI_PROD.name: Carrier AI Fragment
SENTFREI_PROD.subtitle: Battleship Core Remnant
SENTFREI_PROD.description: A single splinter of the colossal mainframe at the heart of a Sentinel capital ship. It blinks, its solitary living eye trained upon the one piece of data it retains - the last known location of one of its fleet of Interceptors. Select the AI Fragment and use Search Archive (FE_ALT1) to translate information about Interceptor's crash site to your starship's navigation systems.

DRONE_SALVAGE.name: Inverted Mirror
DRONE_SALVAGE.subtitle: Burning Glassy Remnant
DRONE_SALVAGE.description: A pane of watchful g l a s s, retrieved from the smoking remains of the corrupted swarm's Dissonance Resonators. It emits more light than it reflects, casting a faint purple hue on its surroundings. Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

DRONE_SHARD.name: Radiant Shard
DRONE_SHARD.subtitle: Glassy Reality Intrusion
DRONE_SHARD.description: A fragment of glassy lifeforce, chipped from a larger formation. Dynamic intermolecular binding gives the shard a strangely flexible, sinewy quality. It writhes gently, almost as if it were seeking something... Highly sought after for salvage operations, as it can be used to bypass the security systems of key Sentinel ship technologies.

GEODE_LAND.name: Geode
GEODE_LAND.subtitle: Valuable Mineral Deposit
GEODE_LAND.description: An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

GEODE_CAVE.name: Geode
GEODE_CAVE.subtitle: Valuable Mineral Deposit
GEODE_CAVE.description: An unusually vibrant and potentially valuable lump of rock. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

GEODE_CRYSTAL.name: Crystal Fragment
GEODE_CRYSTAL.subtitle: Concentrated Element Shard
GEODE_CRYSTAL.description: A crystalline shard with an unusually dense structure. Potentially highly valuable. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

GEODE_SPACE.name: Tritium Hypercluster
GEODE_SPACE.subtitle: Energetic Fragment
GEODE_SPACE.description: A shard of pure crystalised Tritium. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

GEODE_ASTEROID.name: Gold Nugget
GEODE_ASTEROID.subtitle: Valuable Ore
GEODE_ASTEROID.description: A highly valuable ore chunk, ready to be processed into Gold. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

GEODE_RARE.name: Glowing Mineral
GEODE_RARE.subtitle: Valuable Rock Sample
GEODE_RARE.description: Though its surface is dirtied and dull, polishing this rock reveals a deep inner glow, a glitter beneath a subtly iridescent surface. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and crack open with FE_ALT1.

SCRAP_GOODS.name: Suspicious Packet (Goods)
SCRAP_GOODS.subtitle: Contraband
SCRAP_GOODS.description: A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of technology. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and use FE_ALT1 to examine the contents. No refunds.

SCRAP_TECH.name: Suspicious Packet (Tech)
SCRAP_TECH.subtitle: Contraband
SCRAP_TECH.description: A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of high-value or interesting item. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and use FE_ALT1 to examine the contents. No refunds.

SCRAP_WEAP.name: Suspicious Packet (Arms)
SCRAP_WEAP.subtitle: Contraband
SCRAP_WEAP.description: A suspicious looking parcel, acquired via an unusual transaction. The seller indicated it contained some sort of weapon-based technology. Select in the Inventory (INVENTORY) and use FE_ALT1 to examine the contents. No refunds.

POI_LOCATOR.name: Anomaly Detector
POI_LOCATOR.subtitle: Anomalous Homing Device
POI_LOCATOR.description: A single-use geometric beacon that probes the surrounding area for near-space anomalies. Such objects are highly unpredictable. Select the Detector and use Begin Scan (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

ABAND_LOCATOR.name: Emergency Signal Scanner
ABAND_LOCATOR.subtitle: Coordinate Data
ABAND_LOCATOR.description: A single-use receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage. Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

ABAND_LOCATOR_X.name: Emergency Signal Scanner (Active)
ABAND_LOCATOR_X.subtitle: Coordinate Data
ABAND_LOCATOR_X.description: A single-use receiver that scans for distress signals on freighter frequencies. Derelict or abandoned freighters often contain high-value salvage. Select the Receiver and use Tune Signal (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

STONE_EYE_PROD.name: Vigilant Stone
STONE_EYE_PROD.subtitle: Unblinking Eye
STONE_EYE_PROD.description: An eye of living stone: waiting, watching. A relic left by a slumbering guardian, keeping sentry over ancient creature burial grounds. Warning: Disturbing the eye may disturb the slumber of living stone guardians. Ensure re-animated guardians are defeated before storing this relic in the home.

SACVENOM.name: Sac Venom
SACVENOM.subtitle: Trade commodity
SACVENOM.description: A stabilised poison gland extracted from a terrestrial urchin. The host-urchin is actually a colony of smaller proto-creatures, a formation built on years of slow growth and cooperation. Of use both medicinally and as a delicacy in some riskier cuisines. Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

GRAVBALL.name: Gravitino Ball
GRAVBALL.subtitle: Trade commodity
GRAVBALL.description: A supersymmetric particle cluster created by divergent super-gravitational forces. A micro-rift is created as they form, and extraction of the orb prompts a localised reality weakening. Sentinel forces will respond to stablise any such anomaly. Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

ALBUMENPEARL.name: Albumen Pearl
ALBUMENPEARL.subtitle: Trade commodity
ALBUMENPEARL.description: Gemstone formed over the course of centuries within the egg of a super-incubatory species. Highly ornamental, these gems are themselves living seeds, lucent grains of potential life. Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

CAVECUBE.name: Vortex Cube
CAVECUBE.subtitle: Trade commodity
CAVECUBE.description: An ancient object, unearthed from the depths of a planetary cave system. Its surface is cold to the touch, and is curiously polished despite its age. A fusion of metal and rock, these cubes have proved resistant to industrial processing. As such, they are of value only to collectors. Can be sold at a Galactic Trade Terminal.

FIENDCORE.name: Larval Core
FIENDCORE.subtitle: Monstrosity
FIENDCORE.description: A pulsating jellied orb, this gooey sphere is warm to the touch. Its stench triggers a primal fear in mortal beings, a deep-seated gnawing that begs you to drop it and flee.

STORM_CRYSTAL.name: Storm Crystal
STORM_CRYSTAL.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
STORM_CRYSTAL.description: A rare and highly valuable cluster of storm crystals. These crystalline structures thrive in stormy conditions, and naturally attract lightning strikes, becoming spectacularly luminescent when ionised. Exclusively found on extreme weather planets.

CLAMPEARL.name: Living Pearl
CLAMPEARL.subtitle: Semi-Conscious Gemstone
CLAMPEARL.description: Born in the hearts of enormous glowing molluscs found deep underwater. Unlike most pearls, this sample is no unliving calcite. Some trace of the mother-clam's consciousness remains within the gem, giving it a lingering, haunting beauty.

VENTGEM.name: Crystal Sulphide
VENTGEM.subtitle: Compressed Mineral
VENTGEM.description: Formed in the incredible, high-pressure furnace of planetary cores, these rich mineral deposits have an almost glass-like quality. Has a wide variety of industrial uses, taking advantage of both its mineral content and its extreme strength under pressure.

FISHCORE.name: Hadal Core
FISHCORE.subtitle: Horrific Sample
FISHCORE.description: A highly-pressurised fleshy orb. One can feel it push back when touched, a flash of bioluminescence stirring in the inky black core of this mysterious object.

EYEBALL.name: Hypnotic Eye
EYEBALL.subtitle: Horrific Sample
EYEBALL.description: The eye is cold, almost frozen, to the touch. Nonetheless, it is impossible to escape the feeling it is somehow still alive. Extended exposure is not recommended. Do not stare back into the eye. Do not stare back. Do not stare back.

ALLOY1.name: Aronium
ALLOY1.subtitle: Alloy Metal
ALLOY1.description: A lightweight and highly malleable alloy. Crafted from Paraffinium and Ionised Cobalt. In high demand on the Galactic Trade Network due to its utility in the construction of planetside outposts and facilities.

ALLOY2.name: Dirty Bronze
ALLOY2.subtitle: Alloy Metal
ALLOY2.description: A popular metal alloy with a wide variety of uses. 'Dirty Bronze' has shed its scientific name in favour of the popular term for its colour. Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Pyrite.

ALLOY3.name: Herox
ALLOY3.subtitle: Alloy Metal
ALLOY3.description: Combined neutral alloy with uses that range from pharmacology all the way to heavy industry. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Ammonia. Forms the backbone of galactic alloy trading.

ALLOY4.name: Lemmium
ALLOY4.subtitle: Alloy Metal
ALLOY4.description: Pure Ferrite alloy. Crafted from Pure Ferrite and Uranium. Used extensively in starship freighter construction due to its sheer strength. A hardcore material popular on the Galactic Trade Network.

ALLOY5.name: Magno-Gold
ALLOY5.subtitle: Alloy Metal
ALLOY5.description: Highly prized and lustrous alloy. Popular with traders of all known primary galactic races. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Phosphorus. Easily recognisable by its bright red glow and strong magnetic field.

ALLOY6.name: Grantine
ALLOY6.subtitle: Alloy Metal
ALLOY6.description: Soft workable alloy favoured by artisans throughout the known galaxy. Crafted from Ionised Cobalt and Dioxite. A popular trading good, with many galactic shipping paths devoted to its sale and transport.

ALLOY7.name: Geodesite
ALLOY7.subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal
ALLOY7.description: Advanced and durable alloy primarily used in starship hull construction and deep-space exploration drone technology. Crafted from Herox, Dirty Bronze and Lemmium.

ALLOY8.name: Iridesite
ALLOY8.subtitle: Enriched Alloy Metal
ALLOY8.description: Advanced light metal alloy traded throughout the galactic Outer Edge. Often used in the interiors of trading shuttles to reduce weight as they ascend from planets with high gravitational fields. Crafted from Aronium, Magno-Gold and Grantine.

STARCHART_A.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_A.subtitle: Secret Cartographic Data
STARCHART_A.description: A map of a nearby planet. A secure site of interest has been marked. Such sites often hold blueprints for new products. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

STARCHART_B.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_B.subtitle: Emergency Cartographic Data
STARCHART_B.description: A map of a nearby planet. The coordinates of a distress signal have been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

STARCHART_C.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_C.subtitle: Commercial Cartographic Data
STARCHART_C.description: A map of a nearby planet. An inhabited outpost of some kind has been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

STARCHART_D.name: Planetary Chart
STARCHART_D.subtitle: Alien Cartographic Data
STARCHART_D.description: A map of a nearby planet. A a relic of an ancient civilisation has been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

CHART_EMPTY.name: Planetary Chart (Empty)
CHART_EMPTY.subtitle: Cartographic Data
CHART_EMPTY.description: A map of a nearby planet. The chart is barren, devoid of any lifesigns or indications of settled territory.

A1S6_STARMAP.name: Planetary Chart
A1S6_STARMAP.subtitle: Cartographic Data
A1S6_STARMAP.description: A map of a nearby planet. A a relic of an ancient civilisation has been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

TUT_STARMAP.name: Planetary Chart
TUT_STARMAP.subtitle: Cartographic Data
TUT_STARMAP.description: A map of a nearby planet. The coordinates of a distress signal have been marked. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

CHART_TREASURE.name: Artifact Chart
CHART_TREASURE.subtitle: Dig Site Cartographic Data
CHART_TREASURE.description: A map of a nearby planet. An ancient ruined site has been marked. Excavating this site is likely to yield valuable treasures. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display. New maps can be gained by exchanging Navigation Data with a Space Station Cartographer.

CHART_HIVE.name: Sentinel Boundary Map
CHART_HIVE.subtitle: Anomalous Planetary Location Data
CHART_HIVE.description: A strange, shifting map. Though hard to focus upon, this chart appears to show the location of a nearby Sentinel Pillar. Such Sentinel strongholds house many secrets... Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

CHART_ROBOT.name: Echo Locator
CHART_ROBOT.subtitle: Harmonic Location Tracker
CHART_ROBOT.description: A curious mesh of old and new technology, a hybrid between two entirely separate methods of creation. Nonetheless, this location tracing device appears fully functional. Select this device and use Resonate (FE_ALT1) to trace its harmonic origin.

CHART_SETTLE.name: Settlement Chart
CHART_SETTLE.subtitle: Specialist Planetary Chart
CHART_SETTLE.description: A map showing the location of a nearby planetary settlement, acquired from the Space Station Cartographer. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

CHART_BUI_SETTL.name: Autophage Settlement Chart
CHART_BUI_SETTL.subtitle: Harmonic Planetary Chart
CHART_BUI_SETTL.description: A map showing the location of a nearby Autophage planetary settlement, acquired from an Autophage Synthesis Terminal. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

ARTIFACT_KEY.name: Ancient Key
ARTIFACT_KEY.subtitle: Timeless Artifact
ARTIFACT_KEY.description: A key of some weight, this aged piece of wrought iron must belong in a nearby lock...

TRIDENT_KEY.name: Trident Key
TRIDENT_KEY.subtitle: Aquatic Relic
TRIDENT_KEY.description: A strange forked key, glowing with an ultraviolet light. Despite its primitive appearance, Exosuit scanning systems reveal traces of nanite foam upon its teeth.

WAR_CURIO3.name: Vy'keen Tablet
WAR_CURIO3.subtitle: Communion of Hirk
WAR_CURIO3.description: A stone tablet bearing line after line of intricate runes. The words are unintelligible, an ancient dialect forgotten by all but the oldest of the Vy'keen elders. The hand that carved this stone must have been extraordinary. The stonework is precise, delicate - and yet perfectly conveys the unyielding aggression its writer clearly possessed.

EXP_CURIO3.name: Divergence Cube
EXP_CURIO3.subtitle: Anomalous Data Unit
EXP_CURIO3.description: A glitching, pulsing data unit. It does not seem to belong in this reality. The cube gives the impression of a silent scream, the frozen cries of hundreds of lost minds trapped within.

STATION_KEY.name: Station Override
STATION_KEY.subtitle: AI Master Key
STATION_KEY.description: A portable data drive containing the AI override codes for a Space Station Core. The importance of the station AI core ensures that such keys are both highly regulated and extremely profitable on the black market.

REP_TOKEN.name: Forged Passport
REP_TOKEN.subtitle: Overwritten Digital Record
REP_TOKEN.description: A counterfeit starship registration document. This digital signature is guaranteed free of previous crimes or misdemeanors. Can be used to reset any negative faction standing records at a Space Station Core.

NAV_DATA.name: Navigation Data
NAV_DATA.subtitle: Encrypted Navigation Data
NAV_DATA.description: Encoded navigation data. This highly portable data unit contains all relevant cartographical information for a planetary region. May be traded with a Cartographer aboard a Space Station in exchange for usable star charts.

NAV_DATA_DROP.name: Exosuit Upgrade Chart
NAV_DATA_DROP.subtitle: Encrypted Navigation Data
NAV_DATA_DROP.description: Encoded navigation data which, when properly decrypted, will reveal the location of a Drop Pod containing an Exosuit Inventory Upgrade. Select the coordinates in the inventory and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

LOG_KEY.name: Log Encryption Key
LOG_KEY.subtitle: Incomplete Data Sequence
LOG_KEY.description: A fragment of the encryption override sequence for a freighter's emergency log. Several parts of the sequence may be required to gain full access to recorded data.

ACCESS1.name: AtlasPass v1
ACCESS1.subtitle: Access Card
ACCESS1.description: Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species. Provides access to low level restricted areas and outpost systems.

ACCESS2.name: AtlasPass v2
ACCESS2.subtitle: Access Card
ACCESS2.description: Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species. Provides access to mid-tier restricted areas and outpost systems.

ACCESS3.name: AtlasPass v3
ACCESS3.subtitle: Access Card
ACCESS3.description: Security and permissions pass granted to specific travellers by many primary galactic species. Provides access to high level restricted areas and outpost systems.

POLICE_TOKEN.name: Defence Chit
POLICE_TOKEN.subtitle: System Authority Payment Substitute
POLICE_TOKEN.description: A token, entitling the bearer to support from the system authorities in dealing with pirate attacks.

MIND_ARC.name: Mind Ark
MIND_ARC.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product
MIND_ARC.description: A strange piece of technology, a gift from beyond the stars. It shimmers in a way that suggests it is not fully in this world.

SOUL_ENGINE.name: Soul Engine
SOUL_ENGINE.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product
SOUL_ENGINE.description: A powerful organic computing unit. A glitching beat drives this miracle circuit, performing cycle after cycle in an endless, furious loop of calculation.

BP_SALVAGE.name: Salvaged Data
BP_SALVAGE.subtitle: Salvaged Technology
BP_SALVAGE.description: The salvageable heart of some ancient technology. Unreadable in its current form. These databanks can be spent at a Construction Research Unit and used to research new Construction Blueprints.

FACT_TOKEN.name: Factory Override Unit
FACT_TOKEN.subtitle: Advanced Research Module
FACT_TOKEN.description: A portable data unit, compatible with most planetary fabricator facilities. Once access has been gained to a central control terminal, the Override Unit can divert the facilities resources towards researching new product recipes.

FRIG_TOKEN.name: Salvaged Frigate Module
FRIG_TOKEN.subtitle: Capital Ship Wiring Platform
FRIG_TOKEN.description: A technology module harvested from the remains of a large interstellar starship. May be collected from freighter crashsites or salvaged during frigate expeditions. Useless in its current form, a Research Station aboard your freighter may be able to convert it into useable technology.

SHIP_INV_TOKEN.name: Storage Augmentation
SHIP_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Starship Expansion Module
SHIP_INV_TOKEN.description: A technology module harvested from the remains of a salvaged starship. May also be collected from freighter crash sites or salvaged during frigate expeditions. Can be used to expand starship storage capacity at the Space Station's Starship Outfitter.

FREI_INV_TOKEN.name: Cargo Bulkhead
FREI_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Auto-Expanding Freighter Module
FREI_INV_TOKEN.description: A technology module harvested from the remains of an abandoned freighter found floating in space. May also be salvaged during frigate expeditions. Pre-packed nano-expanders fill out this portable unit and graft it to an existing freighter, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply at your freighter's Upgrade Terminal.

WEAP_INV_TOKEN.name: Multi-Tool Expansion Slot
WEAP_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Upgrade Unit
WEAP_INV_TOKEN.description: A flexible upgrade circuit, compatible with all person Multi-Tools. This module can be wired into a Multi-Tool at a Space Station Multi-Tool Upgrade Rack, granting the user more space in the Multi-Tool's internal layout to add further upgrades or technology specialisations.

SUIT_INV_TOKEN.name: Exosuit Expansion Unit
SUIT_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Upgrade Unit
SUIT_INV_TOKEN.description: An advanced survival technology module that allows expansion of a user's Exosuit Storage. Pre-packed nano-expanders create stablised sub-warp voids within the Exosuit, increasing its inventory capacity. Apply this augmentation at the Exosuit upgrade terminal on board a Space Station.

ALIEN_INV_TOKEN.name: Spawning Sac
ALIEN_INV_TOKEN.subtitle: Sentient Vessel Storage Sac
ALIEN_INV_TOKEN.description: An additional storage nodule for Sentient starships. Upon hatching, the parasite inside this sac is grafted upon the vessel, exchanging the use of its cavernous innards for vital nutrients from the host. Use FE_ALT1 to trigger growth and begin the hatching process.

ALIEN_TECHBOX.name: Psychonic Egg
ALIEN_TECHBOX.subtitle: Pulsating Yolk Sac
ALIEN_TECHBOX.description: A writhing sac of genetic fluid, designed to foster the creation of new bio-infused technology for a sentient starship. The embryo will grow into bio-technology upgrade. Begin biogenesis with FE_ALT1.

TECHBOX.name: Memory Fragment
TECHBOX.subtitle: Technology Echo
TECHBOX.description: The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an important technology upgrade to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

INVBOX.name: Memory Fragment (Inventory)
INVBOX.subtitle: Rogue Technology Echo
INVBOX.description: The shattered remnants of an expired traveller. It whispers, an unknowable name deep within its fibres. The memory will manifest as an inventory expansion to aid you on your travels. Absorb this memory with FE_ALT1.

FRIGATE_FUEL_1.name: Frigate Fuel (50 Tonnes)
FRIGATE_FUEL_1.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
FRIGATE_FUEL_1.description: A small barrel of frigate fuel. This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

FRIGATE_FUEL_2.name: Frigate Fuel (100 Tonnes)
FRIGATE_FUEL_2.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
FRIGATE_FUEL_2.description: A large barrel of frigate fuel. This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

FRIGATE_FUEL_3.name: Frigate Fuel (200 Tonnes)
FRIGATE_FUEL_3.subtitle: Stabilised Di-hydrogen Fuel
FRIGATE_FUEL_3.description: A huge barrel of frigate fuel. This viscous gel is highly toxic to the touch. A refined fuel, it powers the interstellar engines of large trading ships.

FRIG_BOOST_TRA.name: Mind Control Device
FRIG_BOOST_TRA.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
FRIG_BOOST_TRA.description: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition. The mind control device plugs into the ship's trading and communications systems, allowing the Fleet Commander to gain the upper hand in any negotiation.

FRIG_BOOST_EXP.name: Holographic Analyser
FRIG_BOOST_EXP.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
FRIG_BOOST_EXP.description: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition. This powerful analytic computer overclocks the existing fleet systems, allowing for faster-than-light calculations. Heat is a problem, and the chips do not last long.

FRIG_BOOST_MIN.name: Mineral Compressor
FRIG_BOOST_MIN.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
FRIG_BOOST_MIN.description: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition. The mineral compressor allows fleet mining crews to liquidise the substances they extract, for both faster processing and easier transportation.

FRIG_BOOST_COM.name: Explosive Drones
FRIG_BOOST_COM.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
FRIG_BOOST_COM.description: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition. This pack of autonomous explosives have been programmed to launch from the fleet and pilot themselves directly towards hostile vessels. Extremely dangerous.

FRIG_BOOST_SPD.name: Fuel Oxidiser
FRIG_BOOST_SPD.subtitle: Consumable Frigate Upgrade
FRIG_BOOST_SPD.description: A temporary frigate upgrade that lasts for one expedition. This powerful fuel upgrade overloads frigate engines, allowing for faster-than-usual travel.

TRA_CURIO1.name: Gek Relic
TRA_CURIO1.subtitle: Medium value curiosity
TRA_CURIO1.description: A metal statuette of a creature with a coin placed in its beak. Popular with many traders who see it as an emblem of fair commerce and peace.

TRA_CURIO2.name: GekNip
TRA_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity
TRA_CURIO2.description: Edible product much beloved by the Gek. Allows beaked traders to release delightfully scented packets of gas for a prolonged period of time. GekNip gas packets are considered an art form, and the truest representation of the Gek soul.

NIPNIPBUDS.name: NipNip Buds
NIPNIPBUDS.subtitle: Medicinal Substance
NIPNIPBUDS.description: A pungent bud harvested from the NipNip plant, often used to produce Gek Nip.

WAR_CURIO1.name: Vy'keen Effigy
WAR_CURIO1.subtitle: Medium value curiosity
WAR_CURIO1.description: A small wooden icon carved into the shape of a Sentinel drone. Used by warriors to enter a temporary trance-like state that eliminates their kind's need for sleep.

WAR_CURIO2.name: Vy'keen Dagger
WAR_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity
WAR_CURIO2.description: Largely ceremonial weapon. A vital part of Vy'keen tradition and culture.

EXP_CURIO1.name: Korvax Casing
EXP_CURIO1.subtitle: High value curiosity
EXP_CURIO1.description: The metallic shell of a disconnected electronic lifeform that was too distant from its kind to be refreshed with a new entity. Highly prized by all species, not least its own.

EXP_CURIO2.name: Convergence Cube
EXP_CURIO2.subtitle: Trade commodity
EXP_CURIO2.description: Device used by the Korvax for the storage of historical and cultural information.

FARMPROD1.name: Acid
FARMPROD1.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD1.description: Dilute acid for high current generation in diverse power cells. Crafted from Mordite and Fungal Mould.

FARMPROD2.name: Lubricant
FARMPROD2.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD2.description: A synthetic lubricant that reduces wear and prolongs the lifespan of technologies with moving parts. Crafted from Faecium and Gamma Root.

FARMPROD3.name: Glass
FARMPROD3.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD3.description: Shatter-proof, scratch-resistant glass with a self-cleaning, UV-cured coating, for general construction use. Refined from Silicate powder. Extract silicate from the earth with a Terrain Manipulator. Can be crafted from Frost Crystals extracted from plants on frozen worlds.

FARMPROD4.name: Heat Capacitor
FARMPROD4.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD4.description: A thermal regulator produced from refined organic material. It is unique in its ability to produce, dissipate and distribute heat as required. Crafted from Solanium and Frost Crystals.

FARMPROD5.name: Poly Fibre
FARMPROD5.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD5.description: A connective fibre for electronics, made from an advanced synthetic polymer and capable of serving as a conduit for power and data. Crafted from Cactus Flesh and Star Bulbs.

FARMPROD6.name: Unstable Gel
FARMPROD6.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD6.description: A highly reactive gel, this substance is both energy-rich and dangerous to touch. Crafted from Cactus Flesh.

FARMPROD7.name: Liquid Explosive
FARMPROD7.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD7.description: A general purpose high explosive, offered in liquid form for convenience of transport and deployment. Do not drink. Crafted from Acid and Unstable Gel.

FARMPROD8.name: Living Glass
FARMPROD8.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD8.description: An advanced building material, this glass has been imbued with organic compounds that allow it to react to the environment. Microbes within the glass filter harmful light of all wavelengths and balance the atmosphere as required. Crafted from Lubricant and Glass.

FARMPROD9.name: Circuit Board
FARMPROD9.subtitle: Advanced Agricultural Product
FARMPROD9.description: Stackable, semi-flexible circuit board made from a highly durable synthetic polymer. Crafted from Heat Capacitors and Poly Fibre.

REACTION1.name: Thermic Condensate
REACTION1.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product
REACTION1.description: A refined product, holding the energy potential of heated atmospheric gas in a stable state until required. Crafted from Sulphurine and Condensed Carbon.

REACTION2.name: Enriched Carbon
REACTION2.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product
REACTION2.description: A refined product, taking ordinary carbon and boosting it with radioactive energy. Crafted from Radon and Condensed Carbon.

REACTION3.name: Nitrogen Salt
REACTION3.subtitle: Enhanced Gas Product
REACTION3.description: A refined product, this is a powerful organic fertiliser in an easily distributed form. Crafted from Nitrogen and Condensed Carbon.

COMPOUND1.name: Organic Catalyst
COMPOUND1.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
COMPOUND1.description: A catalytic material used in the creation of many organic fertilisers. Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Enriched Carbon.

COMPOUND2.name: Semiconductor
COMPOUND2.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
COMPOUND2.description: An advanced material useful in many electronic devices, with its own in-built temperature regulator. Crafted from Thermic Condensate and Nitrogen Salt.

COMPOUND3.name: Hot Ice
COMPOUND3.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
COMPOUND3.description: A paradoxical material, made less mysterious by its relative ease of manufacture. Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Nitrogen Salt.

COMPOUND4.name: Fusion Accelerant
COMPOUND4.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
COMPOUND4.description: An advanced fuel source, made from a perfect blend of high potential energy organic materials. Crafted from Organic Catalyst and Nitrogen Salt.

COMPOUND5.name: Superconductor
COMPOUND5.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
COMPOUND5.description: An advanced conductive material, the superconductor further enriches the field-warping power of the Semiconductor. Crafted from Enriched Carbon and Semiconductors.

COMPOUND6.name: Cryo-Pump
COMPOUND6.subtitle: Manufactured Gas Product
COMPOUND6.description: An advanced, self-regulating hybrid material, the Cryo-Pump distributes heat across itself with near perfect efficiency, making it vital in the creation of thermal regulators. Crafted from Hot Ice and Thermic Condensate

MEGAPROD1.name: Portable Reactor
MEGAPROD1.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product
MEGAPROD1.description: A miniature self-controlled nuclear reactor. Generates sub-stellar levels of energy in a hassle-free, widely compatible fuel module. Crafted from Liquid Explosives and Fusion Accelerant.

MEGAPROD2.name: Quantum Processor
MEGAPROD2.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product
MEGAPROD2.description: A highly advanced computational device, essential for the complex calculations involved in warp travel. Crafted from Circuit Boards and Superconductors.

MEGAPROD3.name: Cryogenic Chamber
MEGAPROD3.subtitle: Advanced Crafted Product
MEGAPROD3.description: A low temperature chamber, designed to prevent the natural decay of organic matter. Crafted from Living Glass and a Cryo-Pump.

ULTRAPROD1.name: Fusion Ignitor
ULTRAPROD1.subtitle: Highly Refined Technology
ULTRAPROD1.description: A highly advanced piece of technology for use in the next generation of power plants. Producing a fusion core requires both intricate scientific skills and complex industrial processes. Crafted from Portable Reactor, Quantum Processors and Geodesite.

ULTRAPROD2.name: Stasis Device
ULTRAPROD2.subtitle: Highly Refined Technology
ULTRAPROD2.description: A device specifically crafted to keep lifeforms alive for thousands of years longer than their natural lifespan. Such a device requires great skill to manufacture, as not only is it technically complex, but the consequences for a user in the event of malfunction would be disastrous. Crafted from Quantum Processors, Cryogenic Chambers, and Iridesite.

TRA_ALLOY1.name: Nanotube Crate
TRA_ALLOY1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)
TRA_ALLOY1.description: A packed crate of carbon nanotubes. These tiny but incredibly strong tubes are required in the construction of tiny but incredibly strong scientific components.

TRA_ALLOY2.name: Self-Repairing Heridium
TRA_ALLOY2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)
TRA_ALLOY2.description: A hopper of self-repairing Heridium. It looks fresh. Used in the creation of scientific components. Self-repairing heridium is particularly useful for deployment in remote facilities, where maintenance opportunities may be limited or deadly.

TRA_ALLOY3.name: Optical Solvent
TRA_ALLOY3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)
TRA_ALLOY3.description: Several bottles of optical solvent. The liquid in these bottles is used to wash away surplus light that may otherwise cause decay in scientific components.

TRA_ALLOY4.name: 5D Torus
TRA_ALLOY4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)
TRA_ALLOY4.description: A specially manufactured container of five-dimensional tori. Highly specific materials are required to construct shapes in extra dimensions. These tori are used to contain the strong fields generated in the manufacture of scientific components.

TRA_ALLOY5.name: Superconducting Fibre
TRA_ALLOY5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Construction)
TRA_ALLOY5.description: A densely layered package of superconducting fibres. Powerful, flexible, and water-resistant; the controlled magnetic weave of these fibres is vital in the creation of many scientific components.

TRA_COMMODITY1.name: Decrypted User Data
TRA_COMMODITY1.subtitle: Trade Goods
TRA_COMMODITY1.description: A crate packed with hard drives, each of which contain vast amounts of decrypted user data. Individually of low value, taken together these repositories can be processed and scanned for valuable data. This processing occurs in systems with advanced material economies.

TRA_COMMODITY2.name: Star Silk
TRA_COMMODITY2.subtitle: Trade Goods
TRA_COMMODITY2.description: Several spools of star silk. Star silk is woven on enormous solar looms in orbit around trading planets. Cosmic ray impact triggers the pattern of the weave, which can then be used in advanced material processing.

TRA_COMMODITY3.name: Comet Droplets
TRA_COMMODITY3.subtitle: Trade Goods
TRA_COMMODITY3.description: Several canisters of comet droplets. An elaborate trading name for chunks of meteorite, these rocks are nonetheless extremely valuable to the advanced material economies that can process them.

TRA_COMMODITY4.name: Ion Sphere
TRA_COMMODITY4.subtitle: Trade Goods
TRA_COMMODITY4.description: A packed crate of ion spheres. These delicate glass spheres house a small-scale replica of the upper atmosphere. Sparkly and hypnotic to look at, these baubles are also of importance in the manufacture of advanced material alloys.

TRA_COMMODITY5.name: Teleport Coordinators
TRA_COMMODITY5.subtitle: Trade Goods
TRA_COMMODITY5.description: A bundle of precisely calibrated teleport coordinators. These pin-prick sized circuits are vital to the delicate process of inserting reinforcing material into advanced alloys. They can also aid long-distance sales efforts.

TRA_COMPONENT1.name: Enormous Metal Cog
TRA_COMPONENT1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)
TRA_COMPONENT1.description: Several huge cogs. Sturdy, well-made metal gears. While not advanced technology themselves, they're a vital component in countless pieces of high-tech machinery all over the galaxy.

TRA_COMPONENT2.name: Non-Stick Piston
TRA_COMPONENT2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)
TRA_COMPONENT2.description: Wrapped and greased pistons, ready for shipping. High-tech components frequently require rapidly moving parts, or high-endurance motors. Without specially coated pistons, the failure rate of such parts would be significantly higher.

TRA_COMPONENT3.name: Mesh Decouplers
TRA_COMPONENT3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)
TRA_COMPONENT3.description: A crate of mesh decouplers. The creation of high-tech components often involves accidental mesh-coupling. These decouplers are particularly powerful, being able to deploy six prongs simultaneously.

TRA_COMPONENT4.name: Holographic Crankshaft
TRA_COMPONENT4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)
TRA_COMPONENT4.description: Packed and separated data containers for holographic crankshafts. Real crankshafts are frequently too large, noisy or hard-to-maintain for use in delicate machines. When faced with such a situation, high-tech manufacturers turn to these holographic substitutes.

TRA_COMPONENT5.name: Vector Compressors
TRA_COMPONENT5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Industrial)
TRA_COMPONENT5.description: A large crate of high-capacity vector compressors. The creation of interstellar drives often requires dimensions to be condensed and then re-rendered. Such high-tech component manufacture would not be possible without industrial-grade compressors such as these.

TRA_ENERGY1.name: Spark Canister
TRA_ENERGY1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)
TRA_ENERGY1.description: A crate packed with spark canisters. Many industrial and mining processes have considerable power demands. A counterpart to the slow release of a battery, spark canisters are able to meet these demands instantaneously.

TRA_ENERGY2.name: Industrial-Grade Battery
TRA_ENERGY2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)
TRA_ENERGY2.description: A packet of well-isolated industrial batteries. Heavy-duty batteries are required to power deep level miningoperations. These highly durable sources can last for weeks, even in the extremes of heat and pressure found kilometres underground.

TRA_ENERGY3.name: Ohmic Gel
TRA_ENERGY3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)
TRA_ENERGY3.description: Several packets of ohmic gel. Power-hungry mining operations are fraught with danger. Ohmic gel helps keep rapidly moving parts both insulated and lubricated.

TRA_ENERGY4.name: Experimental Power Fluid
TRA_ENERGY4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)
TRA_ENERGY4.description: Corrosion-resistant barrels of an experimental power fluid. One barrel of this highly volatile concoction is enough to power a space station for weeks on end. Particularly valued by mining economies.

TRA_ENERGY5.name: Fusion Core
TRA_ENERGY5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Energy Source)
TRA_ENERGY5.description: A slightly glowing bundle of fusion cores. Power source, engine, high-capacity heater. A fusion core is the ultimate in deep-space power generation. Highly valued by mining economies looking to make their asteroid colonies more self-sufficient.

TRA_EXOTICS1.name: De-Scented Bottles
TRA_EXOTICS1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)
TRA_EXOTICS1.description: A loose collection of recycled pheromone bottles. Vast quantities of pheromones are produced and distributed every day. This has spawned a lucrative trading opportunity for those willing to deal with the waste products. These glass jars have been thoroughly scrubbed and should pose no threat to the carrier.

TRA_EXOTICS2.name: Neutron Microscope
TRA_EXOTICS2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)
TRA_EXOTICS2.description: A parcel of neutron microscopes. Scientific economies produce and consume large numbers of microscopes. However, some have slight defects that render them unsuitable for precision work. These are still a trading opportunity, in that they can be sold to those unable to tell the difference.

TRA_EXOTICS3.name: Instability Injector
TRA_EXOTICS3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)
TRA_EXOTICS3.description: A jumbled box of instability injectors. Grand experiments often require a large number of variables to be changed in a very short period of time. An instability injector provides such a service. They can also be used to create chaos in market systems; such unethical behaviour represents an excellent trading opportunity.

TRA_EXOTICS4.name: Organic Piping
TRA_EXOTICS4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)
TRA_EXOTICS4.description: A vat of preserved organic piping. Still warm. To avoid difficult ethical problems, many labs grow their test subjects on a component level. The leftovers can be profitable in trading economies with relaxed medical regulations.

TRA_EXOTICS5.name: Neural Duct
TRA_EXOTICS5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Scientific)
TRA_EXOTICS5.description: A box of fresh neural ducts. Neural ducts are temporary inserts designed for a brief boost of concentration and productivity. Useful everywhere, these are highly valued in trading economies where competition between workers is fierce.

TRA_MINERALS1.name: Dirt
TRA_MINERALS1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)
TRA_MINERALS1.description: Several tonnes of dirt. Leftover dirt from mining operations. Residual metals can be extracted by specialists in manufacturing economies with the time and equipment to sift through it.

TRA_MINERALS2.name: Unrefined Pyrite Grease
TRA_MINERALS2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)
TRA_MINERALS2.description: Large jars full of pyrite grease. A fat solution with a high mineral content. This grease is highly valued by manufacturing economies, where it's used to keep large machinery oiled and glistening.

TRA_MINERALS3.name: Bromide Salt
TRA_MINERALS3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)
TRA_MINERALS3.description: A crate of bromide salt. The result of an extensive distillation and evaporation process, the bromide salt vats feed hungry factories in manufacturing systems.

TRA_MINERALS4.name: Polychromatic Zirconium
TRA_MINERALS4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)
TRA_MINERALS4.description: A sack full of polychromatic zirconium crystals. These crystals produce lenses of dazzling colour and near-indestructible hardness. Highly valuable in manufacturing economies.

TRA_MINERALS5.name: Re-latticed Arc Crystal
TRA_MINERALS5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Minerals)
TRA_MINERALS5.description: A neatly wrapped parcel of re-latticed arc crystals. Extremely rare mineral formations, arc crystals are in high demand in manufacturing economies, where their hardness and conductivity is vital to several industrial processes. They also make alluring (if dangerous) jewellery.

TRA_TECH1.name: Decommissioned Circuits
TRA_TECH1.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)
TRA_TECH1.description: A collection of salvaged circuitry. Power generation economies go through vast numbers of high-tech components. As such, the demand is present even for highly damaged circuits, to be scavenged for parts or just plugged wholesale into low-quality power cores.

TRA_TECH2.name: Welding Soap
TRA_TECH2.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)
TRA_TECH2.description: Several large bars of welding soap. Used in power generation systems to heat-clean metal diodes before they're fused into batteries.

TRA_TECH3.name: Ion Capacitor
TRA_TECH3.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)
TRA_TECH3.description: A reinforced crate of ion capacitors. These supercapacitors have an incredibly high energy density. In great demand in power generation economies.

TRA_TECH4.name: Autonomous Positioning Unit
TRA_TECH4.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)
TRA_TECH4.description: A container of positioning units and associated wiring. These APS units can be used to turn virtually any technology into a self-navigating system. Highly valuable in power generation economies, where they're used to remove conductive organic hands from the manufacturing process.

TRA_TECH5.name: Quantum Accelerator
TRA_TECH5.subtitle: Trade Goods (Technology)
TRA_TECH5.description: Several large quantum accelerator units. Capable of propelling matter at unmeasurable speeds, these units are particularly important in power generation economies, where they're used to compress the energy stored in high-grade batteries.

ILLEGAL_PROD1.name: Blood Salt
ILLEGAL_PROD1.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD1.description: Jars of murky, foul-smelling crystals. Produced in viscous evaporation traps, these organic salts are used in the manufacture of illegal pheromones. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD2.name: Stolen DNA Samples
ILLEGAL_PROD2.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD2.description: Sealed vials of unregistered DNA samples, free of the standard biosecurity mechanisms that prevent unlawful genetic tampering. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD3.name: Moon Ether
ILLEGAL_PROD3.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD3.description: A vat of highly volatile liquid. Its fumes are extremely flammable and a function as a powerful sedative. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD4.name: Prismatic Feathers
ILLEGAL_PROD4.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD4.description: A vacuum-sealed bundle of dazzlingly beautiful feathers. The animal that gave its life for this impossible, kaleidoscopic, charm is long since extinct. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD5.name: GrahGrah
ILLEGAL_PROD5.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD5.description: A canister of the now-banned Vy'keen battle gas, traditionally inhaled on the eve of battle. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD6.name: Counterfeit Circuits
ILLEGAL_PROD6.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD6.description: Reversed-engineered from a captured space station core, these unlicensed circuits are used in a wide range of black- and grey-market technologies. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD7.name: Banned Weapons
ILLEGAL_PROD7.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD7.description: Hacked together from the salvaged remains of Sentinel forces, these potent weapons are a favourite of outlaws across the galaxy. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ILLEGAL_PROD8.name: First Spawn Relics
ILLEGAL_PROD8.subtitle: Smuggled Goods
ILLEGAL_PROD8.description: Relics of the fallen Gek empire, condemned and banned by all the galaxy's major civilisations. Purchase is illegal at nearly all galactic trade terminals. Regular supply is only available within outlaw systems. Selling banned goods into commercially-regulated space may be highly profitable.

ATLAS_STONE.name: Atlas Stone
ATLAS_STONE.subtitle: Very high value curiosity
ATLAS_STONE.description: A spherical gem that seems to pulsate with red light from its centre. An extremely rare item often associated with ancient monolithic sites.

ATLAS_SEED_1.name: Captured Nanode
ATLAS_SEED_1.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_1.description: Atlas Seed containing zonally-shifted quasi-stellar substrate. Warning: do not allow matrix to commune with this dimensional space.

ATLAS_SEED_2.name: Englobed Shade
ATLAS_SEED_2.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_2.description: This Atlas Shell holds the remains of a parasitic space-borne lifeform, most likely of extra-dimensional origins.

ATLAS_SEED_3.name: Noospheric Orb
ATLAS_SEED_3.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_3.description: An Atlas Seed capable of resonating on humanoid telepathic frequencies; may attempt to subsume any subordinate intellect in close proximity.

ATLAS_SEED_4.name: Dark Matter
ATLAS_SEED_4.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_4.description: An Atlas Seed shell encompassing a void element harvested from the collapse state of the last universe. Toxic if ingested.

ATLAS_SEED_5.name: Dawn's End
ATLAS_SEED_5.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_5.description: Sculpted tau neutrino-boson matrix fixed within an irreplaceable Atlas Seed shell. May be semi-sentient.

ATLAS_SEED_6.name: Photic Jade
ATLAS_SEED_6.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_6.description: This irreplaceable Atlas Seed is a form of matter-adapted photons coalesced into physical solidity by unknown means.

ATLAS_SEED_7.name: State Phasure
ATLAS_SEED_7.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_7.description: For unknown reasons, this unique Atlas Seed has been phased out of alignment with this quantum reality. Contents cannot be determined.

ATLAS_SEED_8.name: Novae Reclaiment
ATLAS_SEED_8.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_8.description: Atlas Seed contains neutronium elements from a catastrophic supernova event that obliterated a sentient civilization in an earlier era.

ATLAS_SEED_9.name: Modified Quanta
ATLAS_SEED_9.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_9.description: This one-of-a-kind Atlas Seed holds an aesthetically pleasing mathematical construct salvaged from the simulation of an alternate reality.

ATLAS_SEED_10.name: Heart of the Sun
ATLAS_SEED_10.subtitle: Unique valuable curiosity
ATLAS_SEED_10.description: An Atlas Seed containing a time-locked quantum cilia suspended in a photonic shell. No others are known to exist.

HEXCORE.name: Hex Core
HEXCORE.subtitle: Contained Reality Glitch
HEXCORE.description: This strange energy orb constantly vibrates, emitting a low-frequency drone. Slight variations in the pattern repeat over and over, almost as if it is attempting to relay a message.

FISHBAIT_1.name: Mealworms
FISHBAIT_1.subtitle: Fishing Bait
FISHBAIT_1.description: A piece of specialist bait, designed to improve the size and rarity of your catch. Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

FISHBAIT_2.name: Spicy Chum
FISHBAIT_2.subtitle: Fishing Bait
FISHBAIT_2.description: A piece of specialist bait, designed to greatly improve the size and rarity of your catch. Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

FISHBAIT_3.name: Bionic Lure
FISHBAIT_3.subtitle: Fishing Bait
FISHBAIT_3.description: A specialist lure, designed to vastly improve the size and rarity of your catch. Of particular interest to anglers seeking legendary fish. Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

FISHBAIT_DAY.name: Dangling Orb
FISHBAIT_DAY.subtitle: Fishing Bait
FISHBAIT_DAY.description: A specialist lure, designed to attract diurnal fish. Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

FISHBAIT_NIGHT.name: Shadow Lure
FISHBAIT_NIGHT.subtitle: Fishing Bait
FISHBAIT_NIGHT.description: A specialist lure, designed to attract nocturnal fish. Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

FISHBAIT_STORM.name: Magpulse Lure
FISHBAIT_STORM.subtitle: Fishing Bait
FISHBAIT_STORM.description: A specialist lure, designed to attract fish that are only active during storms. Locate your Fishing Rig and begin bait application with FE_ALT1.

BONE_TEMP.name: %NAME% Exhibit
BONE_TEMP.subtitle: Pre-assembled Fossil Display
BONE_TEMP.description: %CRE_DESC% This curated fossil exhibit can be sold, traded, or re-deployed within any habitable base.

WORMBOOK.name: Writhing Manuscript
WORMBOOK.subtitle: Cultist Document
WORMBOOK.description: A translucent sheet of worm-vellum, inscribed with a fanatical text. It writhes when touched. 'The children were the first to notice. A thump thump thump, thundering deep below the sand. The first worm split the sky like black lightning as it leapt overhead. Worm by worm, they rose from the desert. Migrating. Every storm season, we each hope to be chosen. We arrange ourselves in lines across the desert, arms lifted to the sky. Anyone may enter the maw. We are all equal under the great worms.'

WORMSCROLL1.name: Wormskin Folio: 1
WORMSCROLL1.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll
WORMSCROLL1.description: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky. Our pathetic shells cannot follow, cannot reach its height, cannot reach its depths. We offer ourselves to the ground. We beg our sacrifice accepted.'

WORMSCROLL2.name: Wormskin Folio: 2
WORMSCROLL2.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll
WORMSCROLL2.description: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'The dust was choking. Our eyes reddened and watered. But the truth was inescapable. The veins of the Atlas had surfaced.'

WORMSCROLL3.name: Wormskin Folio: 3
WORMSCROLL3.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll
WORMSCROLL3.description: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'Now with every storm we beg to be chosen; Arms to the sky, faces to the dirt, calling out with all we have! When heavy raindrops hit the earth, the veins of Atlas answer. The rapture of our consumption is beyond words.'

WORMSCROLL4.name: Wormskin Folio: 4
WORMSCROLL4.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll
WORMSCROLL4.description: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'We tumble as it swallows, but grip the slick walls as best we can - Oh! - to reach the gizzard still awake. Breathe it deeply! How our lungs gurgle! The slime clogs our noses and stings our eyes, though in this warm darkness, we are already blind.'

WORMSCROLL5.name: Wormskin Folio: 5
WORMSCROLL5.subtitle: Fleshy Scroll
WORMSCROLL5.description: Ancient words are carved into this living document. They read: 'Curse the agony of regurgitation, Curse this this feeble flesh that still confines me! My brethren were reborn, rising from the blessed dust as fresh tendrils. Glistening capillaries to the great veins, slithering away into the sand. I will be patient. Until the next storm.'

WORMCORE.name: Flesh Rope
WORMCORE.subtitle: Intestinal Fragment
WORMCORE.description: The coiled remains of a Hungering Tendril's digestive tract. Though its meaty walls still convulse, there is surely no way for a fresh tendril to regrow from these meagre scraps... Such specialist offal is rarely traded on the Galactic Exchange and is thus highly valuable.

WORMPROD.name: Vile Spawn
WORMPROD.subtitle: Hungering Embryo
WORMPROD.description: The fragile embryo of a Hungering Tendril, still dripping with mucal butter. It wails and recoils when touched. May be extracted from embryotic sacs with the aid of a Visceral Synthesiser.

PIRATE_MAPPROD0.name: Pirate Map Fragment 1 of 3
PIRATE_MAPPROD0.subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data
PIRATE_MAPPROD0.description: Partial coordinate data, acquired from a troubled freighter captain. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto: "We Blight this new galaxy, as we did the last, as we will the next!" The data is of value to pirate faction The Blight, who attempted to retrieve it by violent means.

PIRATE_MAPPROD1.name: Pirate Map Fragment 2 of 3
PIRATE_MAPPROD1.subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data
PIRATE_MAPPROD1.description: Partial coordinate data, acquired from a freighter shot down by pirate faction The Blight. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto: "The galactic tunnels belong to the Blight!" The navigational information is corrupted, but appears to be linked to the data acquired from the freighter captain.

PIRATE_MAPPROD2.name: Pirate Map Fragment 3 of 3
PIRATE_MAPPROD2.subtitle: Scrambled Geographic Data
PIRATE_MAPPROD2.description: Partial coordinate data, acquired from a starship crashed on an ocean bed. The chart is signed with a snippet of pirate manifesto: "Annihilate every Traveller! All galaxies will fall to Blight!" The navigational information is unreadable in its current state, but appears to be linked to the data acquired from the freighter captain.

PIRATE_MAPWHOLE.name: Pirate Map
PIRATE_MAPWHOLE.subtitle: Illicit Geographic Data
PIRATE_MAPWHOLE.description: Reassembled treasure coordinate data, retrieved from the victims of pirate faction The Blight.

PIRATE_BEACON.name: Rendezvous Beacon
PIRATE_BEACON.subtitle: Navigational Data Recorder
PIRATE_BEACON.description: An unmarked navigation beacon, acquired from the wreck of a downed starship. Use Activate Beacon (FE_ALT1) to deploy the beacon and retrace the final steps of the crashed ship.

PIRATE_INVITE.name: Ticket to Freedom
PIRATE_INVITE.subtitle: Secure System Pass
PIRATE_INVITE.description: "Glorious survivor! The promised star will be yours!" A Secure system pass bearing the mark of the 'Voice of Freedom'. Select the pass and use Accept Invitation (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your navigation systems.

WHALE_BEACON.name: Dream Aerial
WHALE_BEACON.subtitle: Subconscious Access Device
WHALE_BEACON.description: A signal receiver and amplifier, tuned to the wavelength of the unconscious mind. It is every colour all at once, splitting the surrounding light into a shimmering rainbow. Warning: Carrying this antenna into deep space may attract the attention of cosmic megafauna.

S8_BEACON.name: Homeworld Repeater
S8_BEACON.subtitle: A Last Link Home
S8_BEACON.description: A makeshift device, cobbled from salvaged electronic components kept in deep storage for many years. This jumble of wires will attempt to make contact with the last-known remnants of the freighter's homeworld. Select the device and select Broadcast (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

SALVAGE_TECHMT1.subtitle: Multi-Tool Subcomponent
SALVAGE_TECHMT1.description: A valuable piece of recycled Multi-Tool technology, created by a Multi-Tool Decommissioning Terminal aboard the Space Anomaly. Component is useful only as scrap to be sold at a Trade Terminal.

BIOSHIP_STEM1.name: Fragile Neural Stem
BIOSHIP_STEM1.subtitle: Fragment of Life
BIOSHIP_STEM1.description: A delicate web of living tissue, this is the spark that will ignite a new lifeform into existence. It requires careful attendance while it matures.

BIOSHIP_STEM2.name: Fragile Heart
BIOSHIP_STEM2.subtitle: Fragment of Life
BIOSHIP_STEM2.description: Though nothing more than a cluster of cells, it is already possible to detect the soft beating of this proto-heart. It requires careful attendance while it matures.

BIOSHIP_STEM3.name: Fragile Shell
BIOSHIP_STEM3.subtitle: Fragment of Life
BIOSHIP_STEM3.description: Translucent and impossibly thin, this shell is no more than the merest breath of glass. And yet the potential is clear, a relentless multiplicative hardening adding constantly to its strength. It requires careful attendance while it matures.

BIOSHIP_STEM4.name: Growing Singularity
BIOSHIP_STEM4.subtitle: Fragile Breath
BIOSHIP_STEM4.description: A slow knitting together of flesh, neurons and antimatter. The way this mind experiences the universe is beyond any imagining. It requires careful attendance while it matures.

BIOSHIP_GROWTH1.name: Mature Neural Stem
BIOSHIP_GROWTH1.subtitle: Living Starship Organ
BIOSHIP_GROWTH1.description: This web of living tissue has grown its own metallic filaments, a mesh of silver and flesh. It crackles with its own electric charge, a network in need of its nodes. It awaits its host.

BIOSHIP_GROWTH2.name: Mature Heart Node
BIOSHIP_GROWTH2.subtitle: Living Starship Organ
BIOSHIP_GROWTH2.description: Powerful and muscular, this bionic pump sits within a network of synthetic tubes. It twitches when touched, its rhythms sensitive to the presence of other thinking entities. It awaits its host.

BIOSHIP_GROWTH3.name: Hardened Shell
BIOSHIP_GROWTH3.subtitle: Living Starship Organ
BIOSHIP_GROWTH3.description: Translucent, reflective, iridescent, impossibly strong. This shell swiftly reconfigures itself upon damage, knitting itself back together stronger than ever before. The newly formed bonds create a memory in glass, reflecting back the light absorbed at the moment of damage. It awaits its host.

BIOSHIP_GROWTH4.name: Singularity Core
BIOSHIP_GROWTH4.subtitle: Living Starship Organ
BIOSHIP_GROWTH4.description: A sensitive arrangement of neurons in a stable orbit around a miniature black hole. The mind at the heart of this bionic miracle is free from the constraints of linear time, its experience an impossible web of myriad collected lifeforms. It awaits its host.

BIOSHIP_EGG1.name: Active Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG1.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity
BIOSHIP_EGG1.description: An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated. When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a world beset by powerful anomalies and strange colours.

BIOSHIP_EGG2.name: Stirring Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG2.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity
BIOSHIP_EGG2.description: An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated. When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a dust-covered world of extreme storms.

BIOSHIP_EGG3.name: Awakened Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG3.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity
BIOSHIP_EGG3.description: An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated. When touched, conjures a powerful vision of a water world covered in lush and verdant plantlife.

BIOSHIP_EGG4.name: Cracking Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG4.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity
BIOSHIP_EGG4.description: An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated. When touched, conjures a powerful visions of a planet of strange anomalies, one minute a world of grass, the next a world of bizarre fungal growths...

BIOSHIP_EGG5.name: Cracking Void Egg
BIOSHIP_EGG5.subtitle: Agitated Curiosity
BIOSHIP_EGG5.description: An anomalous egg. Since the encounter with the bizarre deep-space 'creature', its strange music has grown more active, more agitated. When touched, conjures a powerful visions of pink and blue, colours seared into the mind of the holder. The Hunter SLASH The Reflection SLASH The Hunter SLASH The Spiral of Reality SLASH The Star Over WaterSLASH The Ascending Orb SLASH The Obscured Companion SLASH The Hunter SLASH The Lowly Insect SLASH The Anomaly SLASH The Sailor SLASH The Ocean King SLASH EUCLID EUCLID EUCLID

BIOSHIP_COMP1.name: Consciousness Bridge
BIOSHIP_COMP1.subtitle: Reactivated Neural Ladder
BIOSHIP_COMP1.description: A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host. This device appears to offer an interface between an individual entity and a greater shared consciousness. It appears derived from, but not attuned to, Korvax technology.

BIOSHIP_COMP2.name: Pulsating Core
BIOSHIP_COMP2.subtitle: Superheated Life Fragment
BIOSHIP_COMP2.description: A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host. Organic, but aglow with heat and possessing a highly-pressurised inner vessel. This 'device' is part pump, and part accelerated evolutionary chamber.

BIOSHIP_COMP3.name: Impossible Membrane
BIOSHIP_COMP3.subtitle: Auto-Regenerating Lifeform
BIOSHIP_COMP3.description: A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host. A fine mesh of tightly woven fibre. Micro-organisms embedded within the weave allow it to regenerate endlessly, a perfect and infinite bionic skin.

BIOSHIP_COMP4.name: Seeds of Glass
BIOSHIP_COMP4.subtitle: Frozen Archive
BIOSHIP_COMP4.description: A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host. Capsules of genetic material, encased in a film of living glass. Shared memories swim in the their reflective surfaces, waiting for their chance to shape the life within.

BIOSHIP_COMP5.name: Archived Soul
BIOSHIP_COMP5.subtitle: Bionic Ark
BIOSHIP_COMP5.description: A biomechanical construct, created to the design of an anonymous host. A fusion of complex circuitry and the ineffable glitch of the Traveller. Such a calculus might bind realities together, or tear them into mere simulated fragments.

EXOTIC_BIOPROD.name: Living Water
EXOTIC_BIOPROD.subtitle: Glassy Indeterminance
EXOTIC_BIOPROD.description: Unusual surface interactions cause this liquid to quickly split into small, perfect, spheres. Light refracted through one such sphere splits into colours beyond description. Of unknown origin.

MP_REP_PART1.name: Encrypted Navigation Computer
MP_REP_PART1.subtitle: Starship Component
MP_REP_PART1.description: An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors. This part could be in working order, but will require decryption before it can be installed in a new ship. A paired decryption terminal can be located via Exosuit analysis.

MP_REP_PART1C.subtitle: Starship Component
MP_REP_PART1C.description: An advanced nanocomputer, performing processing tasks related to starship navigation, flight stabilisation, and external sensors. The part appears intact, functional, and ready to be installed in a new ship.
