DRONE_BROKEN.name: Undamaged Drone Shell
DRONE_BROKEN.subtitle: Sentinel Debris
DRONE_BROKEN.description: The shell of a Sentinel drone, all that remains after its destruction in combat. While the exterior is physically intact, its internals have been severely burned. Given the right tools and several exotic components, it may be possible to repair it.

DRONE_PART_E2.name: Nanite Filament
DRONE_PART_E2.subtitle: Drone Component
DRONE_PART_E2.description: A thin, shimmering thread, once owned by Iteration: Gemini. This impossible fibre, once a treasured keepsake, sings on the wavelength of the Space Anomaly. A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

DRONE_PART_E3.name: Portal Phylactery
DRONE_PART_E3.subtitle: Drone Component
DRONE_PART_E3.description: A vial of the portal's blue amber, given to you by Iteration: Mercury. The ether of the Atlas itself, this is primeval liquid from which it weaves the multiverse. A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

DRONE_PART_P.name: Beads of Glass
DRONE_PART_P.subtitle: Drone Component
DRONE_PART_P.description: A handful of glassy orbs, once owned by Specialist Polo. Their pearlescent surface does not reflect the world around them, offering instead a mirror to different reality. A valuable and exotic component, this would be of great use to Iteration: Tethys in repairing the shattered Drone.

DRONE_FRIEND.name: Sentinel Flare (Off)
DRONE_FRIEND.subtitle: Sentinel Communicator
DRONE_FRIEND.description: A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone. Select the device and use Activate Flare (FE_ALT1) to signal [The Drone]. While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.

DRONE_FRIEND_X.name: Sentinel Flare
DRONE_FRIEND_X.subtitle: Sentinel Communicator
DRONE_FRIEND_X.description: A specialist device, created by Iteration Tethys. Its primary function is to hail your reconstructed Sentinel drone. Select the device and use Deactivate Broadcast (FE_ALT1) to stop signalling [ The Sentry ]. While this flare is active in your Exosuit inventory, the drone will stay by your side while planetside.

WALKER_PROD_2.name: Pristine Brain
WALKER_PROD_2.subtitle: Anomalous Material
WALKER_PROD_2.description: Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. A sinister purple light leaks from deep within its wiring, changing in intensity as it watches its holder. Unlike most Walker brains, this one has survived its violent extraction and is pristine and undamaged. It could potentially be installed in a new vessel...

WALKER_PROD_3.name: Hacked Brain
WALKER_PROD_3.subtitle: Anomalous Material
WALKER_PROD_3.description: Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile. Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by Iteration: Tethys. Its new-found freedom from the Atlas has been noted by the universe.

WALKER_PROD_4.name: Radiant Brain
WALKER_PROD_4.subtitle: Anomalous Material
WALKER_PROD_4.description: Shifting nanite clusters sewn together with a pugneum filament, this circuit is painfully hot to the touch. The purple light that leaks from within its wiring has softened, as if it has become less hostile. Previously embedded within a Sentinel Walker, this semi-organic computer has been altered by both Iteration: Tethys and a Messenger of the Atlas.

SHIPBRAIN_CLEAN.name: Harmonic Brain
SHIPBRAIN_CLEAN.subtitle: Harnessed Sentience
SHIPBRAIN_CLEAN.description: The central processing unit of a Sentinel interceptor ship. The circuitry appears stable, pulsing with a regular electrical heartbeat. It no longer reacts angrily to my presence. Status: DOCILE Install this unit in a disabled Sentinel ship to unlock its vestigial cockpit and enable manual piloting.

GAS_BRAIN_LOC.name: Deep-Space Lure
GAS_BRAIN_LOC.subtitle: Anomaly Attraction Device
GAS_BRAIN_LOC.description: A single-use device for locating a deep-space Gaseous Sentience. The lure generates an electromagnetic field of an intriguing nature to these highly advanced lifeforms. Select the Lure and use Generate Field (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

BIGGS_POI_LOC.name: Debris Rangefinder
BIGGS_POI_LOC.subtitle: Deep-Space Salvage Locator
BIGGS_POI_LOC.description: A single-use device for locating the wreckage of starships in deep space. Select the Rangefinder and Scan for Debris (FE_ALT1) to begin the location process.

ROGUE_BEACON.subtitle: Cosmic Melody Instrument
ROGUE_BEACON.description: A powerful but mellow musical instrument, capable of relaying song through space via gently undulating electromagnetic waves. Use Relay Song (FE_ALT1) while in deep space to broadcast the flute's melody...

ROGUE_FINDER.name: Memory Resonator
ROGUE_FINDER.subtitle: Loop Manifestation Technology
ROGUE_FINDER.description: A highly familar, entirely novel, piece of technology, designed by Specialist Polo as part of their loop research efforts. It synchronises its vibrations with the underlying song of the universe, allowing it to reveal memory hotspots within the loop. Begin the resonance alignment process with FE_ALT1.

ROGUE_KEY.name: A Dreadful Wailing
ROGUE_KEY.subtitle: Loop Artifact
ROGUE_KEY.description: A relentless, despairing cry that will not let you rest. Listen at a personally significant location to remember what has been forgotten. DEATH IS NOT THE END SLASH THE LOOP CONTINUES

ROGUE_G_STONE1.name: Memory Imprint I
ROGUE_G_STONE1.subtitle: Loop Artifact
ROGUE_G_STONE1.description: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "The leviathan was like nothing I've ever seen. So vast as to blot out the sun. I wanted it. I deserve to have it! It will be mine. But it resisted, would not come quietly. It wailed and it wailed as the infra-knife carved into its meat. It almost took me down with it. Perhaps it has. Perhaps..."

ROGUE_G_STONE2.name: Memory Imprint II
ROGUE_G_STONE2.subtitle: Loop Artifact
ROGUE_G_STONE2.description: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "The same nightmare chases me: a wail fills my cockpit, the dashboard controls gummed with blood. I have given up sleep. I pulse past blurred stars. And then there it was: majestic, drifting in the ocean of space. Something inside me burns for it. I must have it. Its great fin flexed toward my ship, and my hull was gone..."

ROGUE_G_STONE3.name: Memory Imprint III
ROGUE_G_STONE3.subtitle: Loop Artifact
ROGUE_G_STONE3.description: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "Today should have been the day. Their hour was at hand. It must be mine. They are like nothing I've ever seen. Everything was prepared. But it moved faster than I thought possible. As though it knew where I would fly, before I knew it myself. A great tentacle hugged my ship, my cockpit - pressing my suit down to the bone. This suit will be my grave."

ROGUE_G_STONE4.name: Memory Imprint IV
ROGUE_G_STONE4.subtitle: Loop Artifact
ROGUE_G_STONE4.description: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "The chase is over, and I have lost. The giants will endure, and I will end. As I plummeted from the sky, I saw another ship falling alongside mine. Then another, and another. I may have imagined it. The misfiring of a dying mind... Those creatures were so beautiful. But it is all ended now. They will haunt my thoughts no longer."

ROGUE_G_STONE5.name: Memory Imprint V
ROGUE_G_STONE5.subtitle: Loop Artifact
ROGUE_G_STONE5.description: A memory is burned into this strange material, an echo of another lifetime... "I came face-to-face with a creature more beautiful and bizarre than anything I have ever seen. Despite no discernible eyes, I do not believe it is blind. It was huge, glorious, serene. But then - with a flick of its tentacles, it was gone. I have thought of nothing else since. I can only think of the whale. whale. whale. wail."

S9_PACK1.name: Utopia Supply Drop Beta
S9_PACK1.subtitle: Utopia Foundation Supply Cache
S9_PACK1.description: To support the workers bravely terraforming the lava-filled wastes of planet Pehaelump, the Utopia Overseers are glad to supply this cache of vital goods. Select the supply pack and use Open Package (FE_ALT1) to collect your Utopia Foundation supplies, as well as details of your next assignment.

S9_PACK2.subtitle: Utopia Foundation Supply Cache

S9_MAP1.name: Settlement Coordinates Beta
S9_MAP1.subtitle: Utopia Foundation Settlement Chart
S9_MAP1.description: A map from the Utopia Foundation, showing personalised coordinates for your target construction site. Select the map and use Plot Route (FE_ALT1) to pin the location in your Exosuit display.

S9_MYSTERY_ITEM.name: Construction History
S9_MYSTERY_ITEM.subtitle: Classified Dossier
S9_MYSTERY_ITEM.description: This report records the history of a planetary facility forming part of the Utopia Project. Several sections are curiously absent. DS 2368 :: Facility founded. Plasma deep drill rig operational. DS 2384 :: Return growth steady at 1%. DS 2400 :: Overseers querying growth rate. DS 2416 :: Orbital exp. approved. Station trade booming. DS 2432 :: [Redacted] hazard encountered. DS 2448 :: [Redacted] DS 2464 :: Utopia Project launched. DS 2464 :: Facility restored. Plasma deep drill rig operational. Trade routes re-opened. DS 2480 :: [Redacted] DS 2496 :: Facility restored. Plasma deep drill rig operational. Trade routes re-opened. DS 2512 :: [Redacted] The last two entries are repeated over and over, across hundreds of pages.

S10_ROBO_HEAD.name: Construct Head
S10_ROBO_HEAD.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component
S10_ROBO_HEAD.description: The circuit cage and primary control sensors for a primitive automaton. Plans for this unit were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp.

S10_ROBO_BODY.name: Construct Shell
S10_ROBO_BODY.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component
S10_ROBO_BODY.description: The principal metallic carapace for a primitive automaton. Plans for this unit were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp.

S10_ROBO_ARMS.name: Construct Limbs
S10_ROBO_ARMS.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component
S10_ROBO_ARMS.description: A set of complex hydraulic tubes and various gripping surfaces that form a pair of usable arms for a primitive automaton. Plans for this unit were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp.

S10_ROBO_LEGS.name: Construct Legs
S10_ROBO_LEGS.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component
S10_ROBO_LEGS.description: A bipedal movement platform for a primitive automaton. Plans for this unit were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp.

S10_ROBO_CORE.name: Atlantid Reactor
S10_ROBO_CORE.subtitle: Salvaged Autophage Component
S10_ROBO_CORE.description: The central reactor unit and primary fuel source for a primitive automaton. Plans for this unit were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp.

S10_ATLAS_SEED1.name: Seed of Dreams
S10_ATLAS_SEED1.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
S10_ATLAS_SEED1.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. This mere atom contains boundless noise, each tiny vibration the hopes and dreams of entire lifetimes. Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

S10_ATLAS_SEED2.name: Seed of Power
S10_ATLAS_SEED2.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
S10_ATLAS_SEED2.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A particle of indescribable energy, it is unclear how to continues to exist within this reality. Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

S10_ATLAS_SEED3.name: Seed of Will
S10_ATLAS_SEED3.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
S10_ATLAS_SEED3.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. A flash of pure light and fury, this seed contains the unsuppressable need to exist. Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

S10_ATLAS_SEED4.name: Seed of Life
S10_ATLAS_SEED4.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
S10_ATLAS_SEED4.description: A seed of creation, a tiny drop of the infinity of the Atlas. Though a mere speck, this seed contains the potential for an entire universe; a boundless, glorious expansion. Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

S10_ATLAS_SEED5.name: Seed of Hope
S10_ATLAS_SEED5.subtitle: Voice of the Wordless Atlas
S10_ATLAS_SEED5.description: A seed of creation, a perfect droplet of infinity. A gift from the Atlas, this is a tiny fragment of all the universe's dreams, will, power and life; a fragment of the Travellers; a fragment of myself. Use FE_ALT1 to resonate the seed, converting its waveform into the audible range.

S10_SOUL.name: Echo Seed
S10_SOUL.subtitle: Crystalline Sentience Cage
S10_SOUL.description: The Seed is an echo of life, the last reverberations of a living being. This sentience was fused with a lattice of Atlantideum, as though it had germinated together with the crystal.

S10_FRAGMENT.name: Echo Collective
S10_FRAGMENT.subtitle: Consciousness Housing
S10_FRAGMENT.description: A shifting vortex of atlantideum, attuned to the growing collective will housed inside Nada's Prime Terminal. Current sentience threshold: ??%. The grains oscillate in a pattern, but the message is unintelligible.

STAFF_PART_A.name: Fibreglass Grip
STAFF_PART_A.subtitle: Voltaic Component
STAFF_PART_A.description: A strap of flexible resin, securely wrapped around a steel pole. One of three core components, this forms the backbone of a traditional Autophage Voltaic Staff.

STAFF_PART_B.name: Atlantideum Chamber
STAFF_PART_B.subtitle: Voltaic Component
STAFF_PART_B.description: A compact box of circuitry and ethereal crystals, painstakingly wired by hand. One of three core components, this forms the core of a traditional Autophage Voltaic Staff.

STAFF_PART_C.name: Concentric Transducer
STAFF_PART_C.subtitle: Voltaic Component
STAFF_PART_C.description: An electrified arrangement of mechanical wheels. Transforms stored energy into beams or propulsion, according to the specifications of weapons and laser attachments. One of three core components, this forms the head of a traditional Autophage Voltaic Staff.

S12_POI_SEED1.name: Memory of Ocean
S12_POI_SEED1.subtitle: Fragment of the Atlas
S12_POI_SEED1.description: This memory is a fragment of the cosmos, one filament in an infinite galaxy of possible pasts and possible futures. Reach the stars and then use FE_ALT1 to awaken this memory.

SIGNALCHARGE.subtitle: High Voltage Energy Pack
SIGNALCHARGE.description: A high-powered battery pack, designed to release a significant charge in a short space of time. Used to power the high energy needs of Signal Boosters as they survey planets for distant buildings.

S15_BOT_1.name: Message in a Bottle
S15_BOT_1.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
S15_BOT_1.description: A sealed bottle, found floating in the water. There appears to be a message from the Angler inside. Use FE_ALT1 to unseal the bottle and read the message within.

S15_MESSAGE0.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE0.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
S15_MESSAGE0.description: A message recovered from a bottle stowed beneath the seat of the starship. It reads: "I finally feel like I'm getting closer. A trader on Gisto offered me solid-gold information on its location, for a price. And so I'm selling my ship. I'll miss the Celeste, but I have to know if the rumours are true. I hope whoever buys you takes good care of you..." %PARTY_1%

S15_MESSAGE1.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE1.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
S15_MESSAGE1.description: A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads: "The rumours were true. It's out there, I can feel it. Not here, but somewhere. The water calls to me, I just need to follow its voice..." %PARTY_3%

S15_MESSAGE2.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE2.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
S15_MESSAGE2.description: A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads: "I saw it in my dreams last night. Scales like fire and eyes of pure starlight. It sang to me, a song of hope and longing. It wants me to find it, I know it. I must be closing in." %PARTY_4%

S15_MESSAGE3.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE3.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
S15_MESSAGE3.description: A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads: "I was right! It was here! After all these light years, all the doubts, it's finally mine. Oh, and how it shines! Like fire in the water, beautiful, impossible..." %PARTY_5%

S15_MESSAGE4.name: The Angler's Diary
S15_MESSAGE4.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
S15_MESSAGE4.description: A scrap of paper recovered from a bottle found bobbling in the water. The message on it reads: "The fire has faded from my catch's scales, and my dreams have soured. I thrash through the night. My skin itches, damp and clammy. Salt seeps from my pores. It longs to be free. I cannot keep it contained like this. It must be free. I must be free..."

S15_FISH.name: The Angler
S15_FISH.subtitle: Legendary Fish
S15_FISH.description: Fire dances across the scales of this impossible marine being. Its starlit eyes stare back at you with a meaning far deeper than any fish should know. As they stare, the world around you fades away. The sound of water fills your ears. It wants to be free. You want to be free...

ANY_BONE.name: Any Edible Bone
ANY_BONE.subtitle: Ingredient Category
ANY_BONE.description: A highly refined food product, created in the Nutrient Processor. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets. Food such as this can be highly valuable.

ANY_FISH.name: Any Seafood
ANY_FISH.subtitle: Ingredient Category
ANY_FISH.description: A piece of seafood, created in the Nutrient Processor. Food such as this can be highly valuable. Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.

SPOOK_JUICE.name: Elixir of Glass
SPOOK_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
SPOOK_JUICE.description: A slight membrane has begun to form over this viscous purple liquid. Beneath its glassy surface it swirls slowly, forming syrupy currents of its own accord. The elixir will maintain your local boundary integrity and prevent the intrusion of the horrors beyond. Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 or inject it directly into the Anomaly Suppressor from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

PORTAL_JUICE.name: Elixir of Quicksilver
PORTAL_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
PORTAL_JUICE.description: The liquid's silvered surface forms a perfect mirror, your own face reflected back as you examine it. But the more you stare, the less perfect the mirror becomes. The face in the image moves. It blinks. It - Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1 to reveal the location of nearby portals.

MESSAGE_JUICE.name: Elixir of BloodPR_10
MESSAGE_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
MESSAGE_JUICE.description: Thick and warm, the liquid in this jar is both deeply comforting and deeply unsettling, both familiar and repulsive at the same time. A shape forms in the surface, impossible and yet unmistakeable: PR_10. Present the elixir at a portal, or consume it with FE_ALT1 to commune with those beyond the boundaries of reality.

BOSS_JUICE.name: Elixir of Water
BOSS_JUICE.subtitle: Otherworldly Concoction
BOSS_JUICE.description: The water in this vessel seems to stretch on forever, plunging down to dizzying depths, far beyond what the container could possibly hold. Consume the elixir with FE_ALT1. Beware what lurks in the deep water...

This unusual ship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

SWITCH_SHIP01.name: Horizon Vector NX
SWITCH_SHIP01.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
SWITCH_SHIP01.description: An exclusive Starship. This compact fighter craft boasts superior manoeuvrability, giving it an edge in space combat. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

SWITCH_GUN01.name: Infinite Neon Mark XXII
SWITCH_GUN01.subtitle: Exclusive Multifunction Survival Device
SWITCH_GUN01.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool. This brightly-coloured rifle offers the user cutting-edge defensive capabilities in ground combat situations. Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

EXPD_BACKPACK01.name: Streamlined Jetpack Unit
EXPD_BACKPACK01.subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
EXPD_BACKPACK01.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A streamlined and lightweight backpack unit, featuring an elegant single-thruster design. This exclusive exosuit augmentation commemorates completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_HELMET01.name: Golden First Spawn Battle Mask
EXPD_HELMET01.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
EXPD_HELMET01.description: An aggressive Exosuit Appearance Override, modeled on the war helmets of the ancient Gek. This special edition is cast in a durable and precious alloy. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_SHIP01.name: Golden Vector
EXPD_SHIP01.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
EXPD_SHIP01.description: An exclusive golden edition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship, commemorating completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'. This highly-manoeuvrable spacecraft is constructed from a durable and precious alloy, and coated in a tough layer of fibrous insulation to endure many lifetimes' worth of rigorous space exploration. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

EXPD_TITLE01.name: Title: 'Pioneer'
EXPD_TITLE01.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE01.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL01.name: Pioneers Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL01.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL01.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal features the golden edition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship, and commemorates completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

EXPD_BANNER01.name: Pioneers Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER01.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER01.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_FIREPACK01.name: Atlas Firework Pack
EXPD_FIREPACK01.subtitle: Pyrotechnics Multi-Pack
EXPD_FIREPACK01.description: A three-variety pack of luxury fireworks. These stunning pyrotechnics render the likeness of an Atlas Interface, in bursts of indium, gold and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

EXPD_FIREWORK01.name: Blue-Red Atlas Firework
EXPD_FIREWORK01.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
EXPD_FIREWORK01.description: A stunning pyrotechnic rendition of an Atlas Interface, rendered in a burst of indium and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

EXPD_FIREWORK02.name: Gold-Blue Atlas Firework
EXPD_FIREWORK02.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
EXPD_FIREWORK02.description: A stunning pyrotechnic rendition of an Atlas Interface, rendered in a burst of gold and indium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

EXPD_FIREWORK03.name: Red-Gold Atlas Firework
EXPD_FIREWORK03.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
EXPD_FIREWORK03.description: A stunning pyrotechnic rendition of an Atlas Interface, rendered in a burst of cadmium and gold. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

EXPD_FIREWORK04.name: Flesh Launcher
EXPD_FIREWORK04.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
EXPD_FIREWORK04.description: A luxury firework. These organic pyrotechnics rocket into the sky and explode in a splatter of slime, plasma and wormlets. Ignite to create disgusting displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

EXPD_FIREPACK04.name: Flesh Launcher Pack
EXPD_FIREPACK04.subtitle: Pyrotechnics Multi-Pack
EXPD_FIREPACK04.description: A pack of luxury fireworks. These organic pyrotechnics rocket into the sky and explode in a splatter of slime, mucus, and wormlets. Ignite to create disgusting displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

BLD_EXPD_BASE01.name: Pioneers Expedition Flag
BLD_EXPD_BASE01.subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
BLD_EXPD_BASE01.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This elaborate, gold-fringed flag features a rendition of the iconic Alpha Vector Starship. Plant in a habitable base to commemorate completion of the inaugural Expedition, 'Pioneers'.

EXPD_SPEC02.name: SSV Normandy SR1
EXPD_SPEC02.subtitle: Exclusive Frigate
EXPD_SPEC02.description: The SSV Normandy SR1 is a one-of-a-kind 'deep scout' frigate. This legendary ship represents peace and cooperation between races, and commemorates completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition. Recruiting this frigate will add it to your fleet. Manage your frigate fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

MYSTERY_TRACKER.name: Historiographical Dosimeter
MYSTERY_TRACKER.subtitle: Personal Reality Flux Monitor
MYSTERY_TRACKER.description: Nada has detected a new pattern emerging in the stories of the Gek, Korvax, and Vy'keen. The dosimeter measures exposure to historiographical flux around key artifact sites. Recordings of unusual historical shifts will enable Nada to trace the signal. Assist Nada and Polo in their research by using this device to transmit historial data from alien artifact sites.

EXPD_TITLE02A.name: Title: 'Renegade'
EXPD_TITLE02A.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE02A.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition, and your success in tracking the renegade historical echo. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_TITLE02B.name: Title: 'Paragon'
EXPD_TITLE02B.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE02B.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the 'Beachhead' Expedition, and your success in tracking the renegade historical echo. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL02.name: Beachhead Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL02.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL02.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates the collective effort of the Travellers in mapping the Histiographical Flux and tracking the renegade echo during the Beachhead Expedition.

EXPD_BANNER02.name: Beachhead Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER02.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER02.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the 'Beachhead' Expedition, and your success in tracking the renegade historical echo. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

BLD_PLANET_HOLO.name: Holographic Chart Projector
BLD_PLANET_HOLO.subtitle: System Simulation Device
BLD_PLANET_HOLO.description: A decorative model of a star system, complete with holographic representations of various stellar objects. A small, self-contained, perpetual motion device generates the small amount of power required to continue the projection.

BLD_FLYJAR.name: Bio-Lantern
BLD_FLYJAR.subtitle: Organic Lighting
BLD_FLYJAR.description: A secure biological containment vessel, complete with its own purified internal atmosphere. Pre-installed bioluminescent insects provide a soft, flickering light, perfect for those seeking natural lighting for their base.

EXPD_TITLE03.name: Title: 'Globemaster'
EXPD_TITLE03.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE03.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the 'Cartographers' Expedition, and your success in documenting and then escaping from the expedition planet. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL03.name: Cartographers Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL03.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL03.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates your success in documenting and then escaping from the expedition planet.

EXPD_BANNER03.name: Cartographers Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER03.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER03.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the 'Cartographers' Expedition, and your success in documenting and then escaping from the expedition planet. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_TITLE04.name: Title: 'Worm Lord'
EXPD_TITLE04.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE04.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Emergence expedition. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL04.name: Emergence Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL04.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL04.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Emergence expedition.

EXPD_BANNER04.name: Emergence Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER04.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER04.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Emergence expedition. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_BUBBLE.name: Jetpack Bubble Trail
JETS_BUBBLE.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_BUBBLE.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Specially conditioned oil is added to the jetpack's exhaust jets, creating a stream of pearlescent bubbles as it operates. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_WORM.name: Ghastly Trail
JETS_WORM.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_WORM.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Attaches an active bio-chamber to the Jetpack's exhaust nozzles. During flight, the thrusters warm and expel the slimy juice contained within. Note: Contains living worms. Ejected worms may infest local ecosystems. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_03.name: Whispering Companion Egg
EXPD_EGG_03.subtitle: Horrific Spawn
EXPD_EGG_03.description: A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch! A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane. Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be nightmarish and soul-consuming.

EXPD_EGG_04.name: Sandworm Egg
EXPD_EGG_04.subtitle: Titanic Spawn
EXPD_EGG_04.description: A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch! Curled within the shell is a hungry wormlet, its coils rippling restlessly. Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be cursed and insatiable.

BLD_SKULL.name: Titanic Trophy
BLD_SKULL.subtitle: Ornamental Skull
BLD_SKULL.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This many-toothed skull once belonged to a large legless vertebrate, cousin to the titan sandworm. The powerful jaws can exert enough force to crush a Multi-Tool, and the bones of most creatures.

EXPD_WORMHAT.name: Feasting Casque
EXPD_WORMHAT.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
EXPD_WORMHAT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Redistribute your facial organs and alarm other explorers by assuming the appearance of a sandworm cultist. This bio-silicone helmet is sealed against all known planetary hazards, but may feel slightly clammy to the wearer. Ritualistically transform the head of your Vy'keen appearance at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_SENT.name: Reality Glitch Trail
JETS_SENT.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_SENT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. The jetpack exhaust is fitted with a high-concentrate pugneum dispenser. When the jets are activated, the resulting reaction carves miniature distortions in reality, and creates an interesting visual effect. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_POSTER05A.name: Solstice Poster
EXPD_POSTER05A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER05A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This golden poster evokes the of nostalgia of long summer days.

EXPD_POSTER05B.name: Abyssal Poster
EXPD_POSTER05B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER05B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. A reminder of what lurks in the depths below.

EXPD_POSTER05C.name: Territories Poster
EXPD_POSTER05C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER05C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This adrenaline-fueled poster depicts two noble herd leaders clashing over territory.

EXPD_PETCUST05.name: Exotic Armour
EXPD_PETCUST05.subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
EXPD_PETCUST05.description: An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. Ideal for fierce-tempered companions, this stylish plate armour protects vital organs against laser and projectile fire. Ultra-soft breathable padding reduces the likelihood of companions wriggling out of the accessory. Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

EXPD_BACKPACK05.name: Exotic Wingpack
EXPD_BACKPACK05.subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
EXPD_BACKPACK05.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. An elegant wing-assisted jetpack, inspired by the design philosophy of exotic starships. This exclusive exosuit augmentation commemorates completion of the 'Exobiology' Expedition. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_TITLE05.name: Title: 'Exobiologist'
EXPD_TITLE05.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE05.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Exobiology expedition. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL05.name: Exobiology Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL05.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL05.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Exobiology expedition, and celebrates the peaceful co-existence of Travellers with the countless species of wildlife inhabiting the universe.

EXPD_BANNER05.name: Exobiology Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER05.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER05.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the 'Exobiology' Expedition, and your explorations into the diverse wildlife inhabiting the universe. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_05.name: Quad Egg
EXPD_EGG_05.subtitle: Sentinel Spawn Capsule
EXPD_EGG_05.description: A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch! The shell crackles with an electronic energy. Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be tireless and watchful.

SHIP_PIRATE.name: Sputtering Starship Trail
SHIP_PIRATE.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_PIRATE.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. A ramshackle ship exhaust nozzle, hand-assembled in an emergency by an outlaw. Has an occasional propensity to explode, but with no adverse effect on flight handling. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

EXPD_POSTER06A.name: Dread Captain Fahng Poster
EXPD_POSTER06A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER06A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. Few Vy'keen would be unfamiliar with Dread Captain Fahng and their bone-chilling exploits - though it is not known for certain whether they are a real historical figure, or simply a story made up to frighten disobedient cubs.

EXPD_POSTER06B.name: Outlaw Poster
EXPD_POSTER06B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER06B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. A rebellious tribute to pirates, fugitives, and resistance to Sentinel law.

EXPD_POSTER06C.name: Resbur XIII Poster
EXPD_POSTER06C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER06C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This anarchistic poster depicts a notorious pirate-occupied planet.

EXPD_FLAG_06A.name: Piracy Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06A.subtitle: Exclusive Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06A.description: The bright red skull emblazoned on this velvety flag serves as a warning to hostile parties. An exclusive buildable base ornament.

EXPD_FLAG_06B.name: Unity Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06B.subtitle: Exclusive Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06B.description: A collaboratively designed standard, resulting from the cooperation between several intergalactic guilds. An exclusive buildable base ornament.

EXPD_FLAG_06C.name: Heraldry Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06C.subtitle: Exclusive Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06C.description: This flag's delicate golden embroidery instantly adds elegance and refinement to any habitable base. An exclusive buildable base ornament.

EXPD_FLAG_06D.name: Orbital Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06D.subtitle: Exclusive Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06D.description: An abstract representation of planetary orbits under a watchful eye, sewn from striking crimson and grey fabrics. An exclusive buildable base ornament.

EXPD_FLAG_06E.name: Viridian Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06E.subtitle: Exclusive Flag
EXPD_FLAG_06E.description: A contrasting green and purple design, this flag was inspired by those searching for verdant galaxies. An exclusive buildable base ornament.

EXPD_CUBE_06.name: Wayward Cube
EXPD_CUBE_06.subtitle: Floating Primitive
EXPD_CUBE_06.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This cubic lifeform drifted into an orbital station from another reality, where it was captured by a travelling merchant. Provides placid companionship when rehomed in a habitable base.

EXPD_TITLE06.name: Title: 'Hunter of the Blight'
EXPD_TITLE06.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE06.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Blighted expedition, the glorious retrieval of ill-gotten lucre, and the discovery of a pirate secret. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL06.name: Blighted Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL06.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL06.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Blighted expedition, the glorious retrieval of ill-gotten lucre, and the discovery of a pirate secret.

EXPD_BANNER06.name: Blighted Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER06.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER06.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the 'Blighted' Expedition, the glorious retrieval of ill-gotten lucre, and the discovery of a pirate secret. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_CAPE06.name: Outlaw Cape
EXPD_CAPE06.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
EXPD_CAPE06.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A battle-worn cape, stolen from notorious pirate faction The Blight. Woven from chemically-dipped nano-fibres, the fabric is completely impervious to the heat produced by jetpack exhaust. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_POSTER07A.name: Leviathan Poster
EXPD_POSTER07A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER07A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a pod of biological frigates gliding serenely through the cosmos.

EXPD_POSTER07B.name: The Loop Poster
EXPD_POSTER07B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER07B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster represents the reiterative nature of time.

EXPD_POSTER07C.name: Timesplice Poster
EXPD_POSTER07C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER07C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster is a reminder of the non-linear nature of reality.

SHIP_ROGUE.name: Temporal Starship Trail
SHIP_ROGUE.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_ROGUE.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

EXPD_CAPE07.name: Whalestalker Cloak
EXPD_CAPE07.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
EXPD_CAPE07.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. This sweeping cloak was once worn by an ill-fated Traveller - obsessed with their quest to capture a cosmic leviathan, and doomed to repeat the chase for all eternity. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

BLD_MINI_BIOFRI.name: Organic Frigate Calf
BLD_MINI_BIOFRI.subtitle: Ornamental Base Companion
BLD_MINI_BIOFRI.description: A juvenile cosmic leviathan, suitable for rehoming in a habitable base. This mysterious creature is enclosed in a chrono-preservation field to ensure it remains eternally young, playful, and a manageable size.

EXPD_TITLE07.name: Title: 'Looper'
EXPD_TITLE07.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE07.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Leviathan expedition, and the lifting of a generation-spanning curse. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL07.name: Leviathan Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL07.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL07.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Leviathan expedition, and the lifting of a generation-spanning curse.

EXPD_BANNER07.name: Leviathan Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER07.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER07.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the 'Leviathan' Expedition, and the lifting of a generation-spanning curse. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_BIOFRIG.name: Organic Frigate
EXPD_BIOFRIG.subtitle: Cosmic Leviathan
EXPD_BIOFRIG.description: This peaceful space giant is a mutation of organism and starcraft, and can be tamed to swim through the stars alongside a fleet of frigates. Recruiting this creature will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

EXPD_POSTER08A.name: Pilgrim Poster
EXPD_POSTER08A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER08A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster is dedicated to brave spacefarers who forge new paths across the galaxy.

EXPD_POSTER08B.name: Polestar Poster
EXPD_POSTER08B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER08B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster is dedicated to explorers and navigators who boldly seek out new horizons.

EXPD_POSTER08C.name: Heavy Shipping Poster
EXPD_POSTER08C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER08C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster is dedicated to the hard-working freighter crews who keep the universe fuelled and fed.

FREI_TRAIL_GRAV.name: High-Gravity Freighter Trail
FREI_TRAIL_GRAV.subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
FREI_TRAIL_GRAV.description: An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier. High-energy exhaust gases rapid condense as they exit the freighter's colossal engines, collapsing into micro-singularities. Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

EXPD_CAPE08.name: Fleet Commander's Cape
EXPD_CAPE08.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
EXPD_CAPE08.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Master, commander, voyager of the stars. Don your cloak and prepare to take the helm. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

BLD_MAPTUBE.name: Navigation Archive
BLD_MAPTUBE.subtitle: Secure Map Containment
BLD_MAPTUBE.description: A secure containment vessel, designed to provide a near-indestructible chamber for the storage of vital navigation charts. Resilient and designed to last thousands of years, this archive is entirely free of electronic components.

BLD_FIREPIT.name: Flaming Barrel
BLD_FIREPIT.subtitle: Inefficient Heat Source
BLD_FIREPIT.description: A low-tech heating device, ideal for generating light and heat without access to high-energy power sources. User is advised to keep arms and legs outside of the barrel at all times.

BLD_DATASIGN.name: Data Display Unit
BLD_DATASIGN.subtitle: Dynamic Signpost
BLD_DATASIGN.description: An arrangement of dynamic glass panels, each filled with undoubtedly useful and valuable information. This display unit also functions as a source of illumination.

EXPD_TITLE08.name: Title: 'The Seeker'
EXPD_TITLE08.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE08.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Polestar expedition, and the completion of a long cruise aboard a capital ship. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL08.name: Polestar Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL08.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL08.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Polestar expedition, and the completion of a long cruise aboard a capital ship.

EXPD_BANNER08.name: Polestar Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER08.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER08.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the 'Polestar' Expedition, and the completion of a long cruise aboard a capital ship. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_08.name: Helios Egg
EXPD_EGG_08.subtitle: Captured Space Protozoa
EXPD_EGG_08.description: A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch! Floating within the shell is a haunting glow, a beacon both beautiful and cursed. Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be gelatinous and spectral.

EXPD_POSTER09A.name: Factions Poster
EXPD_POSTER09A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER09A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster echoes the ongoing tensions between the galaxies' dominant lifeforms.

EXPD_POSTER09B.name: Night Squad Poster
EXPD_POSTER09B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER09B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts an inter-species friendship between three explorers of the universe.

EXPD_POSTER09C.name: Planetary Base Poster
EXPD_POSTER09C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER09C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster captures a towering skyline within the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project.

BLD_HOLOGEK.name: Holographic Friend
BLD_HOLOGEK.subtitle: Simulated Trader Lifeform
BLD_HOLOGEK.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This holographic Gek attendant provides eternal friendship to even the loneliest of habitable bases.

SPEC_BUCKETHELM.name: Fearsome Visor
SPEC_BUCKETHELM.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
SPEC_BUCKETHELM.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Strike dread into the hearts of your foes with this oxide-strengthened helmet. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_SHIP09.name: Utopia Speeder
EXPD_SHIP09.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
EXPD_SHIP09.description: A unique and exclusive starship, commemorating completion of the Utopia expedition, and contributions to the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project. This versatile craft is plated with radiation-resistant armour, and engineered with an aerodynamic profile for agility during atmospheric flight. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

EXPD_TITLE09.name: Title: 'Utopia Dignitary'
EXPD_TITLE09.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE09.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Utopia expedition, and contributions to the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL09.name: Utopia Expedition Decal
EXPD_DECAL09.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL09.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Utopia expedition, and contributions to the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project.

EXPD_BANNER09.name: Utopia Expedition Banner
EXPD_BANNER09.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER09.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Utopia expedition, and contributions to the Utopia Foundation communal habitation project. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_09.name: Robo-Warden Egg
EXPD_EGG_09.subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule
EXPD_EGG_09.description: A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to hatch! A regular electronic beeping can be heard from within the egg, soft and somehow reassuring. Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be meticulous and dependable.

EXPD_POSTER10A.name: Atlas Poster
EXPD_POSTER10A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER10A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster glows with a crimson so intense, it lingers when you close your eyes.

EXPD_POSTER10B.name: Atlantid Poster
EXPD_POSTER10B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER10B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts the ethereal substance that spills from the bodies of corrupted Sentinels as they fall.

EXPD_POSTER10C.name: Construct Poster
EXPD_POSTER10C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER10C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a possible schematic for the mysterious Construct unearthed during the Singularity expedition.

BLD_CRYS_SENT0.name: Living Fragment A
BLD_CRYS_SENT0.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_CRYS_SENT0.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This is a detailed replica of the Living Fragments that litter discordant worlds, the prismatic grains that thrust from the earth in a struggle for freedom from their geological prison.

BLD_CRYS_SENT1.name: Living Fragment B
BLD_CRYS_SENT1.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_CRYS_SENT1.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This is a detailed replica of the Living Fragments that litter discordant worlds, the prismatic grains that thrust from the earth in a struggle for freedom from their geological prison.

BLD_CRYS_DRONE.name: Crystallised Drone
BLD_CRYS_DRONE.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_CRYS_DRONE.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This is a detailed replica of the Living Fragments that litter discordant worlds, the prismatic grains that thrust from the earth in a struggle for freedom from their geological prison.

SPEC_ROCKETHAT.name: Wayfarer's Helm
SPEC_ROCKETHAT.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
SPEC_ROCKETHAT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Despite its aerodynamic appearance and advanced solar design, reliance on helmet-exclusive propulsion is not advised. For maximum safety, ensure all body parts are propelled equally. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_TITLE10.name: Title: 'The Construct'
EXPD_TITLE10.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE10.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Singularity expedition, and the forging of the mysterious Construct. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL10.name: Singularity Decal
EXPD_DECAL10.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL10.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Singularity expedition, and the forging of the mysterious Construct.

EXPD_BANNER10.name: Singularity Banner
EXPD_BANNER10.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER10.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Singularity expedition, and the forging of the mysterious Construct. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

FREI_TRAIL_RED.name: Crimson Freighter Trail
FREI_TRAIL_RED.subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
FREI_TRAIL_RED.description: An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier. A harmonic generation device converts the output of the freighter engines to A T L A S frequencies, radiating a painfully crimson trail. Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

JETS_CORRUPT.name: Discordant Trail
JETS_CORRUPT.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_CORRUPT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. The jetpack exhaust is augmented with an atlantideum filter. When activated, its discordant effect is spilled across the landscape, a trail of dissonant reverberations that echo on an unknowable frequency. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_POSTER11A.name: Navigators Poster
EXPD_POSTER11A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER11A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster celebrates those who plot new routes into the unknown, always pushing at the boundaries of reality.

EXPD_POSTER11B.name: Anomalous Wonder Poster
EXPD_POSTER11B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER11B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts one of the universe's great mysteries, the anomaly of existence itself.

EXPD_POSTER11C.name: Open Horizons Poster
EXPD_POSTER11C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER11C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster celebrates those in search of the next discovery, the next wonder, and the next unknown sky...

EXPD_TITLE11.name: Title: 'The Intrepid'
EXPD_TITLE11.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE11.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Voyagers expedition, and the discoveries made along the way. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL11.name: Voyagers Decal
EXPD_DECAL11.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL11.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Voyagers expedition, and the discoveries made along the way.

EXPD_BANNER11.name: Voyagers Banner
EXPD_BANNER11.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER11.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Voyagers expedition, and the discoveries made along the way. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_ELECTRIC.name: Electric Jetpack Trail
JETS_ELECTRIC.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_ELECTRIC.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Humidifiers discharge a highly salinated mist from the rocket nozzles, conducting a dramatic streak of electricity during Jetpack operation. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_11.name: Construct 'Egg'
EXPD_EGG_11.subtitle: Robotic Spawn Capsule
EXPD_EGG_11.description: A metal 'egg' capsule, ready to deploy! A low hum resonates from deep within the capsule, its dissonant frequency turning the air around it a faint purple. Scans indicate the being within is programmed to be free-spirited and defiant.

EXPD_PETCUST11.name: Mechanical Paw
EXPD_PETCUST11.subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
EXPD_PETCUST11.description: An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This biomechanical remnant is a constant reminder of the many and diverse forms that existence can take. Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

BLD_BUI_HAND.name: Construct Digits
BLD_BUI_HAND.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUI_HAND.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. A partially assembled robotic hand, as seen on mechanical lifeforms across the galaxy. The unit is severly damaged and appears to contain no trace of Autophage entity inhabitation...

BLD_BUI_HEAD.name: Construct 'Skull'
BLD_BUI_HEAD.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUI_HEAD.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. This is a detailed replica of an Autophage facial cage. The unit is inoperable and contains no trace of Autophage entity inhabitation...

BLD_BUI_TENT.name: Ragged Tent
BLD_BUI_TENT.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUI_TENT.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. A makeshift planetary shelter, assembled out of rudimentary and salvaged materials.

S10_PART1A.name: Construct Head: Atlantid
S10_PART1A.subtitle: Unlockable Head
S10_PART1A.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. The circuit cage and primary control sensors for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp, before being infused with Atlantideum. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

S10_PART1B.name: Construct Head: Crimson
S10_PART1B.subtitle: Unlockable Head
S10_PART1B.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. The circuit cage and primary control sensors for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp, before being infused with an Atlas Seed. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

S10_PART2.name: Construct Hands
S10_PART2.subtitle: Autophage Appearance Modification
S10_PART2.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A set of complex hydraulic tubes and various gripping surfaces that form a pair of usable arms for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

S10_PART3.name: Construct Chest
S10_PART3.subtitle: Autophage Appearance Modification
S10_PART3.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. The principal metallic carapace for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

S10_PART4.name: Construct Feet
S10_PART4.subtitle: Autophage Appearance Modification
S10_PART4.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A pair of fleshless feet for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

S10_PART5.name: Construct Legs
S10_PART5.subtitle: Autophage Appearance Modification
S10_PART5.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A bipedal movement platform for a primitive automaton. Plans for a unit of this design were extracted from an autophage left at an abandoned junker's camp. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_SHIP12.name: Starborn Runner
EXPD_SHIP12.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
EXPD_SHIP12.description: A unique and exclusive starship, commemorating completion of the Omega expedition. This unusual starship is optimised for effortless gliding during flight, while a localised vector field allows the craft to hover above solid planes. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

EXPD_ATLASHELM.name: Atlas Headshield
EXPD_ATLASHELM.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
EXPD_ATLASHELM.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A soft but immutable heartbeat resonates through your skull when you wear this helmet. A T L A S. The pulse is strangely soothing. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_ATLASSTAFF.name: Atlas Sceptre
EXPD_ATLASSTAFF.subtitle: Unique Korvax Technology?
EXPD_ATLASSTAFF.description: An exclusive Multi-Tool. This unusual ceremonial staff was hand-forged by a Korvax Priest Entity in tribute to the Atlas. Take this Multi-Tool to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current Multi-Tool. Swap between active Multi-Tools from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

EXPD_ATLASPACK.name: Atlas Flightpack
EXPD_ATLASPACK.subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
EXPD_ATLASPACK.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A lightweight jetpack, welded from stellar alloys around a fiery crimson core. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_POSTER12A.name: Remembrance Poster
EXPD_POSTER12A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER12A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster holds the seeds of what was, what is, what could be.

EXPD_POSTER12B.name: Interface Poster
EXPD_POSTER12B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER12B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts an infinite array of Atlas Interfaces, crimson eyes staring tirelessly into the dark.

EXPD_POSTER12C.name: Starborn Poster
EXPD_POSTER12C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER12C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. The Traveller approaches, delicately piloting their tiny ship through the stars. The Atlas, infinite, waits.

EXPD_TITLE12.name: Title: 'Starborn'
EXPD_TITLE12.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE12.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Omega expedition, and the memories gleaned from within the Atlas. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL12.name: Omega Decal
EXPD_DECAL12.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL12.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Omega expedition, and the memories gleaned from within the Atlas.

EXPD_BANNER12.name: Omega Banner
EXPD_BANNER12.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER12.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Omega expedition, and the memories gleaned from within the Atlas. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_POSTER13A.name: Meditation Poster
EXPD_POSTER13A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER13A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. A poster to contemplate as your mind soars through the empty endless void of space...

EXPD_POSTER13B.name: Alone in the Dark Poster
EXPD_POSTER13B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER13B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster stands a reminder of how impossibly small every Traveller is when compared to the infinite void that surrounds us.

EXPD_POSTER13C.name: Isolation Poster
EXPD_POSTER13C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER13C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster is for those who face the black expanse alone.

BLD_SHIPBREAK1.name: Ruined Starship
BLD_SHIPBREAK1.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_SHIPBREAK1.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The shattered remains of a crashed starship, this shell of a ship has rotted beyond the point of any useful salvage.

BLD_SHIPBREAK2.name: Unsalvageable Wreck
BLD_SHIPBREAK2.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_SHIPBREAK2.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The shattered remains of a crashed starship, this shell of a ship has rotted beyond the point of any useful salvage.

BLD_SHIPBREAK3.name: Broken Vessel
BLD_SHIPBREAK3.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_SHIPBREAK3.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The shattered remains of a crashed starship, this shell of a ship has rotted beyond the point of any useful salvage.

BLD_SHIPBREAK4.name: Damaged Starship
BLD_SHIPBREAK4.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_SHIPBREAK4.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The shattered remains of a crashed starship, this shell of a ship has rotted beyond the point of any useful salvage.

BLD_SHIPBREAK5.name: Starship Remnants
BLD_SHIPBREAK5.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_SHIPBREAK5.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The shattered remains of a crashed starship, this shell of a ship has rotted beyond the point of any useful salvage.

EXPD_SHIPMAT13.name: Stealth Paint
EXPD_SHIPMAT13.subtitle: Starship Customisation Option
EXPD_SHIPMAT13.description: An exclusive starship customisation option, creating a unique low-radar-signature look for Fighter and Hauler class starships. Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

EXPD_SHIP_METAL.name: Iron Panels
EXPD_SHIP_METAL.subtitle: Starship Customisation Option
EXPD_SHIP_METAL.description: An exclusive starship customisation option, creating a unique well-worn appearance for Fighter and Hauler class starships. Acquire starship components by breaking down existing ships at the Starship Outfitting unit aboard any space station. Visit the Starship Fabricator to design and assemble a new vessel.

EXPD_TITLE13.name: Title: 'Drifter'
EXPD_TITLE13.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE13.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating completion of the Adrift expedition, and to finding peace in a lonely universe. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL13.name: Adrift Decal
EXPD_DECAL13.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL13.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates completion of the Adrift expedition, and to finding peace in a lonely universe.

EXPD_BANNER13.name: Adrift Banner
EXPD_BANNER13.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER13.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the Adrift expedition, and to finding peace in a lonely universe. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_13.name: Appalling Egg
EXPD_EGG_13.subtitle: Spawning Sac
EXPD_EGG_13.description: A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch! A shadow writhes beneath the egg's protective membrane. Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be nightmarish and soul-consuming.

EXPD_GHOSTFRIG.name: Ship of the Damned
EXPD_GHOSTFRIG.subtitle: Cursed Frigate
EXPD_GHOSTFRIG.description: The remains of a long-abandoned frigate. Despite its ruined condition, it sails on through the stars... Recruiting this vessel will add it to your frigate fleet. Manage your fleet from a Fleet Command Room aboard your freighter, and consult your Navigator to deploy frigates on lucrative expeditions.

EXPD_SHIP13.name: Iron Vulture
EXPD_SHIP13.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
EXPD_SHIP13.description: A unique and exclusive starship, commemorating completion of the Adrift expedition. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

EXPED_BUG_ARMOR.name: Chitin Exoskeleton
EXPED_BUG_ARMOR.subtitle: Unlockable Armour
EXPED_BUG_ARMOR.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this hardened carapace represents the apex of bio-organic engineering. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPED_BUG_GLOVE.name: Chitin Gauntlets
EXPED_BUG_GLOVE.subtitle: Unlockable Gloves
EXPED_BUG_GLOVE.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, these protective claws represent the apex of bio-organic engineering. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPED_BUG_BOOTS.name: Chitin Spurs
EXPED_BUG_BOOTS.subtitle: Unlockable Boots
EXPED_BUG_BOOTS.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, these feet-replacements represent the apex of bio-organic engineering. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPED_BUG_HAT.name: Chitin Mandibles
EXPED_BUG_HAT.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
EXPED_BUG_HAT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this insectoid helmet represents the apex of bio-organic engineering. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPED_BUG_PACK.name: Chitin Flight Pack
EXPED_BUG_PACK.subtitle: Unlockable Jetpack
EXPED_BUG_PACK.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A fusion of advanced technology and resinous organic secretions, this jetpack replacement represents the apex of bio-organic engineering. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_14.name: Grub Cocoon
EXPD_EGG_14.subtitle: Vile Larval Sac
EXPD_EGG_14.description: A writhing cocoon, the spawning sac of a grub of the vile brood. Scans indicate the being within has anomalous genetic material, an unstable binding of several independent strands.

BLD_BUGHEAD1.name: Monstrous Trophy
BLD_BUGHEAD1.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUGHEAD1.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The mounted head of a colossal insect, this is a trophy from the glorious work of the Liquidators.

BLD_BUGHEAD2.name: Mounted Mandibles
BLD_BUGHEAD2.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUGHEAD2.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The mounted head of a colossal insect, this is a trophy from the glorious work of the Liquidators.

BLD_BUGHEAD3.name: Broodling Trophy
BLD_BUGHEAD3.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUGHEAD3.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The mounted head of a colossal insect, this is a trophy from the glorious work of the Liquidators.

BLD_BUGHEAD4.name: Vile Taxidermy
BLD_BUGHEAD4.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUGHEAD4.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The mounted head of a colossal insect, this is a trophy from the glorious work of the Liquidators.

BLD_BUGHEAD5.name: Prized Exoskeleton
BLD_BUGHEAD5.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_BUGHEAD5.description: An exclusive buildable base ornament. The mounted head of a colossal insect, this is a trophy from the glorious work of the Liquidators.

EXPD_POSTER14A.name: Swarmsong Poster
EXPD_POSTER14A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER14A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster resonates with the busy hum of the hive, a binding music that keeps the brood as one...

EXPD_POSTER14B.name: Brood Mother Poster
EXPD_POSTER14B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER14B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. The vile queen looms from this poster, a warning to all those who would disturb her brood...

EXPD_POSTER14C.name: Bug Hunt Poster
EXPD_POSTER14C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER14C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. An educational poster, useful for all those who seek to identify insects, for good or for ill...

BUGMECH_ARML.name: Liquidator Left Arm
BUGMECH_ARML.subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
BUGMECH_ARML.description: An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments. This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system. It deploys high-velocity stun projectiles, perfect for keeping hostiles in place while advancing to close range.

BUGMECH_ARMR.name: Liquidator Right Arm
BUGMECH_ARMR.subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
BUGMECH_ARMR.description: An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments. This limb override also functions as its own dedicated combat system - a flamethrower for extreme damage at close range. Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

BUGMECH_LEGS.name: Liquidator Legs
BUGMECH_LEGS.subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
BUGMECH_LEGS.description: An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments. Installation will significantly improve the Minotaur's engine and mobility systems.

BUGMECH_HEAD.name: Liquidator Body
BUGMECH_HEAD.subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
BUGMECH_HEAD.description: An upgrade to the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid, the Liquidator is a cutting-edge heavy-duty combat unit, designed to operate in the harshest of environments. Will function as a semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator. The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit.

EXPD_TITLE14.name: Title: 'Broodling'
EXPD_TITLE14.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE14.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating the glorious triumph Liquidators expedition, and the victory over the endless swarm. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_DECAL14.name: Liquidator Decal
EXPD_DECAL14.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_DECAL14.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal commemorates the glorious triumph Liquidators expedition, and the victory over the endless swarm.

EXPD_BANNER14.name: Liquidator Banner
EXPD_BANNER14.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_BANNER14.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair in commemoration of the glorious triumph Liquidators expedition! Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_POSTER15A.name: Gone Fishin' Poster
EXPD_POSTER15A.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER15A.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster celebrates the need to get away from distractions and spend some time on and/or in the water.

EXPD_POSTER15B.name: Sea Chart Poster
EXPD_POSTER15B.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER15B.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. A poster to help sailors navigate treacherous depths and shifting sands...

EXPD_POSTER15C.name: Bounty of the Sea Poster
EXPD_POSTER15C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER15C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. An educational poster, useful for all those who seek to identify the teeming bounty of the ocean.

EXPD_FISH_PACK.name: Aquarius Flight Pack
EXPD_FISH_PACK.subtitle: Unlockable Jetpack
EXPD_FISH_PACK.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this jetpack replacement allows for smooth and stylish passage through the murky abyss. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_S15_ARMOUR.name: Deep-Sea Armour
EXPD_S15_ARMOUR.subtitle: Unlockable Armour
EXPD_S15_ARMOUR.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_S15_HAT.name: Deep-Sea Helmet
EXPD_S15_HAT.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
EXPD_S15_HAT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_S15_BOOTS.name: Deep-Sea Flippers
EXPD_S15_BOOTS.subtitle: Unlockable Boots
EXPD_S15_BOOTS.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Hardened against the extreme conditions found beneath the waves, this diving suit component is the perfect choice for both deep-water exploration and an afternoon's fishing. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_TITLE15.name: Title: 'The Fisher'
EXPD_TITLE15.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
EXPD_TITLE15.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, commemorating the catches, the stories, and the ones that got away while on the Aquarius expedition. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

BOBBLE_OCTO.name: Tentacled Figurine
BOBBLE_OCTO.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_OCTO.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of a sea creature. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

EXPD_SHIP16.name: Boundary Herald
EXPD_SHIP16.subtitle: Exclusive Spacecraft
EXPD_SHIP16.description: An exclusive starship, retrieved while escaping the reality collapse that occurred during the Cursed Expedition. Claim this ship to add it to your collection, or Exchange it with your current ship. While on a planet, summon ships from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

JETS_SQUID.name: Ink-Stained Trail
JETS_SQUID.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_SQUID.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A localised anomaly within the jetpack's core allows the spectral afterglow of the boundary horrors to leak across into this reality. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_S16_HAT.name: Boundary Horror Mandibles
EXPD_S16_HAT.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
EXPD_S16_HAT.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Transform your appearance into that of a Boundary Horror, a fragment of what dwells beyond the tunnels of the portal network... Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

EXPD_EGG_16.name: Glowing Egg
EXPD_EGG_16.subtitle: Bioluminescent Spawning Sac
EXPD_EGG_16.description: A living, fertile egg, ready to hatch! A living fire burns within the egg, the haunting pale glow of a lifeform that must provide its own light. Scans indicate the being within has the genetic potential to be gelatinous and luminescent.

EXPD_POSTER16B.subtitle: Decoration

EXPD_POSTER16C.subtitle: Decoration
EXPD_POSTER16C.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. A poster for those who wish to study the ancient runes etched into the cold grey stone of the portals.
