DECAL_WORM_P1.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This cursed decal depicts the mighty titan worm. "The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky."

DECAL_WORM_P2.name: Worm Hunt II Decal
DECAL_WORM_P2.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_WORM_P2.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This cursed decal depicts the mighty titan worm. "The veins of the Atlas had surfaced."

DECAL_WORM_P3.name: Worm Hunt III Decal
DECAL_WORM_P3.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_WORM_P3.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This cursed decal depicts the mighty titan worm. "The rapture of our consumption is beyond words."

DECAL_WORM_P4.name: Worm Hunt IV Decal
DECAL_WORM_P4.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_WORM_P4.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This cursed decal depicts the mighty titan worm. "We tumble as it swallows, but grip the slick walls as best we can."

DECAL_PEEP.name: Peeping Fauna Decal
DECAL_PEEP.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_PEEP.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal depicts a particularly adorable animal species.

DECAL_BONESOUP.name: Bone Broth Decal
DECAL_BONESOUP.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_BONESOUP.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal depicts a steaming, savoury bowl of bone broth.

DECAL_EXTINCT.name: Extinction Decal
DECAL_EXTINCT.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_EXTINCT.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal is dedicated to all extinct creatures who inhabited the worlds of the universe long ago.

DECAL_SCAN.name: Atomic Decal
DECAL_SCAN.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_SCAN.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal depicts a stylised planet and orbiting moon.

DECAL_BONEJUDGE.name: Bones of Justice Decal
DECAL_BONEJUDGE.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_BONEJUDGE.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal judges the value of one bone against another.

DECAL_RUINMECH.name: Living Stone Decal
DECAL_RUINMECH.subtitle: Decoration
DECAL_RUINMECH.description: An exclusive placeable decal, to add flair and decoration to bases. This decal depicts an ancient guardian of living stone, bound to defend the bones of the fallen.

SPEC_HELMET01.name: Sparse Horizon Helmet
SPEC_HELMET01.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
SPEC_HELMET01.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_HELMET02.name: Blazing Orbit Helmet
SPEC_HELMET02.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
SPEC_HELMET02.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_HELMET03.name: Eye of the Korvax Helmet
SPEC_HELMET03.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
SPEC_HELMET03.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_HELMET05.name: First Spawn Battle Mask
SPEC_HELMET05.subtitle: Unlockable Helmet
SPEC_HELMET05.description: An aggressive Exosuit Appearance Override, modeled on the war helmets of the ancient Gek. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_VYK_ARMOUR.name: Armoured Shoulderpads
SPEC_VYK_ARMOUR.subtitle: Unlockable Armour
SPEC_VYK_ARMOUR.description: Powerful shoulder armour, this Exosuit augmentation comes with high-voltage connections into the user's skeletal system. This current jolts the user's body as required, manipulating the muscles into their optimal defensive posture.

SPEC_VYK_TORSO.name: Armoured Chestpiece
SPEC_VYK_TORSO.subtitle: Unlockable Torso Customisation
SPEC_VYK_TORSO.description: Reinforced yet stylish, this Exosuit chest armour provides excellent abdominal protection without compromising on looks.

SPEC_VYK_GLOVES.name: Armoured ExoGloves
SPEC_VYK_GLOVES.subtitle: Unlockable Gloves
SPEC_VYK_GLOVES.description: Armoured gloves, perfect for wielding weapons, impressing martial cultures, and picking really spiky plants.

SPEC_VYK_LEGS.name: Armoured Leggings
SPEC_VYK_LEGS.subtitle: Unlockable Leg Customisation
SPEC_VYK_LEGS.description: Carefully woven nano-fibres make these leggings both flexible and resistant to small-arms fire. Washing requires specialist equipment.

SPEC_VYK_BOOTS.name: Armoured Boots
SPEC_VYK_BOOTS.subtitle: Unlockable Boots
SPEC_VYK_BOOTS.description: Reinforced foot protection system with integrated tread-balancing gyroscopes. Hundreds of years of high-tech research, as applied to footwear.

SPEC_EXOTIC1.name: Iteration: Ariadne Visage
SPEC_EXOTIC1.subtitle: Anomalous Face Transformation
SPEC_EXOTIC1.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. This part silicone, part biological helmet can detect and replicate the facial muscle movements of the wearer, creating the appearance of a natural head. It is fully compatible with exosuit technology and provides all protection of a traditional helmet. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_SPOOKYHEAD.name: Horrific Flesh-Helmet
SPEC_SPOOKYHEAD.subtitle: Anomalous Face Transformation
SPEC_SPOOKYHEAD.description: Naturally transform your appearance via the application of a flesh-hungry parasite. This living being partially fuses with the brainstem of its host, sealing their symbiosis. Cautiously transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

NEW_BACKPACK.name: Exosuit Backpack
NEW_BACKPACK.subtitle: Exosuit Visual Enhancement
NEW_BACKPACK.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A tough, modular backpack unit. Its styling calls to mind a previous era of exploration. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

BOBBLE_APOLLO.name: Apollo Figurine
BOBBLE_APOLLO.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_APOLLO.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of the Traveller Apollo. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

BOBBLE_ART.name: Artemis Figurine
BOBBLE_ART.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_ART.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of the Traveller Artemis. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

BOBBLE_ATLAS.name: Atlas Figurine
BOBBLE_ATLAS.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_ATLAS.description: A synthetic polymer adornment for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of an Atlas Interface. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

BOBBLE_NADA.name: Nada Figurine
BOBBLE_NADA.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_NADA.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of Priest Entity Nada. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

BOBBLE_NULL.name: -null- Figurine
BOBBLE_NULL.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_NULL.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of the Traveller -null-. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

BOBBLE_POLO.name: Polo Figurine
BOBBLE_POLO.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
BOBBLE_POLO.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of Specialist Polo. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

JETS_RAINBOW.name: Rainbow Jetpack Trail
JETS_RAINBOW.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_RAINBOW.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Precisely calibrated multi-chromatic injectors alter the Jetpack's output, turning the exhaust trail into a vibrant display of colour. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_DARK.name: Antimatter Jetpack Trail
JETS_DARK.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_DARK.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Baryon suppressors alter the Jetpack's output, giving a distinct black tint to its signature trail. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_RED.name: Red Jetpack Trail
JETS_RED.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_RED.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Cadmium injection nozzles add a bold red flair to the Jetpack's output. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_GREEN.name: Green Jetpack Trail
JETS_GREEN.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_GREEN.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Emeril injection nozzles add a rich green flair to the Jetpack's output. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_BLUE.name: Blue Jetpack Trail
JETS_BLUE.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_BLUE.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Indium injection nozzles add a dazzling blue flair to the Jetpack's output. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

SHIP_RAINBOW.name: Chromatic Starship Trail
SHIP_RAINBOW.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_RAINBOW.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Precisely calibrated multi-chromatic injectors alter the Pulse Engine's output, turning the exhaust trail into a vibrant display of colour. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

SHIP_DARK.name: Stealth Starship Trail
SHIP_DARK.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_DARK.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Baryon suppressors alter the Pulse Engine's output, giving a distinct black tint to its signature trail. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

SHIP_RED.name: Cadmium Starship Trail
SHIP_RED.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_RED.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Cadmium injection nozzles add a bold red flair to the Pulse Engine's output. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

SHIP_GREEN.name: Emeril Starship Trail
SHIP_GREEN.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_GREEN.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Emeril injection nozzles add a rich green flair to the Pulse Engine's output. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

SHIP_GOLD.name: Golden Starship Trail
SHIP_GOLD.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
SHIP_GOLD.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Gold injection nozzles add a dazzling gold flair to the Pulse Engine's output. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

BASE_ROBOTOY.name: Robotic Companion
BASE_ROBOTOY.subtitle: Personal Drone Valet
BASE_ROBOTOY.description: A perfectly-programmed and error free drone. This miniature robot will be a lively presence in your base, bringing joy, laughter and a constant low-level humming to your home.

BASE_TOYCUBE.name: Expanding Cube Gadget
BASE_TOYCUBE.subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
BASE_TOYCUBE.description: An exclusive decorative curiosity. This precisely crafted gadget utilises a localised gravitational field, delighting and fascinating base visitors.

BASE_TOYSPHERE.name: Holographic Globe Gadget
BASE_TOYSPHERE.subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
BASE_TOYSPHERE.description: An exclusive decorative curiosity for bases. This gadget emits a spherical hologram, representative of one of the quintillions of celestial bodies populating the galaxies.

BASE_TOYJELLY.name: Wriggling Companion
BASE_TOYJELLY.subtitle: Betentacled Steward
BASE_TOYJELLY.description: The captured essence of an abyssal horror, contained for scientific and decorative use. The bounding forcefield is of the very highest quality. The companion cannot escape. The companion will not escape. Escape.

BASE_TREE01.name: Fruit Tree
BASE_TREE01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TREE01.description: A large decorative fruit tree. Fruit form, toxicity and existence will vary according to local climatic and pollinator conditions.

BASE_TREE02.name: Spindle Tree
BASE_TREE02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TREE02.description: A thin, non-fruiting tree. Root system is integrated with highly-adapted fungal symbiotes. Supplied with its own mushrooms for ease of establishment. Fungus is non-toxic and non-spreading.

BASE_TREE03.name: Evergreen Tree
BASE_TREE03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TREE03.description: A hardy evergreen tree, able to survive in a wide-range of climates. Waxy leaves with a silvery underside provide excellent light harvesting abilities, as well as year-round interest and colour.

BASE_MEDPLANT01.name: Carnivorous Bush
BASE_MEDPLANT01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_MEDPLANT01.description: A medium-sized decorative plant. Each of its leaves is covered in a thin film of sticky latex. Insects that land on these leaves are slowly absorbed by digestive hormones mixed in with the glue. Avoid accidental skin contact.

BASE_MEDPLANT02.name: Dwarf Palm
BASE_MEDPLANT02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_MEDPLANT02.description: A squat, easily-managed form of the larger palm species. Place outdoors to attract wildlife and to purify the air.

BASE_MEDPLANT03.name: Curious Corn
BASE_MEDPLANT03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_MEDPLANT03.description: Sprouting decorative corn. Comes in a variety of colours. May attract decorative wildlife. Unable to reproduce naturally. Must be hand-pollinated.

BASE_AQUARIUM.name: Small Aquarium
BASE_AQUARIUM.subtitle: Aquatic Observation Module
BASE_AQUARIUM.description: A small observatory unit for studying aquatic behaviours. Completely self-contained, with its own renewable energy source, pump array, and self-cleaning filtration systems.

BASE_WPLANT1.name: Curly Coral
BASE_WPLANT1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT1.description: A delicate marine invertebrate, cultivated for potted growth. Its distinctive looping structure gives it an attractive whimsical appearance.

BASE_WPLANT2.name: Aquatic Crystal
BASE_WPLANT2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT2.description: An eye-catching cluster of crystallised oceanic minerals. These crystals grow in a shard-like structure, and feature an unusual marbled colouration.

BASE_WPLANT3.name: Candelabra Bloom
BASE_WPLANT3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT3.description: A striking plant featuring luminescent, orb-shaped flowers. This domestic variety has adapted to absorb and process oxygen from any source, whether growing on land or underwater.

BASE_WPLANT4.name: Armoured Anemone
BASE_WPLANT4.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT4.description: A carnivorous marine organism. An armoured shell encloses the core polyp, exposing only the stinging tentacles. Involuntary nerve spasms cause the creature to writhe perpetually: always seeking, always hungering.

BASE_WPLANT5.name: Strip Coral
BASE_WPLANT5.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT5.description: A giant calcium formation, naturally configured into a strip of non-orientable space. Adds a mysterious deep-sea quality to any habitable base.

BASE_WPLANT6.name: Aquatic Colony
BASE_WPLANT6.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT6.description: A rock formation pulled from the floor of a densely-populated ocean. The attached marine life is lacquered in a nutrient-rich mucus, to keep it fed and moist in terrestrial conditions.

BASE_BARNACLE.name: Barnacle
BASE_BARNACLE.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_BARNACLE.description: A tenacious arthropod, naturally found encrusting stationary or slow-moving underwater objects. This variety can be encouraged to affix itself to a chosen position, adding an aged marine appearance to bases.

SPEC_FIREWORK01.name: Blue Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK01.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK01.description: A luxury firework, rich in magnesium and indium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK02.name: Red Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK02.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK02.description: A luxury firework, rich in magnesium and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK03.name: Green Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK03.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK03.description: A luxury firework, rich in magnesium and emeril. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK04.name: Triple Burst Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK04.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK04.description: A luxury firework, featuring a triple-burst symphony of colour. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK05.name: Dual Chrome Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK05.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK05.description: A luxury firework, exploding into sparkling wedges of indium and cadmium. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK06.name: Wheel of Hirk Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK06.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK06.description: A luxury firework. When activated, this pyrotechnic marvel turns and whorls in a mesmerising spiral. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK07.name: Red Titan Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK07.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK07.description: This exotic firework, tinted with cadmium salts, is inspired by the undulating form of the titanic sandworm. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK08.name: Golden Titan Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK08.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK08.description: This exotic firework, tinted with sodium salts, is inspired by the undulating form of the titanic sandworm. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK09.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK09.description: This exotic firework, tinted with emeril salts, is inspired by the undulating form of the titanic sandworm. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK10.name: Purple Ribbon Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK10.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK10.description: This exotic firework, sparkling with Atlantideum and antimony elements, bursts into a cluster of wildly spiralling ribbons. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK11.name: Blue Ribbon Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK11.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK11.description: This exotic firework, sparkling with indium and antimony elements, bursts into a cluster of wildly spiralling ribbons. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

SPEC_FIREWORK12.name: Teal Ribbon Firework
SPEC_FIREWORK12.subtitle: Consumable Pyrotechnics Device
SPEC_FIREWORK12.description: This exotic firework, sparkling with zinc and antimony elements, bursts into a cluster of wildly spiralling ribbons. Ignite to create glittering displays in the sky. Place launch tube via the Build Menu (BUILD_MENU). Warning: Aim away from living creatures. Not recommended for indoor use.

BASE_TOYCORE.name: Pocket Reality Generator
BASE_TOYCORE.subtitle: Unlockable Decoration
BASE_TOYCORE.description: An exclusive decorative curiosity for bases. A model of reality itself, as viewed from the perspective of an impossible observer. Infinite levels of detail wait to be discovered by the viewer with a powerful enough lens.

BASE_TERRARIUM.name: Terrarium
BASE_TERRARIUM.subtitle: Specialised Creature Enclosure
BASE_TERRARIUM.description: A small observatory unit for studying animal behaviours. Completely self-contained, complete with inbuilt nutrient processor, air purifier and faecal disposal system.

BASE_HOTPLANT01.name: Sail Palm
BASE_HOTPLANT01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT01.description: A large-leafed, heat resistant tree. Its broad fronds are laced with minerals, forming a protective barrier against the harsh sunlight of its native conditions.

BASE_HOTPLANT02.name: Globe Tree
BASE_HOTPLANT02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT02.description: A thin tree with a large, fleshy root system, well adapted to hot climates. Root bulb may be tapped for a source of drinkable liquid, but this is not advised outside of the most dire circumstances.

BASE_HOTPLANT03.name: Rock Garden
BASE_HOTPLANT03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT03.description: A garden module, complete with decorative mineral formation and built-in capillary matting for optimum humidity control.

BASE_RADPLANT01.name: Writhing Bush
BASE_RADPLANT01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_RADPLANT01.description: A native of radioactive worlds, this curiously meaty succulent seems to sway gently even when the air is still... Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_RADPLANT02.name: Umbrella Tree
BASE_RADPLANT02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_RADPLANT02.description: This decorative tree has evolved to cope with high levels of background radiation. Its central glowing core attracts wildlife and is in no way a sense organ. It does not watch you. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_RADPLANT03.name: Entwining Tree
BASE_RADPLANT03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_RADPLANT03.description: This beautiful statement tree thrives in the heat of intense gamma radiation. To ensure survival in non-native environments, a chunk of high-energy material has been embedded in the trunk. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_TOXPLANT01.name: Blistering Mushroom
BASE_TOXPLANT01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TOXPLANT01.description: This swollen protuberance grows rapidly from a fine network of underground spores. Greatly improves nearby soil quality. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_TOXPLANT02.name: Watchful Protrusion
BASE_TOXPLANT02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TOXPLANT02.description: While this plant can be cultivated as a crop, consumption is not advised. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_TOXPLANT03.name: Tentacle Spire
BASE_TOXPLANT03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TOXPLANT03.description: This delightful architectural floral combines two highly popular aesthetics: wriggling tentacles and giant fungi. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUSTPLANT1.name: Bewitching Cactus
BASE_DUSTPLANT1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUSTPLANT1.description: Elegant feathery filaments run around this desert plant, increasing the surface area for moisture absorption. They also look very fetching. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUSTPLANT2.name: Celebratory Cactus
BASE_DUSTPLANT2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUSTPLANT2.description: Delightful succulent baubles, these lovely plants top their bulbous bodies with a show of beautiful flowers. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUSTPLANT3.name: Succulent Tree
BASE_DUSTPLANT3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUSTPLANT3.description: The bark on this tree is misleading. Neither rough nor hard, its flesh is instead soft and moist to the touch. Wrinkles in the surface store extra water for times of hardship. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_COLDPLANT1.name: Hardy Shrub
BASE_COLDPLANT1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_COLDPLANT1.description: This tough conifer pumps its sap with anti-freezing enzymes, allowing it to survive unimaginably low temperatures. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_COLDPLANT2.name: Frozen Planter
BASE_COLDPLANT2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_COLDPLANT2.description: A snow-filled stone trough. This is the perfect home for the small, tough plants that grow on ice-bound worlds. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_COLDPLANT3.name: Ancient Conifer
BASE_COLDPLANT3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_COLDPLANT3.description: This tree lives on an almost geological time scale. Low heat and light levels in their native habitat restrict growth to mere millimeters each season. A sample this size is a botanical marvel. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_ROCK01.name: Marine Rock
BASE_ROCK01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_ROCK01.description: A pleasing mineral formation, crystalised from oceanic salts. May also contain aquatic fossils and/or lifeforms. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_ROCK02.name: Mineral Arch
BASE_ROCK02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_ROCK02.description: A remarkable piece of geological geometry. A stable load-bearing arch, infused with curiously angular solid geodes. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_ROCK03.name: Gem-Encrusted Rock
BASE_ROCK03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_ROCK03.description: Once a discarded byproduct of deep-level crystal mining, the aesthetic value of the rocks is now better appreciated. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SWAMP1.name: Flarecap Toadstool
BASE_SWAMP1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SWAMP1.description: This species of fungus is notable for its dense capillary network and bioluminescent qualities. A circulating chain of chemical reactions produces the toadstool's nocturnal glow. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SWAMP2.name: Wizened Stump
BASE_SWAMP2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SWAMP2.description: This ancient stump was harvested from a clonal tree colony, estimated to have lived for over a hundred millennia. Its bark releases a pleasant mossy fragrance. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SWAMP3.name: Mud Hut
BASE_SWAMP3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SWAMP3.description: This simple mud hut was modelled after a mysterious structure discovered in the mists of planet Saxm A13. Similar structures have been found throughout the universe, with no proven hypothesis regarding their origin. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOUDINI1.name: Chitinous Cage
BASE_HOUDINI1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOUDINI1.description: A proteinous formation of unknown origin, replicated aboard the Space Anomaly. Its skeletal structure often retains pockets of air, leading to slightly warmer or cooler temperatures in the centre of the cage. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOUDINI2.name: Protea Wheel
BASE_HOUDINI2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOUDINI2.description: This unusual lifeform, dominated by a wheel of photophore glands, is difficult to classify neatly into flora or fauna. The thick columns of thorns help protect the flavoursome glands from predators. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOUDINI3.name: Vigilant Taro
BASE_HOUDINI3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOUDINI3.description: The eye-like protrusions on this bizarre organism are capable of both processing light and performing simple calculations, although it is unclear what they are watching for... Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_INFEST1.name: Void Husk
BASE_INFEST1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_INFEST1.description: This eggshell still whispers a faint song, as though connected to a distant chorus... Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_INFEST2.name: Plate Stem
BASE_INFEST2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_INFEST2.description: The broad, plate-like leaf topping this tree is highly efficient for photosynthesis, and wild specimens can grow to extraordinary heights. This domestic variety is cultivated to be suitable to furnish habitations. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_INFEST3.name: Compound Bulb
BASE_INFEST3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_INFEST3.description: This vegetative structure is high in antioxidants, though a thick layer of scales makes it impractical for farming. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_LAVA1.name: Igneous Crystal
BASE_LAVA1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_LAVA1.description: A quiet roar sounds from within this natural crystal formation, lava and gas dancing in a perpetual cycle of heating and solidifying. Mesmerising to the eye, but despite the ultrahot core, only slightly warm to the touch. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_LAVA2.name: Igneous Drop
BASE_LAVA2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_LAVA2.description: This hybrid of egg and rock is known to form around the larvae of certain species, keeping the vulnerable creature warm and protected as it develops over the course of several decades. Membranous splits in the rock's surface expose the ever-shifting molten heart. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_LAVA3.name: Archaic Habitation Heater
BASE_LAVA3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_LAVA3.description: Although primitive in design, this habitation heater is nonetheless a popular home furnishing. Its hypnotic flames and gentle crackling lend a comforting ambience to any room. Provides interior decoration opportunities for bases.

BASE_CAVE1.name: Saucer Fungus
BASE_CAVE1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_CAVE1.description: This fungal growth, identifiable by its wide, smooth cap and luminescent pores, is native to a variety of cave biomes. Saucer Fungi enjoy a symbiotic relationship with many species of burrowing creatures.

BASE_CAVE2.name: Cave Creeper
BASE_CAVE2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_CAVE2.description: A hardy variety of lampenflora. This creeping vine occurs naturally in damp, subterranean environments, but will thrive as a free-standing shrub in any biome type.

BASE_CAVE3.name: Troglotulip
BASE_CAVE3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_CAVE3.description: This attractive glowing flower is remarkable for its scent, reminiscent of freshly tilled soil. Due to the plant's mineral-rich diet, the stamens often contain traces of cobalt.

BASE_CAVE4.name: Veined Flat Caps
BASE_CAVE4.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_CAVE4.description: Clusters of these large mushrooms can be found growing in underground caves. The surface 'veins' form part of an unusual gill structure, releasing spores from both above and below the fungus's cap.

BASE_CAVE5.name: Fingery Deposit
BASE_CAVE5.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_CAVE5.description: This stalagmite was formed by the dripping of cobalt-rich moisture over several millennia. It is eternally cold to the touch, as though the rock recalls the temperature of its home cave.

BASE_NEXUS1.name: Antimatter Observation Orb
BASE_NEXUS1.subtitle: Space Anomaly Replica Part
BASE_NEXUS1.description: This spiked chamber contains a globule of antimatter, creating an unusual display piece for discerning base builders.

BASE_NEXUS2.name: Synthesis Core
BASE_NEXUS2.subtitle: Space Anomaly Replica Part
BASE_NEXUS2.description: A replica of the mysterious orb utilised by Polo's Quicksilver Synthesis Companion. The physical properties of the orb are forever shifting in strangely rhythmic patterns: temperature, radioactivity and density all fluctuating to an unheard song.

BASE_NEXUS3.name: Bubble Vat
BASE_NEXUS3.subtitle: Space Anomaly Replica Part
BASE_NEXUS3.description: A miniaturised replica of the bubbling 'liquid' vat which forms part of the Space Anomaly's anatomy. This mesmerising ornament brings an echo of Polo and Nada's anomalous home to planetary bases.

BASE_BUBPIPE.name: Bubble Duct
BASE_BUBPIPE.subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
BASE_BUBPIPE.description: This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. Intelligently welds into different shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

BASE_BUBPIPE_S.name: Bubble Duct
BASE_BUBPIPE_S.subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
BASE_BUBPIPE_S.description: This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

BASE_BUBPIPE_L.name: L-Shaped Bubble Duct
BASE_BUBPIPE_L.subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
BASE_BUBPIPE_L.description: This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. This L-shaped configuration allows for curves in duct connections. Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

BASE_BUBPIPE_T.name: T-Shaped Bubble Duct
BASE_BUBPIPE_T.subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
BASE_BUBPIPE_T.description: This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. This T-shaped configuration allows for creating branches in duct connections. Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

BASE_BUBPIPE_X.name: X-Shaped Bubble Duct
BASE_BUBPIPE_X.subtitle: Decorative Aqueduct
BASE_BUBPIPE_X.description: This clear glass aqueduct encloses a perpetually churning supply of 'liquid'. This X-shaped configuration allows for connecting four ducts in a cruciform arrangement. Weld together with different duct shapes to create mesmerising displays in your base.

S_SAIL0.name: Full Sail
S_SAIL0.subtitle: Decoration
S_SAIL0.description: This full sail replicates the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and makes for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

S_SAIL1.name: Offset Sails
S_SAIL1.subtitle: Decoration
S_SAIL1.description: These offset sails replicate the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and make for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

S_SAIL2.name: Asymmetrical Sails
S_SAIL2.subtitle: Decoration
S_SAIL2.description: These asymmetrical sails replicate the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and make for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

S_SAIL3.name: Draped Canvas
S_SAIL3.subtitle: Decoration
S_SAIL3.description: This draped canvas half-sail replicates the design of the ancient maritime trade vessels of the Gek, and makes for a striking nautical-themed home decoration.

BUILDCHAIR4.name: Classic Chair
BUILDCHAIR4.subtitle: Furniture
BUILDCHAIR4.description: A sturdy, well-constructed seat, standardised for installation in Space Stations across the galaxies. Its angular design is surprisingly ergonomic.

PLANTPOT4.name: Illuminated Pot
PLANTPOT4.subtitle: Decoration
PLANTPOT4.description: This clay plant pot features a climate neutralising field, nutrient recycling system, and integrated drip tray. Ideal for showcasing decorative plants or other decorations.

BASE_GRASS1.name: Tall Spikegrass
BASE_GRASS1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS1.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. This variety is characterised by very long, thin blades, covered in very fine hairs.

BASE_GRASS2.name: Short Spikegrass
BASE_GRASS2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS2.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. This variety, like its taller cousin, is characterised by long hirsute blades - but grows more densely, with slightly heftier blades.

BASE_GRASS3.name: Flatblade Grass
BASE_GRASS3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS3.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. The wide, flat blades secrete a fragrant, unpleasant-tasting sap to deter predators.

BASE_GRASS4.name: Looping Grass
BASE_GRASS4.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS4.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. This variety features attractively curled blades, which furl and unfurl to allow the plant to maintain a constant internal temperature.

BASE_GRASS5.name: Ribbon Grass
BASE_GRASS5.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS5.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. Closely related to certain varieties of seaweed, ribbon grass can be identified by its long rippling blades and fine hexagonal surface texture.

BASE_GRASS6.name: Cloven Paw Grass
BASE_GRASS6.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS6.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. Cloven paw bears more structural similarity to a shrub than a true grass, and features large glossy leaves for rapid photosynthesis.

BASE_GRASS7.name: Antler Grass
BASE_GRASS7.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_GRASS7.description: A tough ornamental grass, suitable for growing in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. The branching blades of this variety are formed of woody, twig-like armour insulating thick veins of moisture-storing resin.

BASE_FLOWER1.name: Nighttongue Flowers
BASE_FLOWER1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLOWER1.description: A hardy floral patch, genetically modified to thrive in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. Barbed petals protect the flowers from would-be predators, piercing flesh with a deadly toxin. Haz-Mat Gauntlets recommended while handling.

BASE_FLOWER2.name: Urchin Flowers
BASE_FLOWER2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLOWER2.description: A hardy floral patch, genetically modified to thrive in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. These unusually-shaped flowers are packed with pollen, and release a dizzyingly sweet perfume.

BASE_FLOWER3.name: Eternal Eye Flowers
BASE_FLOWER3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLOWER3.description: A hardy floral patch, genetically modified to thrive in all biomes, soil types, and weather conditions. These ligulate blossoms remain open day and night, absorbing light from both local and distant stars.

BLD_COVSILOS.name: Covered Silos
BLD_COVSILOS.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_COVSILOS.description: A set of tarpaulin-draped silo barrels, containing cargo of questionable provenance.

BLD_COVCRATE.name: Covered Crate
BLD_COVCRATE.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_COVCRATE.description: A large crate, sealed and prepared for transportation. The tarpaulin wrapping conceals the precise nature of this cargo, obscuring whether all the export stamps are where they ought to be...

BLD_CRANE.name: Industrial Crane
BLD_CRANE.subtitle: Decoration
BLD_CRANE.description: Heavy machinery, for lifting and relocating heavy cargo. Despite the crane's size, the rotation-resistant hoist rope and AI-corrected swivel allow for extremely precise movements.

S_SIGN_BAR1.name: "Euclid Moonrise" Sign
S_SIGN_BAR1.subtitle: Decoration
S_SIGN_BAR1.description: An attention-grabbing welcome sign, illuminated by an array of gas-discharge tubes. Design salvaged from the "Euclid Moonrise", a Vy'keen joint with an insalubrious reputation.

S_SIGN_BAR2.name: "Ship and Pilot" Sign
S_SIGN_BAR2.subtitle: Decoration
S_SIGN_BAR2.description: An attention-grabbing welcome sign, illuminated by an array of gas-discharge tubes. Design salvaged from the lively Gek saloon known as the "Ship and Pilot".

S_SIGN_BAR3.name: "The Black Hole in the Wall" Sign
S_SIGN_BAR3.subtitle: Decoration
S_SIGN_BAR3.description: An attention-grabbing welcome sign, illuminated by an array of gas-discharge tubes. Design salvaged from an underground Korvax cantina named "The Black Hole in the Wall".

BANNER_CHU.name: Curious Fauna Banner
BANNER_CHU.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
BANNER_CHU.description: Demonstrate your interest in strange and unusual animal life with this exclusive Personal Flair. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

BANNER_BLOB.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
BANNER_BLOB.description: Show off your love of gentle blob-like creatures and their delicious honey with this exclusive Personal Flair. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

BANNER_AF.description: Equip this exclusive Personal Flair to represent the enigmatic organisation known as the Atlas Foundation. Apply this banner to your profile at an Appearance Modifier.

ODD_EGG.name: Void Egg
ODD_EGG.subtitle: Living Curiosity
ODD_EGG.description: An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched. A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

EXPD_ODD_EGG.name: Void Egg
EXPD_ODD_EGG.subtitle: Living Curiosity
EXPD_ODD_EGG.description: An anomalous egg. The shell is tough and leathery, and twitches when touched. A faint tapping can be heard coming from within. From time to time, it appears to sing.

MYSTERY_BEACON.name: Myth Beacon
MYSTERY_BEACON.subtitle: Experimental Summoning Technology
MYSTERY_BEACON.description: The result of Nada's research into unusual patterns detected in the stories of the Gek, Korvax, and Vy'keen. The beacon broadcasts a signal echo attuned to the shift historiographical flux mapped by Nada's Traveller companions. Specialist Polo is unwilling to predict the results of the broadcast.

SPEC_TITLE25.name: Title: 'Exotic'
SPEC_TITLE25.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
SPEC_TITLE25.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, 'Exotic', proudly declaring one's status as an outlier. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_TITLE26.name: Title: 'Volcanic'
SPEC_TITLE26.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
SPEC_TITLE26.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, 'Volcanic', declaring one's taste for fiery explosions both literal and metaphorical. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_TITLE27.name: Title: 'Swamp-Dweller'
SPEC_TITLE27.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
SPEC_TITLE27.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, 'Swamp-Dweller', for those who find joy in places others do not. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_TITLE28.name: Title: 'Sixteenth'
SPEC_TITLE28.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
SPEC_TITLE28.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, 'Sixteenth', for those who know the deepest secrets of the universe. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_TITLE29.name: Title: 'Encoded'
SPEC_TITLE29.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
SPEC_TITLE29.description: An exclusive Explorer Title that will represent your understanding of those who have come before you. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

SPEC_TITLE30.name: Title: 'Photographer'
SPEC_TITLE30.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
SPEC_TITLE30.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, 'Photographer', for those Travellers committed to beautifully documenting their trips through the universe. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

TITLE_SPOOKY1.name: Title: 'Pillar of Light'
TITLE_SPOOKY1.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
TITLE_SPOOKY1.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, for those who brave the dark places of the universe. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

TITLE_SPOOKY2.name: Title: 'The Doomed'
TITLE_SPOOKY2.subtitle: Bespoke Personal Identification
TITLE_SPOOKY2.description: An exclusive Explorer Title, for those who brave the dark places of the universe. Apply this title to your banner at an Appearance Modifier.

SLIME_MED.name: Detoxified Slime
SLIME_MED.subtitle: Placeable Sludge
SLIME_MED.description: Gelatinous and slowly pulsing, this puddle of living slime smells sweeter than would be imagined. Though there is no evidence to suggest it would be unsafe to do so, avoid treading on the slime where possible.

SPOOKY_PLANT.name: Orange Pustule
SPOOKY_PLANT.subtitle: Organic Decoration
SPOOKY_PLANT.description: The flesh of this sinister squash is always warm, and slightly luminous. Despite these strange qualities, it is quite edible, and releases a comforting aroma wherever it grows. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

SPEC_PETCUST1.name: Rounded Laser
SPEC_PETCUST1.subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
SPEC_PETCUST1.description: An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This articulated mining laser is insulated with a lightweight gel, ensuring ultimate comfort for companions assisting with resource harvesting. Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

SPEC_PETCUST2.name: Movement Tracker
SPEC_PETCUST2.subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
SPEC_PETCUST2.description: An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This compact device generates detailed analytics reports of creature traversal habits, to provide explorers with insight into the secret lives of their animal companions. Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

SPEC_PETCUST3.name: Energy Coil
SPEC_PETCUST3.subtitle: Unlockable Companion Accessory
SPEC_PETCUST3.description: An exclusive Companion Appearance Enhancement. This dual-purpose laser responds to the biological vitals of its wearer, providing an adaptive level of warmth and light, as well as soft pulses to soothe anxiety. Earn the trust of wild animals to adopt companions. Interact with companions to customise their appearance.

SPEC_BB_TRACK01.name: ByteBeat Chip: 'Nemesis101'
SPEC_BB_TRACK01.subtitle: Audio Containment Crystal
SPEC_BB_TRACK01.description: A data storage lattice containing a single ByteBeat music track. Track data will be added to the 'Other Tracks' section of the ByteBeat Library. Access the Library from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

SPEC_BB_TRACK02.name: ByteBeat Chip: 'Cosine Will Never Forget You'
SPEC_BB_TRACK02.subtitle: Audio Containment Crystal
SPEC_BB_TRACK02.description: A data storage lattice containing a single ByteBeat music track. Track data will be added to the 'Other Tracks' section of the ByteBeat Library. Access the Library from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

SPEC_BB_TRACK03.name: ByteBeat Chip: 'Sultans of Ping'
SPEC_BB_TRACK03.subtitle: Audio Containment Crystal
SPEC_BB_TRACK03.description: A data storage lattice containing a single ByteBeat music track. Track data will be added to the 'Other Tracks' section of the ByteBeat Library. Access the Library from the Utilities section of the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

S_POSTER12.name: Black & Gold Traveller Poster
S_POSTER12.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER12.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This sumptuous black and gold poster depicts a Traveller in the likeness of Apollo.

S_POSTER14.name: Anomalous Home Poster
S_POSTER14.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER14.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This brightly-coloured poster depicts a wireframe illustration of the Space Anomaly.

S_POSTER16.name: Milk? Poster
S_POSTER16.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER16.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a delicious, creamy glass of warm Proto-Milk.

S_POSTER17.name: Atlas Cake Poster
S_POSTER17.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER17.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a delightfully moist cream cake, emblazoned with the symbol of the Atlas.

S_POSTER18.name: Counterfeit Pass Poster
S_POSTER18.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER18.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a discounted Atlas Pass, as advertised at a disreputable marketplace.

S_POSTER19.name: Friend-Entity Poster
S_POSTER19.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER19.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts Priest Entity Nada's ongoing search for friends and explorers.

S_POSTER20.name: Cosmic Flight Poster
S_POSTER20.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER20.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. A poster celebrating the joy of lifting off in a starship.

S_POSTER21.name: Orbital Poster
S_POSTER21.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER21.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a Space Station looming above a pensive explorer.

S_POSTER22.name: Ship Catalogue Poster
S_POSTER22.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER22.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster catalogues an array of starship silhouettes.

S_POSTER23.name: Departure Poster
S_POSTER23.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER23.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a capital ship disappearing into the endless night.

S_POSTER24.name: Diplomacy Poster
S_POSTER24.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER24.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster represents the Traveller's place amongst the dominant alien species in the universe.

S_POSTER25.name: ByteBeat Poster
S_POSTER25.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER25.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts a ByteBeat Chip containing a lively track of music.

S_POSTER26.name: Voyage Poster
S_POSTER26.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER26.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This soft-toned poster collects some of the landmarks of the Traveller's voyage.

S_POSTER27.name: Atlas Seed Poster
S_POSTER27.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER27.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster depicts an Atlas-like silhouette bursting forth from a planetary crust.

S_POSTER28.name: Utopia Poster
S_POSTER28.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER28.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster captures an idyllic alien landscape under a gold-tinted sky.

S_POSTER29.name: Scrambled Signal Poster
S_POSTER29.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER29.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster represents fragments of many long-distance communication signals between the dominant factions of the universe.

S_POSTER30.name: Ship Parts Poster
S_POSTER30.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER30.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster was donated by honest ship SalesGek Bakkar. Visit their Starship component store today! Best prices for friends!

S_POSTER31.name: Bake Sale Poster
S_POSTER31.subtitle: Decoration
S_POSTER31.description: An exclusive piece of self-adhesive, crease-proof wall art. This poster advertises an assortment of baked goods, including a crusty bread roll and fresh stack of haunted wafers.

FREI_TRAIL_GRE.name: Emeril Freighter Trail
FREI_TRAIL_GRE.subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
FREI_TRAIL_GRE.description: An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier. The extreme heat of the freighter's engines excites this filter of Emeril salts, tinting the exhaust with a vivid green hue. Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

FREI_TRAIL_YEL.name: Golden Freighter Trail
FREI_TRAIL_YEL.subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
FREI_TRAIL_YEL.description: An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier. The extreme heat of the freighter's engines excites this filter of sodium salts, tinting the exhaust with a vivid golden hue. Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

FREI_TRAIL_PUR.name: Antimatter Freighter Trail
FREI_TRAIL_PUR.subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
FREI_TRAIL_PUR.description: An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier. A grid of compact particle accelerators activate with heat from the freighter engines, streaking the exhaust with a dark trail of antimatter. Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

FREI_TRAIL_TUR.name: Hadal Freighter Trail
FREI_TRAIL_TUR.subtitle: Freighter Engine Flare Override
FREI_TRAIL_TUR.description: An exclusive Freighter Engine Flare Modifier. Organically altering the hue of freighter exhaust, this engine modification utilises the bioluminescence of abyssal sea creatures to generate its striking turquoise colouration. Transform the appearance of your freighter at the Upgrade Control Terminal on the bridge.

CAPE_JELLY.name: Tentacled Cape
CAPE_JELLY.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
CAPE_JELLY.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Flow across the galaxy with this cape's lattice of fluttering tentacles, woven from regenerated cellulose fibres. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

CAPE_BIOFRIG.name: Cosmic Megafauna Cape
CAPE_BIOFRIG.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
CAPE_BIOFRIG.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. In the furthest reaches of space swim cosmic megafauna, aligning their paths with Travellers, dreaming of possible realities. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

CAPE_WORM.name: Titan Worm Cape
CAPE_WORM.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
CAPE_WORM.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. "The worm lord towers above the dusty earth; its flesh becomes the sky." Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

CAPE_SEED.name: Geometric Cape
CAPE_SEED.subtitle: Unlockable Cape
CAPE_SEED.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A vintage garment woven from a star silk blend, bearing a classic geometric design. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

HOOD_GEK.name: Spawning Cowl
HOOD_GEK.subtitle: Unlockable Hood
HOOD_GEK.description: This grand hood is worn by the upper ranks of Gek at events and conventions, distinguishing the esteemed Trade Lord from the lowly Hireling. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit with this exclusive Appearance Override at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_FIRE.name: Scorching Jetpack Trail
JETS_FIRE.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_FIRE.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Pressurised jets breathe additional oxygen into the Jetpack flames, brightening and lengthening the exhaust trail. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_CONFETTI.name: Festive Jetpack Trail
JETS_CONFETTI.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_CONFETTI.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. A multi-coloured scattering of bio-plastic flakes adds a celebratory flair to the Jetpack's output. Expelled material is fully compostable. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_FIREWORK.name: Pyrotechnic Jetpack Trail
JETS_FIREWORK.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_FIREWORK.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Pellets of chromatic metal ignite during flight, splitting into glittering stars of RGB. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_PLASMA.name: Plasma Jetpack Trail
JETS_PLASMA.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_PLASMA.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Replaces the standard Jetpack combustion chamber with a plasma engine. During flight, the exhaust nozzles release dazzling clouds of ionised matter. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

JETS_FUSION.name: Fusion Jetpack Trail
JETS_FUSION.subtitle: Jetpack Exhaust Override
JETS_FUSION.description: An exclusive Exosuit Appearance Override. Harnesses natural stellar processes to make the Jetpack output blaze. A light-diffusing compound protects the user and onlookers from retinal damage. Transform the appearance of your Exosuit at an Appearance Modifier.

BASE_FOXGLOVE01.name: Budding Thimblestem
BASE_FOXGLOVE01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FOXGLOVE01.description: A tall ornamental plant, characterised by a proliferation of vividly-coloured flowers. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_FLORAL01.name: Tassel Weed
BASE_FLORAL01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLORAL01.description: A small, attractive plant, native to humid climates. The dewy "tassels" radiate a gentle light, attracting nocturnal pollinators. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_FLORAL02.name: Mature Tassel Lily
BASE_FLORAL02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLORAL02.description: A small, attractive plant, native to humid climates. This petalled variety is in the mature stage of blooming. The dewy "tassels" radiate a gentle light, attracting nocturnal pollinators. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_FLORAL03.name: Spoonleaf
BASE_FLORAL03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLORAL03.description: This elegant flowering plant consists of a single spathe coiled around a perfumed core. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_FLORAL04.name: Tassel Lily
BASE_FLORAL04.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLORAL04.description: A small, attractive plant, native to humid climates. This petalled variety is in the early stage of blooming. The dewy "tassels" radiate a gentle light, attracting nocturnal pollinators. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_PEACOCK01.name: Plumage Palm
BASE_PEACOCK01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_PEACOCK01.description: A tall desert-native tree. The fronds resemble the plumage of a bird, and crown in a vertical formation. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_PEACOCK02.name: Nodding Plumage Palm
BASE_PEACOCK02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_PEACOCK02.description: A tall desert-native tree. The fronds resemble the plumage of a bird, and crown in a drooping formation. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_PEACOCK03.name: Forked Plumage Palm
BASE_PEACOCK03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_PEACOCK03.description: A tall desert-native tree. The fronds resemble the plumage of a bird, and crown in a vertical formation. This specimen has branched into two separate crowns. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SPRIGBUSH.name: Sprig Bush
BASE_SPRIGBUSH.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SPRIGBUSH.description: A compact, many-leafed herb. Lends a pleasant subtle fragrance to gardens. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_FLYINGFERN.name: Floating Tassel Lily
BASE_FLYINGFERN.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_FLYINGFERN.description: Levitating variety of the tassel lily. This oversized specimen absorbs its nutrients from atmospheric moisture. The dewy "tassels" radiate a gentle light, attracting nocturnal pollinators. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT1.name: Closed Seed Cone
BASE_SUBZPLANT1.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT1.description: A large organic structure, housing the seeds of coniferous megaflora. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT2.name: Open Seed Cone
BASE_SUBZPLANT2.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT2.description: A large organic structure, housing the seeds of coniferous megaflora. This specimen has dried out, its scales flexed back to release the seeds inside. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT3.name: Petrified Branches
BASE_SUBZPLANT3.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT3.description: The timber of this ancient tree has mineralised and frozen, forming a superhard, ice-bound sculpture. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT4.name: Coldcup Plant
BASE_SUBZPLANT4.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT4.description: A fleshy, spreading plant with hair-covered foliage, tending to accumulate a covering of snow. The cupped flowers unfold in response to drops in temperature, allowing pollen to be distributed by driving snow and wind. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT5.name: Blizzard's Arch Plant
BASE_SUBZPLANT5.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT5.description: A dimorphic plant with fleshy, hair-covered foliage, tending to accumulate a covering of snow, and more delicate secondary leaves to attract pollinating wildlife. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT6.name: Coldcup Nest Plant
BASE_SUBZPLANT6.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT6.description: A fleshy, compact plant with hair-covered foliage, tending to accumulate a covering of snow. The cupped flowers unfold in response to drops in temperature, allowing pollen to be distributed by driving snow and wind. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT7.name: Flowering Chillwood
BASE_SUBZPLANT7.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT7.description: A hardy, slender-branched tree, native to subzero environs. This specimen is in full bloom. The thickened venation in the foliage protects the plant against extreme cold. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT8.name: Chillwood
BASE_SUBZPLANT8.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT8.description: A hardy, slender-branched tree, native to subzero environs. The thickened venation in the foliage protects the plant against extreme cold. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_SUBZPLANT9.name: Permafrost Tree
BASE_SUBZPLANT9.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_SUBZPLANT9.description: The timber of this ancient tree has mineralised and frozen, forming a superhard, ice-bound sculpture. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_JUNGLE01.name: Rubber Plant Rock
BASE_JUNGLE01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_JUNGLE01.description: This nutrient-rich rock was mined from a dense jungle, and hosts a small colony of of rubber plants. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_JUNGLE02.name: Twisted Jungle Tree
BASE_JUNGLE02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_JUNGLE02.description: A multi-stemmed rainforest tree. Its sap has a gummy consistency, healing any damage to the tree in a matter of minutes. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_JUNGLE03.name: Mangrove Roots
BASE_JUNGLE03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_JUNGLE03.description: An attractive knot of roots, cultivated to maintain its current shape and minimise rampant spread. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_JUNGLE04.name: Perennial Snowstar
BASE_JUNGLE04.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_JUNGLE04.description: The papery petals of this flowering bush can thrive in a range of climates, enduring anything from frozen subsoil to supersaturated humidity. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_WPLANT7.name: Succulent Algae Tower
BASE_WPLANT7.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT7.description: The broad surfaces of these algae leaves rapidly absorb and process huge volumes of salt water, storing the processed liquid as a powerful acid. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_WPLANT8.name: Lantern Kelp
BASE_WPLANT8.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_WPLANT8.description: Fleshy "lanterns" grow along these delicate kelp laces, producing a scent and glow irresistable to many species of aquatic pollinator. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_TOXPLANT04.name: Sporehip Tree
BASE_TOXPLANT04.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_TOXPLANT04.description: This plant is characterised by its spherical floral organs. These cavernous spheres release masses of toxic spores in reflexive response to nearby movement, clinging to the fur of nearby fauna for distribution and propagation. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOTPLANT04.name: Magmatic Eruption
BASE_HOTPLANT04.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT04.description: This sculptural piece is a result of the anomalous geology on some superheated worlds. Molten lava burst forth from beneath the ground and then congealed rapidly, preserving what would otherwise be a moment of ephemeral beauty. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOTPLANT05.name: Magma Shard
BASE_HOTPLANT05.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT05.description: A solid chunk of igneous rock, shaped by thousands of heating and cooling cycles. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOTPLANT06.name: Carnelian Bush
BASE_HOTPLANT06.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT06.description: This sun-loving plant is an unusual hybrid of mineral and vegetation, giving it its dazzlingly beautiful glassy appearance. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOTPLANT07.name: Carbon Vine
BASE_HOTPLANT07.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT07.description: A freestanding vine with a naturally gritty, powder-like texture to its leaves. Smells of bonfire and charcoal. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_HOTPLANT08.name: Ember Frond
BASE_HOTPLANT08.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_HOTPLANT08.description: The huge leathery leaves of the ember frond are both fire- and water-proof. Traces of the leaves have been found at the foot of ancient monoliths across a range of planetary biomes, suggesting they were once used for some ritualistic purpose. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_RADPLANT04.name: Neutronic Boulder
BASE_RADPLANT04.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_RADPLANT04.description: A large chunk of radioactive rock, lifted from the soil of an irradiated world at great expense to the quarry workers. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST01.name: Desert Star
BASE_DUST01.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST01.description: A welcome sight for weary Travellers, this distinctive, attractive tree indicates the presence of fresh water in desert climates. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST02.name: Pipe Cactus
BASE_DUST02.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST02.description: A squat, dense succulent, covered with millions of needle-like thorns. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST03.name: Dust Palm
BASE_DUST03.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST03.description: A miniature palm with two layers of fronds. Microscopic jellyfish-like creatures make their home among the pinnate inner foliage, sheltering from dust storms and consuming parasites. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST04.name: Leopard Tree
BASE_DUST04.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST04.description: A thick-trunked tree with a distinctive rosette-like pattern across its bark. Water is retained in the trunk, the tree swelling to tremendous proportions during wet seasons. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST05.name: Ornamental Tree
BASE_DUST05.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST05.description: An elegant tree, evoking a feeling of peace and balance. Anyone sitting beneath its branches can also enjoy a soft, relaxing fragrance. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST06.name: Porcelain Flower
BASE_DUST06.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST06.description: This plant's delicate waxy flowers retain precious moisture in dry environs, and can withstand the harshest desert sun. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST07.name: Torque Cactus
BASE_DUST07.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST07.description: Each stem of this columnar cactus grows in a subtle corkscrew pattern, forever twisting away from something unseen. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST08.name: Sandstone Rock
BASE_DUST08.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST08.description: A natural chunk of sedimentary rock, its surface unmarred by tool marks. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST09.name: Sandstone Pillar
BASE_DUST09.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST09.description: A natural pillar of sedimentary rock, its surface unmarred by tool marks. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST10.name: Cavern Rock
BASE_DUST10.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST10.description: A series of naturally-formed stalagnates, carefully cut from a cavern entrance to preserve their original texture. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST11.name: Dancer Tree
BASE_DUST11.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST11.description: A domesticated variety of desert tree, prized for the twirling, sculpted quality of its trunk. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST12.name: Feather Palm
BASE_DUST12.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST12.description: This tall-growing palm tree is common in arid climates, and often farmed for its sweet, nutritious sap. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

BASE_DUST13.name: Tine Cactus
BASE_DUST13.subtitle: Organic Decoration
BASE_DUST13.description: A many-stemmed cactus, enthusiastically multiplying and dividing as it grows towards the nearest sun. Provides decorative landscaping opportunities for bases.

U_LASER1.name: Mining Beam Module
U_LASER1.subtitle: Mining Beam Upgrade
U_LASER1.description: A moderate upgrade for the Mining Beam. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process. The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete. Potential upgrades include: power output, heat toleration and fuel efficiency.

U_LASER2.name: Mining Beam Module
U_LASER2.subtitle: Significant Mining Beam Upgrade
U_LASER2.description: A significant upgrade for the Mining Beam. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process. The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete. Potential upgrades include: power output, heat toleration and fuel efficiency.

U_LASER3.name: Mining Beam Module
U_LASER3.subtitle: Powerful Mining Beam Upgrade
U_LASER3.description: An extremely powerful upgrade for the Mining Beam. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process. The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete. Potential upgrades include: power output, heat toleration and fuel efficiency.

U_LASER4.name: Mining Beam Module
U_LASER4.subtitle: Supreme Mining Beam Upgrade
U_LASER4.description: A supremely powerful upgrade for the Mining Beam. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process. The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete. Potential upgrades include: power output, heat toleration and fuel efficiency.

U_LASERX.name: Suspicious Mining Beam Module
U_LASERX.subtitle: Banned Mining Beam Upgrade
U_LASERX.description: A black-market modification for the Mining Beam. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process. The module is flexible, and exact upgrade statistics are unknown until installation is complete. Potential upgrades include: power output, heat toleration and fuel efficiency.
