F_ALL_LEG_S1.name: Singing Sea-Snail
F_ALL_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ALL_LEG_S1.description: "A voice like honey from a mouth of mucus."

F_ALL_LEG_M1.name: Golden Jellyfish
F_ALL_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ALL_LEG_M1.description: "Its tentacles that glitter like wisps of golden hair, but sting with the fire of thousand suns."

F_ALL_LEG_L1.name: Dragonfish
F_ALL_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ALL_LEG_L1.description: "Territorial, ancient, furious to be caught. The king of the sea."

F_ALL_LEG_XL.name: The Lunker
F_ALL_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ALL_LEG_XL.description: "A true titan of the depths. Nothing compares for sheer mass."

F_TOX_LEG_S1.name: Emeril Sunstar
F_TOX_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_TOX_LEG_S1.description: "Its perfect crystalline form glistens with a emerald light that changes the soul of all those whose eyes fall upon it."

F_TOX_LEG_M1.name: Vampire Squid
F_TOX_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_TOX_LEG_M1.description: "A true error of the deep; its hungry bite corrupts your blood, filling your body with a spurting corrosive bile."

F_TOX_LEG_L1.name: Bleached Bonefish
F_TOX_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_TOX_LEG_L1.description: "Robbed of flesh and stripped of colour by acid seas, the bonefish swims on regardless."

F_TOX_LEG_XL.name: Translucent Gulper
F_TOX_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_TOX_LEG_XL.description: "Seemingly weak and fragile at the surface, these giant jaws have swallowed alive many an unwary soul who ventured into their abyssal home..."

F_RAD_LEG_S1.name: Many-Eyed Jellyfish
F_RAD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_RAD_LEG_S1.description: "A thousand eyes erupt from its soft flesh: a never-ending cycle of rising, blinking, sinking, and re-emergence."

F_RAD_LEG_M1.name: Aberrant Duskfin
F_RAD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_RAD_LEG_M1.description: "Its wings beat slowly as it sails though the poisoned seas, a drifter with no place of rest, no end to their journey."

F_RAD_LEG_L1.name: Gamma Squid
F_RAD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_RAD_LEG_L1.description: "A pale blue glow surrounds it as it drifts through the water - a warning to all those who would come too close..."

F_RAD_LEG_XL.name: Helix Sawfish
F_RAD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_RAD_LEG_XL.description: "Polymorphic, twisting, always in motion; its body a constant whirr of shifting forms and ripping teeth."

F_HOT_LEG_S1.name: Starshell Crab
F_HOT_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_HOT_LEG_S1.description: "Its glittering shell is practically unbreakable, a material of pure perfection."

F_HOT_LEG_M1.name: Mirrorscale Skipper
F_HOT_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_HOT_LEG_M1.description: "Impossible to see with mortal eyes as it flashes through the water under boiling, cloudless skies."

F_HOT_LEG_L1.name: Jelly of the Veil
F_HOT_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_HOT_LEG_L1.description: "A dark cloud follows this creature, and dreams of doom await all those who touch it."

F_HOT_LEG_XL.name: Ancient Irontail
F_HOT_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_HOT_LEG_XL.description: "Heart of stone and fins of iron, this creature lives on where all else falters."

F_COLD_LEG_S1.name: Crystal Jelly
F_COLD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_COLD_LEG_S1.description: "A living snowflake: frozen solid yet still alive, its tentacles a fractal recursion."

F_COLD_LEG_M1.name: Ghostfin
F_COLD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_COLD_LEG_M1.description: "A name only spoken in whispers, its pale body a illusion that flickers beneath the moonlit waves."

F_COLD_LEG_L1.name: Iceblood Gulper
F_COLD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_COLD_LEG_L1.description: "A heart that beats but once a hour, a heart that sees faster life spawn and die, spawn and die, spawn and die..."

F_COLD_LEG_XL.name: Nautilia
F_COLD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_COLD_LEG_XL.description: "None would believe the scale of this beast: its colossal shell, its enormous slimy foot. None, except those who have seen it..."

F_LUSH_LEG_S1.name: Glass Angel
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_LUSH_LEG_S1.description: "A creature of dreams, only visible where the light refracts through its soft, perfect jelly."

F_LUSH_LEG_M1.name: Mist Serpent
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_LUSH_LEG_M1.description: "When hunting, can dissolve into a thin dark cloud, impossible to track, impossible to see coming..."

F_LUSH_LEG_L1.name: Reef Guardian
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_LUSH_LEG_L1.description: "A powerful, muscular body and teeth like razors, these gentle giants protect smaller creatures from predators."

F_LUSH_LEG_XL.name: Blind Titancore
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_LUSH_LEG_XL.description: "The old man of the sea; scarred, blinded, still swimming on..."

F_DUST_LEG_S1.name: Fragile Icthyoscale
F_DUST_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DUST_LEG_S1.description: "A delicate creature, a fragment of the past that lives on in the water."

F_DUST_LEG_M1.name: Titanworm Larva
F_DUST_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DUST_LEG_M1.description: "The many-mouths arise from the darkness of the ocean; the many-mouths hunger for their home in the sand..."

F_DUST_LEG_L1.name: Ossified Deinosuchus
F_DUST_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DUST_LEG_L1.description: "A relic of another age, a fusion of life and stone that refuses to die."

F_DUST_LEG_XL.name: Megalodon
F_DUST_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DUST_LEG_XL.description: "The apex of marine predation, a perfect killing machine. Beware."

F_DEEP_LEG_S1.name: Sentient Crab
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DEEP_LEG_S1.description: "Deep feeling swims in those watery eyestalks, the thoughtful intelligence of a true ancient."

F_DEEP_LEG_M1.name: Brain Eel
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DEEP_LEG_M1.description: "It slides beneath the waves; it slides between the ears; it slides within the folds, and swims forever in your dreams."

F_DEEP_LEG_L1.name: The Hunter Below
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DEEP_LEG_L1.description: "Streamlined, deadly, perfect: the terror of the deep."

F_DEEP_LEG_XL.name: Leviathan Spawn
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_DEEP_LEG_XL.description: "So young and fragile, despite its years beneath the waves. And yet thousands more years must pass before it joins the great herd in the stars..."

F_GAS_LEG_S1.name: Mandelbrot Worm
F_GAS_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_GAS_LEG_S1.description: "The geometry of its impossible body folds within itself, a writhing thread of flesh and spacetime."

F_GAS_LEG_M1.name: Mother-of-Quicksilver
F_GAS_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_GAS_LEG_M1.description: "Brilliantly ablaze, its surface a perfect liquid sun..."

F_GAS_LEG_L1.name: Hyper-cockle
F_GAS_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_GAS_LEG_L1.description: "Both alive and not alive; at once a creature, a mineral, and a moment from another time..."

F_GAS_LEG_XL.name: The Maw of Titan
F_GAS_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_GAS_LEG_XL.description: "So few things survive in waters such as these... so that which thrives should strike fear into the heart of any thinking being."

F_ODD_LEG_S1.name: Abyssal Horror Egg
F_ODD_LEG_S1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ODD_LEG_S1.description: "Listen to these words: Do not allow this egg to hatch. Cast it back into the sea."

F_ODD_LEG_M1.name: Atlantidian Crab
F_ODD_LEG_M1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ODD_LEG_M1.description: "Shell and claw of perfect crystal, eyestalks aglow with purple rage; a being displaced from another reality and cast here as crab."

F_ODD_LEG_L1.name: Child of Helios
F_ODD_LEG_L1.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ODD_LEG_L1.description: "Its song resonates across time and space, calling to its home in the endless black above. One day, it will rise and return to its home among the stars."

F_ODD_LEG_XL.name: Many-Mouthed Lunker
F_ODD_LEG_XL.subtitle: Legendary Fish
F_ODD_LEG_XL.description: "On the surface or below the waves, the vessel hungers, the vessel feeds..."

F_TRASH_1.name: Kelp Strand
F_TRASH_1.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
F_TRASH_1.description: A piece of flotsam, wrenched from its years of drifting in the water when it became entangled in a fishing lure. Of little use to anyone.

F_TRASH_8.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
F_TRASH_8.description: A technology upgrade that has been permanently damaged by prolonged exposure to water. Use FE_ALT1 to begin upgrade installation process.

F_BOTTLE.name: Message in a Bottle
F_BOTTLE.subtitle: Collected Flotsam
F_BOTTLE.description: A sealed bottle, found floating in the water. There appears to be a message inside. Use FE_ALT1 to unseal the bottle and read the message within.

F_JELLYCHILD.name: Child of Aquarius
F_JELLYCHILD.subtitle: Precious Spawn
F_JELLYCHILD.description: An impossibly delicate jellyfish. Its tentacles are as fine as strands of hair, its entire being glassy, dancing on the edge of what is possible. A gift from the sea, almost too precious to keep...

F_BOSS_JELLY.name: Spawn of Arcadia
F_BOSS_JELLY.subtitle: Fragile Medusoid
F_BOSS_JELLY.description: A glassy jellyfish, lights pulsing beneath its skin. Its thin tentacles pluck at the air, their vibrations manipulating the space around its body. As it writhes, a faint music drifts from its tendrils, worming its way into your ears. The melody seems to never end, worming its way into your ears, never ending, worming its way into your ears, never ending, never...

BAIT_BASIC.name: Creature Pellets
BAIT_BASIC.subtitle: Compressed Nutrients
BAIT_BASIC.description: Basic creature bait. Can be placed directly or accessed via the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU). This bait will attract creatures and cause them to yield Faecium. Once a creature has been fed, they may be tamed or farmed for their produce. Dropping bait may calm angry creatures.

BAIT_MEAT_1.name: Synthetic Worms
BAIT_MEAT_1.subtitle: Carnivore Bait
BAIT_MEAT_1.description: A specialist bait for carnivores. Use the Analysis Visor to discover the bait preferences of specific creatures. Created in a Nutrient Processor from Mordite and assorted creature flesh. Feeding using the correct bait will allow creatures to be ridden or harvested. It will also calm predators. Chose bait type from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

FOOD_F_S15.name: Haunted Fillet
FOOD_F_S15.subtitle: Edible Product
FOOD_F_S15.description: A piece of seafood, created in the Nutrient Processor. Food such as this can be highly valuable. Can be consumed as it stands or subjected to further processing.

FOOD_R_FOSSIL.name: Softened Marrow
FOOD_R_FOSSIL.subtitle: Edible Product
FOOD_R_FOSSIL.description: A highly refined food product, created in the Nutrient Processor. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets. Food such as this can be highly valuable.

FOOD_STEW_FOSS.name: Bone Broth
FOOD_STEW_FOSS.subtitle: Edible Product
FOOD_STEW_FOSS.description: A highly refined food product, created in the Nutrient Processor. It has both the identifying shapes and aromas of an actual food item, in stark contrast with conventional nutrition paste or pellets. Food such as this can be highly valuable.

FUELPROD3.name: Carbon Crystal
FUELPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Carbon Deposit
FUELPROD3.description: Hyper-compressed carbon, this substance's dense nanostructure makes it highly valuable as both an energy source and a technology component. Synthesised from Condensed Carbon.

LANDPROD3.name: Rare Metal Element
LANDPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Metal Deposit
LANDPROD3.description: A highly-prized metal product, this rare element is used in the manufacture of several advanced technologies. Metal is highly reactive and quickly bonds to exposed skin. User is advised to handle with extreme caution. Synthesised from Magnetised Ferrite.

CAVEPROD3.name: TetraCobalt
CAVEPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Cobalt Deposit
CAVEPROD3.description: A novel molecular form of Cobalt, requiring very high energy levels to create. Natural occurrence is extremely rare. Synthesised from Ionised Cobalt.

WATERPROD3.name: Chloride Lattice
WATERPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Chlorine Deposit
WATERPROD3.description: A tightly-bonded form of Chlorine. Rigidly-packed molecules offer unrivalled conductivity. Not known to form spontaneously: creation requires highly-focused energy inputs. Synthesised from Chlorine.

CATAPROD3.name: Destablised Sodium
CATAPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Sodium Deposit
CATAPROD3.description: Sodium is typically highly stable, but certain configurations retain the reactivity of its component ions. User is advised to wear Hazardous Material Gauntlets before handling. Synthesised from Sodium.

OXYPROD3.name: Superoxide Crystal
OXYPROD3.subtitle: Concentrated Oxygen Deposit
OXYPROD3.description: A para-magnetic form of Oxygen, this rare substance has much to offer in the production of advanced technologies. Requires conversion prior to input into Life Support systems. Direct inhalation is NOT recommended. Synthesised from Oxygen.

OXY_CRAFT.name: Oxygen Filter
OXY_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
OXY_CRAFT.description: A specialist technology component. This small device can rapidly change the gaseous environment within a device, handling conditions from total vacuum to pure oxygen atmospheres.

WATER_CRAFT.name: Salt Refractor
WATER_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
WATER_CRAFT.description: A specialist technology component, vital to the complex internals of modern laser systems. This light-scattering device takes advantage of the unique optical properties of stabilised and polished salt, to both slow and refract passing photons.

CAVE_CRAFT.name: Cobalt Mirror
CAVE_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
CAVE_CRAFT.description: A specialist optical component. Employing a polished cobalt surface, this mirror is able to selectively filter different wavelengths of light, changing its reflective pattern based on nearby magnetic fields.

CATA_CRAFT.name: Sodium Diode
CATA_CRAFT.subtitle: Crafted Technology Component
CATA_CRAFT.description: An advanced circuit component. The refined sodium electrode within its vacuum tube gives this diode specialist surge-protection capabilities.

PRODFUEL1.name: Oxygen Capsule
PRODFUEL1.subtitle: Portable Life Support Power
PRODFUEL1.description: Stablised and secure life support filtration gas. Easily assembled from Oxygen and Ferrite Dust. Offers an efficient method for long-term life support power.

POWERCELL2.name: Advanced Ion Battery
POWERCELL2.subtitle: Portable Energy Storage
POWERCELL2.description: Powerful energy storage unit. Used in a wide variety of defensive and hazard protection systems. Constructed from Ionised Cobalt and Pure Ferrite, and occasionally found in cylindrical metal containers.

PROTECT.name: Hazard Protection
PROTECT.subtitle: Exosuit Environmental Shielding
PROTECT.description: The Exosuit's Hazard Protection system continually monitors and stabilises the user's environment. General reactive protection may be augmented with Environmental Shields, offering increased protection against specific conditions. The device is charged with sodium-based substances. User is advised that a failure to charge the Hazard Protection system may allow their environment to become incompatible with life.

UT_PROTECT.name: Shield Lattice
UT_PROTECT.subtitle: Hazard Protection Upgrade
UT_PROTECT.description: Increases the base capacity of the Hazard Protection system, allowing the user to spend longer in hazardous environments without recharging their Exosuit.

ENERGY.name: Life Support
ENERGY.subtitle: Suit Survival Power Pack
ENERGY.description: The core of the Exosuit, the Life Support System continually filters and pumps breathable Oxygen. In addition to its role in the continued existence of the Exosuit user, the Life Support Unit uses surplus oxygen to generate power for secondary systems, such as the Jetpack, Speed Augmentation and Torch.

UT_ENERGY.name: Oxygen Recycler
UT_ENERGY.subtitle: Life Support Upgrade
UT_ENERGY.description: Increases the base capacity of the Life Support system, allowing the user to go longer between charges.

JET1.name: Jetpack
JET1.subtitle: Aerial Propulsion Booster
JET1.description: Provides the Exosuit with advanced movement capabilities, including temporary flight. Control thrust with JUMP. The flightpack uses energy from the Exosuit Life Support system to pressurise and vent bursts of gas, propelling the user into the air. Jetpack can be temporarily overloaded by gathering Deuterium-rich plants, causing a dramatic increase in available thrust.

UT_JET.name: Neural Stimulator
UT_JET.subtitle: Exosuit Movement Upgrade
UT_JET.description: Increases the capacity of the Exosuit's Jetpack Tanks and Adrenal Pump Reserves, allowing the user to both fly and sprint longer.

UT_JUMP.name: Rocket Boots
UT_JUMP.subtitle: Exosuit Upgrade
UT_JUMP.description: Equips the Exosuit jetpack with advanced jump capabilities, allowing the user to take huge leaps with ease. Activate jump systems by rapidly pressing JUMP.

UT_MIDAIR.name: Airburst Engine
UT_MIDAIR.subtitle: Jetpack Augmentation
UT_MIDAIR.description: A powerful upgrade for the Exosuit Jetpack, allowing limited jetpack recharging while airborne. Highly efficient compressors fitted around the jetpack exhaust take advantage of the windflow generated by persistent falling, recycling some of that energy into jetpack fuel.

UT_HOT.name: Coolant Network
UT_HOT.subtitle: Hazard Protection Unit
UT_HOT.description: User is guarded from extreme heat damage on scorched worlds. Provides relief from intense atmospheric and solar heat through a threaded dermal distribution network of liquid frenium. Device is charged by mineral extracts found in hot environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_COLD.name: Thermic Layer
UT_COLD.subtitle: Hazard Protection Unit
UT_COLD.description: User is guarded from extreme cold damage on frozen worlds. Heat capillaries threaded through a user's suit that evenly distributes liquid calidium to maintain a comfortable body temperature. Device is charged by mineral extracts found in frozen environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_TOX.name: Toxic Suppressor
UT_TOX.subtitle: Hazard Protection Unit
UT_TOX.description: User is protected from toxic damage. Reactive compounds within the Suppressor remove toxic liquids that fall on the user, thereby reducing peril and choking hazards. Device is charged by mineral extracts found in toxic environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_RAD.name: Radiation Deflector
UT_RAD.subtitle: Hazard Protection Unit
UT_RAD.description: User is shielded from radiation damage. Greatly reduces user peril during the exploration of irradiated worlds. Micro-vibrations increase electromagnetic wave reflection, thereby reducing absorption. Device is charged by mineral extracts found in radioactive environments. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

UT_WATER.name: Aeration Membrane
UT_WATER.subtitle: Aquatic Respiration Aid
UT_WATER.description: User is able to swim underwater for extended periods. Absorbs gases dissolved in water through a membrane contactor that, if user is of a conventionally structured species, is placed over the mouth or facial breathing hole. Operates automatically once constructed within user's exosuit inventory.

PRESSURE_SUIT.name: Pressure Membrane
PRESSURE_SUIT.subtitle: Reinforced Barometric Stabiliser
PRESSURE_SUIT.description: Extreme pressure environments - such as deep water - cause elevated stress on the Exosuit's oxygen circulation and general life support systems. Installation of this reinforced pressurisation shell increases efficiency and protection while operating in high-pressure environments.

SUMMON_SUIT.name: Exocraft Summoning Unit
SUMMON_SUIT.subtitle: Vehicle Translocation Device
SUMMON_SUIT.description: A high-powered matter teleportation device, this personal translocator allows any connected Exocraft to be instantly transported to your location, from anywhere in the galaxy. Interfaces with the Exosuit Quick Menu for ease of use.

SUIT_REFINER.name: Personal Refiner
SUIT_REFINER.subtitle: Self-Mounted Advanced Refiner
SUIT_REFINER.description: A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing a small Portable Refiner, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface. Unit requires fuel and is limited to refining one substance at a time.

SUIT_REFINER2.name: Personal Refiner Mk 2
SUIT_REFINER2.subtitle: Self-Mounted Advanced Refiner
SUIT_REFINER2.description: A compact extension to the Exosuit, installing an advanced yet portable Medium Refiner, accessible directly from the user's Exosuit interface. Unit requires fuel and is able to refine more complex recipes than the standard personal refiner unit.

POWERGLOVE.name: Haz-Mat Gauntlet
POWERGLOVE.subtitle: Exosuit Augmentation
POWERGLOVE.description: Upgrades the metallic shielding of the Exosuit's gloves. An advanced blend of reinforced metal and catalytic shielding allows the user to safely handle hazardous substances, as well as perform the necessary feats of strength required to harvest certain farmable flora.

ATLASSUIT.name: Remembrance
ATLASSUIT.subtitle: A relic of another place
ATLASSUIT.description: Everything you ever knew is within.

STARSUIT.name: Star Seed
STARSUIT.subtitle: Priceless Fragment
STARSUIT.description: The smallest of sparks, housed within a containment field of unknown origins. The seed glows with life, desperate to escape and fulfill its potential.

DENYSUIT.name: Mark of the Denier
DENYSUIT.subtitle: Priceless Fragment
DENYSUIT.description: A tiny mote of stardust, no more than a speck. On closer examination, its surface is all crystalline shards and distorted crimson geometry. It flickers with pent-up energy, demanding to be free. Empower the mark as you discover systems, planets and objects across the universe.

OBSOLETE.name: Obsolete Technology
OBSOLETE.subtitle: Old, unusable technology
OBSOLETE.description: A piece of technology, corrupted by interference from the Atlas. Can be recycled for usable components.

UT_WATERJET.name: Efficient Water Jets
UT_WATERJET.subtitle: Jetpack Upgrade Unit
UT_WATERJET.description: Improves the fuel efficiency of the jetpack's marine jets, reducing the drain on Exosuit life support systems. Aqueous compressor units are installed into the jetpack's turbines, bypassing the large energy requirements of underwater ignition.

UT_WATERENERGY.name: Oxygen Rerouter
UT_WATERENERGY.subtitle: Emergency Life Support System
UT_WATERENERGY.description: Upgrades the Aeration Membrane of the Exosuit to harvest oxygen from the Life Support system in the event of a breathing emergency, allowing the user to resurface and seek conventional fuel supplies. Note: Long-term conversion of life support energy to breathable gas is not recommended, and may result in life no longer being supported.

UT_TRANSLATE1.name: Simple Translator
UT_TRANSLATE1.subtitle: Automatic Language Parser
UT_TRANSLATE1.description: An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning. Low memory capacity on this entry-level model limits translation capacity.

UT_TRANSLATE2.name: Superior Translator
UT_TRANSLATE2.subtitle: Automatic Language Parser
UT_TRANSLATE2.description: An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning. Parallel language processors enable a greater proportion of recorded speech to be translated.

UT_TRANSLATE3.name: Advanced Translator
UT_TRANSLATE3.subtitle: Automatic Language Parser
UT_TRANSLATE3.description: An automatic translation device. It records and parses nearby conversations before running the data through a contextual learning system to determine intended meaning. A large memory array and overclocked language processors allow the real-time translation of significant chunks of speech.

STORY_TRANSLATE.name: Artemis' Translator
STORY_TRANSLATE.subtitle: Automatic Language Parser
STORY_TRANSLATE.description: An automatic translation device. Device must be calibrated by pre-loading with existing translation data. Device must have network connection to Artemis to function. Without access to host translation service, on-board circuit allows limited real-time translation of a small number of words.

WORMTECH.name: Visceral Synthesiser
WORMTECH.subtitle: Ethereal Incubator
WORMTECH.description: A piece of otherworldy technology. Its inviting membranes are soft, gel-like, pulsing with a gentle crimson radiance. Its warm embrace allows the user to extricate any Vile Spawn from the embryotic sacs of Hungering Tendrils.

WORMREADER.name: Archive Bypass Implant
WORMREADER.subtitle: Subcutaneous Access Circuit
WORMREADER.description: A biotechnical firewall, developed as a safeguard against textual cognitohazards. It is coated in something slippery, and has started to bubble along the surface. Embedded beneath the skin, this grants administrative access to ancient forbidden texts bound at a Planetary Archive. Warning: Do not unbind the forbidden texts. Exposure to forbidden texts carries extreme risk.

SUIT_ROCKET.name: Trade Rocket
SUIT_ROCKET.subtitle: Mercantile Missile Summoning Device
SUIT_ROCKET.description: A personal rocketry device with a direct link to the Galactic Trade Network. This unit allows the user to load a small spacecraft with goods. Upon launch, the goods will be transported to the nearest trade terminus and automatically sold. Summon the Trade Rocket using the QUICK_MENU.

FISH_SKIFF.name: Exo-Skiff
FISH_SKIFF.subtitle: Deployable Fishing Platform
FISH_SKIFF.description: A deployable static platform, allowing the user to comfortably survey the seas in any weather. As well as providing a steady and easily accessible fishing spot, the Exo-Skiff also features abundant Cold Storage, granting additional space to store your catch. Summon the Exo-Skiff to any suitable body of water using the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU).

FOOD_UNIT.name: Nutrient Ingestor
FOOD_UNIT.subtitle: Automatic Feeding Unit
FOOD_UNIT.description: The nutrient ingestor improves exosuit performance via the automatic portioning and processing of various cooked items. Select Begin Ingestion to commence automatic consumption of supplied ingredients.

SPOOK_PACK.name: Anomaly Suppressor
SPOOK_PACK.subtitle: Automated Breach Integrity Device
SPOOK_PACK.description: As the boundaries of reality begin to weaken, the risk of catastrophic breach anomalies increases. This device monitors and maintains the local boundary strength, guarding against reality continuity errors. Supply the device with glass to maintain functionality.

SHIPJUMP1.name: Pulse Engine
SHIPJUMP1.subtitle: Starship Flight Booster
SHIPJUMP1.description: Spaceflight propulsion, boosts and on-demand Pulse Jumps through local system. User is advised that Tritium is required to charge Pulse Engine. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Locate Tritium with the starship scanner (SCAN). Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

UT_PULSEFUEL.name: Instability Drive
UT_PULSEFUEL.subtitle: Pulse Engine Augmentation
UT_PULSEFUEL.description: A highly-advanced upgrade for the Pulse Engine, vastly increasing fuel efficiency. Tritium supplies are redirected into a cycle of miniature black holes. Resulting micro-gravity fluctuations are harnessed to boost starship propulsion beyond conventional combustion-based approaches.

UT_PULSESPEED.name: Sub-Light Amplifier
UT_PULSESPEED.subtitle: Pulse Engine Augmentation
UT_PULSESPEED.description: A highly-advanced upgrade for the Pulse Engine, vastly increasing interplanetary speed. Naturally occuring frameshift effects within the Pulse Engine are amplified by tritium-based resonators, increasing its maximum sub-light speed.

UT_SHIPDRIFT.name: Flight Assist Override
UT_SHIPDRIFT.subtitle: Advanced Starship Pilot Module
UT_SHIPDRIFT.description: This grey-market electronics module disables critical safety and pilot-assistance modules usually baked into the starship's fly-by-wire control system. Despite its dubious legal status and its implication in a series of high-speed asteroid impacts, this module remains popular with smugglers, mercenaries, and others who think of themselves as advanced pilots. Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the starship to drift during spaceflight.

PHOTONIX_CORE.name: Photonix Core
PHOTONIX_CORE.subtitle: Pulse Engine Companion Unit
PHOTONIX_CORE.description: Provides increased manoeuvrability and longer boosts during spaceflight.

LAUNCHER.name: Launch Thruster
LAUNCHER.subtitle: Vertical Take-off System
LAUNCHER.description: Vital launch and landing gear system. User is advised that specialised, Deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation. Hold THRUST to take off from planet. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

UT_LAUNCHER.name: Efficient Thrusters
UT_LAUNCHER.subtitle: Starship Launch System Upgrade
UT_LAUNCHER.description: Upgrades the starship launch systems, decreasing the fuel cost of takeoff.

UT_LAUNCHCHARGE.name: Launch Auto-Charger
UT_LAUNCHCHARGE.subtitle: Starship Launch System Upgrade
UT_LAUNCHCHARGE.description: Photovoltaic panels fitted to the starship Launch Thrusters allow for a slow trickle charge while the ship is not in operation. Harvested light is used to fuse di-hydrogen from the atmosphere and over time will refuel the Launch Thrusters automatically.

WATER_LANDER.name: Aqua-Jets
WATER_LANDER.subtitle: Aquatic Landing System
WATER_LANDER.description: An advanced upgrade for the starship's landing system, enabling the ship to land and take off from aquatic surfaces. A mixture of bespoke jets and re-directed exhaust fans allow the ship to hover just above the water's surface.

SHIP_TELEPORT.name: Teleport Receiver
SHIP_TELEPORT.subtitle: Ship-Mounted Teleportation Device
SHIP_TELEPORT.description: A device that modulates standard starship communication signals to enable the transport of matter as well as data. Starships fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's exosuit over a long distance.

HYPERDRIVE.name: Hyperdrive
HYPERDRIVE.subtitle: Lightspeed Warp Drive
HYPERDRIVE.description: FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through Galactic Map.

HDRIVEBOOST1.name: Cadmium Drive
HDRIVEBOOST1.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Red Systems
HDRIVEBOOST1.description: Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

HDRIVEBOOST2.name: Emeril Drive
HDRIVEBOOST2.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Green Systems
HDRIVEBOOST2.description: Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

HDRIVEBOOST3.name: Indium Drive
HDRIVEBOOST3.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Blue Systems
HDRIVEBOOST3.description: Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix, preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

HDRIVEBOOST4.name: Atlantid Drive
HDRIVEBOOST4.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Purple Systems
HDRIVEBOOST4.description: Sideloads a resonant memory packet into your warp computer, allowing the ship to pass through the dissonant space surrounding purple stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

UT_QUICKWARP.name: Emergency Warp Unit
UT_QUICKWARP.subtitle: Hyperdrive Augmentation
UT_QUICKWARP.description: A significant upgrade to the Hyperdrive that allows an instantaneous warp even while conventional systems are blocked by starship combat. Access to the emergency warp system is via the Quick Menu. WARNING: Fast scramble systems mean the user is unable to plot a destination. Uncalculated lightspeed events will damage the unit and require frequent repairs.

CARGOSHIELD.name: Cargo Scan Deflector
CARGOSHIELD.subtitle: Anti-Probe Countermeasures
CARGOSHIELD.description: A specially tuned resonance jammer, designed to interfere with the remote cargo scans deployed by system authorities in the search for smuggled goods. Deploy from the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to deflect the probe. Note: jamming is not 100% effective.

SHIPSHIELD.name: Deflector Shield
SHIPSHIELD.subtitle: Spacecraft Hull Protection
SHIPSHIELD.description: Energy shield that protects spacecraft from laser fire, in-flight projectiles and accidental space debris interaction. User is advised that catalytic elements are required to recharge device. Operates automatically once constructed within user's starship inventory.

UT_SHIPSHIELD.name: Ablative Armour
UT_SHIPSHIELD.subtitle: Starship Shield Upgrade
UT_SHIPSHIELD.description: Adds a layer of superheated shielding to the starship's defense array, vaporising incoming fire. Significantly increases starship shield performance.

SHIPROCKETS.name: Rocket Launcher
SHIPROCKETS.subtitle: Long Range Starship Weapon
SHIPROCKETS.description: A long range starship weapon, capable of delivering a highly explosive torpedo across massive distances. Note: explosive damage is highly effective against unshielded targets, but ineffective against shielded targets. Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

UT_ROCKETS.name: Large Rocket Tubes
UT_ROCKETS.subtitle: Starship Rockets Upgrade
UT_ROCKETS.description: Expands the loading chamber of the starship Rocket Launcher, improving exhaust performance and allowing for significantly faster heat recovery.

SHIPGUN1.name: Photon Cannon
SHIPGUN1.subtitle: Starship Projectile Weapon
SHIPGUN1.description: A destructive starship projectile launcher, the weapons system of choice for the interstellar trader and pirate alike. Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

UT_SHIPGUN.name: Nonlinear Optics
UT_SHIPGUN.subtitle: Photon Cannon Upgrade
UT_SHIPGUN.description: Replaces the conventional Photon Cannon optics with an experimental glass array, boosting combat performance. Significantly improves heat sink capacity.

SHIPSCAN_ECON.name: Economy Scanner
SHIPSCAN_ECON.subtitle: Long-range Sensor Technology
SHIPSCAN_ECON.description: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access detailed economic data about a system without having to visit. See collected data automatically on the Galaxy Map. Active the scanner's internal Trade Computer with FE_ALT1 to search for highly-profitable trading surge events.

SHIPSCAN_COMBAT.name: Conflict Scanner
SHIPSCAN_COMBAT.subtitle: Long-range Sensor Technology
SHIPSCAN_COMBAT.description: An upgrade to the starship's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access conflict data in the galaxy map, without having to put themselves in harm's way.

SHIPLAS1.name: Phase Beam
SHIPLAS1.subtitle: Starship Energy Weapon
SHIPLAS1.description: A high-energy beam weapon for ship-to-ship combat. Though vulnerable to overheating, these highly accurate laser weapons can recharge the users's shields by leeching energy from target shield systems. Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

UT_SHIPLAS.name: Fourier De-Limiter
UT_SHIPLAS.subtitle: Phase Beam Upgrade
UT_SHIPLAS.description: Rewires the Phase Beam with nanite-based circuitry, bypassing conventional reality limits on laser power. Significantly improves heat performance.

SHIPSHOTGUN.name: Positron Ejector
SHIPSHOTGUN.subtitle: Close Range Starship Weapon
SHIPSHOTGUN.description: A powerful starship weapon, capable of delivering extreme destruction at close range. Note: these particles show decreased effectiveness against shielded targets. Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

UT_SHIPSHOT.name: Fragment Supercharger
UT_SHIPSHOT.subtitle: Starship Positron Ejector Upgrade
UT_SHIPSHOT.description: Overhauls the firing mechanism of the Positron Ejector, resulting in faster, more accurate particles. Improves range and accuracy.

SHIPMINIGUN.name: Infra-Knife Accelerator
SHIPMINIGUN.subtitle: Rapid Fire Starship Weapon
SHIPMINIGUN.description: A rapid fire starship weapon that launches superheated globes of liquid metal at hostile targets. These projectiles are extremely effective against unshielded starship hulls. Note: the Accelerator's internal components are vulnerable to rapid overheating. Sustained burst fire is not recommended. Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

UT_SHIPMINI.name: Q-Resonator
UT_SHIPMINI.subtitle: Starship Infra-Knife Upgrade
UT_SHIPMINI.description: Upgrades the Infra-Knife Accelerator, compressing internal waveforms to allow an extra shot to be weaved in to the conventional fire patterns.

SHIPPLASMA.name: Cyclotron Ballista
SHIPPLASMA.subtitle: Anti-Electronics Starship Weapon
SHIPPLASMA.description: A powerful ship-to-ship weapon, flinging plasmatic balls of ionising radiation towards the selected target. These projectiles can disable starship engines, leaving the target vulnerable to attack from other weapons. These charged particles are extremely effective against starship shields, and considerably weaker against the metal armour of a ship's hull. Use CYCLEWEAPON to change weapon mode. Press SHIPFIRE to fire.

UT_SHIPBLOB.name: Dyson Pump
UT_SHIPBLOB.subtitle: Starship Cyclotron Upgrade
UT_SHIPBLOB.description: Replaces the heat sink of the Cyclotron Ballista by encompassing the entire unit with a heat-absorbing megastructure. Heat output is recycled to boost combat efficiency. Significantly improves heat performance.

F_HYPERDRIVE.name: Freighter Hyperdrive
F_HYPERDRIVE.subtitle: Lightspeed Warp Drive
F_HYPERDRIVE.description: FTL propulsion drive that allows starship to attain warp speed and jump between neighbouring systems.

F_HDRIVEBOOST1.name: Warp Core Resonator
F_HDRIVEBOOST1.subtitle: Hyperdrive Companion Unit
F_HDRIVEBOOST1.description: An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter. Quantum resonation improves the robustness of the drive during FTL travel, granting the ability to leap to stars previously out of reach.

F_HDRIVEBOOST2.name: Plasmatic Warp Injector
F_HDRIVEBOOST2.subtitle: Hyperdrive Companion Unit
F_HDRIVEBOOST2.description: An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter. Hyperdrive benefits from advanced fusion that brings starship to higher warp speed and intensity. User's craft will become able to leap deeper into space, and into more distant planetary systems.

F_HDRIVEBOOST3.name: Reality De-Threader
F_HDRIVEBOOST3.subtitle: Hyperdrive Companion Unit
F_HDRIVEBOOST3.description: An augmentation for the colossal hyperdrive engine of an interstellar freighter. Uncapped, yet stabilised, fusion systems are threaded into user's hyperdrive. Allows starship to jump ever longer distances in deep space.

F_HACCESS1.name: Amplified Warp Shielding
F_HACCESS1.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Red Systems
F_HACCESS1.description: Upgrades the hyperdrive's core bounding magnets, preventing rapid disassembly when attempting to reach rare-class red stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

F_HACCESS2.name: Chromatic Warp Shielding
F_HACCESS2.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Green Systems
F_HACCESS2.description: Upgrades the hyperdrive's shield integrity, preventing reality glitches when attempting to reach rare-class green stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

F_HACCESS3.name: Temporal Warp Computer
F_HACCESS3.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Blue Systems
F_HACCESS3.description: Upgrades the hyperdrive's computational matrix, preventing temporal anomalies when attempting to reach rare-class blue stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

F_HACCESS4.name: Resonance Matrix
F_HACCESS4.subtitle: Hyperdrive Upgrade: Purple Systems
F_HACCESS4.description: Sideloads a resonant memory packet into your warp computer, allowing the ship to pass through the dissonant space surrounding purple stellar bodies. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems via the Galactic Map.

F_TELEPORT.name: Matter Beam
F_TELEPORT.subtitle: Freighter-Mounted Teleportation Device
F_TELEPORT.description: A device that modulates standard freighter communication signals to enable the interplanetary transport of matter as well as data. Freighters fitted with such a device can send and receive products and substances to a user's Exosuit over a long distance.

F_SCANNER.name: Interstellar Scanner
F_SCANNER.subtitle: Long Range Sensor Technology
F_SCANNER.description: An upgrade to the freighter's galactic-scale sensors. This device allows the user to access detailed economic and conflict data for a system, even without having previously visited.

F_MEGAWARP.name: Singularity Engine
F_MEGAWARP.subtitle: Wormhole Propulsion Drive
F_MEGAWARP.description: An unstable and highly-experimental piece of freighter hyperdrive technology. This extreme gravity device generates a wormhole deep within the freighter's reactor core, inverting the entire vessel and transporting it across the universe. Speak to the freighter's commander to engage the drive. Warning: destination is not controllable.

F_LIFESUPP.name: Atmospheric Control Unit
F_LIFESUPP.subtitle: Freighter Life Support Module
F_LIFESUPP.description: A critical freighter subsystem, vital for maintaining a habitable and safe environment for all on-board organic lifeforms. Capable of generated a limited breathable atmosphere even when damaged or unpowered, but only for a short period of time.

SHIPSLOT_DMG1.name: Hull Fracture
SHIPSLOT_DMG1.subtitle: Damaged Starship Component
SHIPSLOT_DMG1.description: Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

SHIPSLOT_DMG2.subtitle: Damaged Starship Component
SHIPSLOT_DMG2.description: Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

SHIPEASY_DMG2.subtitle: Damaged Starship Component
SHIPEASY_DMG2.description: Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

SHIPEASY_DMG3.name: Hydraulics Damage
SHIPEASY_DMG3.subtitle: Damaged Starship Component
SHIPEASY_DMG3.description: Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

SHIPEASY_DMG4.description: Starship subsystem severely damaged. Slot cannot be used for storage or technology until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Core starship functionality is not affected. Repairing this damage will free slot up for general inventory use.

SHIPJUMP_ALIEN.name: Pulsing Heart
SHIPJUMP_ALIEN.subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
SHIPJUMP_ALIEN.description: A fibrous metallic superstructure binds this warm and vital organ with the core of the ship. Without it, the ship would be nothing, a lifeless husk. Hold PULSEJUMP to ask the heart to initiate a Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to request a speed boost.

LAUNCHER_ALIEN.name: Neural Assembly
LAUNCHER_ALIEN.subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
LAUNCHER_ALIEN.description: An array of distributed neurons, fused to a board of metallic strands. Complex patterns of electrical impulses weave their way across the surface, knotting each ship system together. Hold THRUST to inquire if the ship would like to take off.

WARP_ALIEN.name: Singularity Cortex
WARP_ALIEN.subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
WARP_ALIEN.description: A complex bio-metallic stem plugged directly into an antimatter heart. Registers high activity during interstellar jumps. It appears to delight in the complex calculations required for FTL travel. Access long-distance navigation systems through Galactic Map. Keep the ship happy by regularly jumping between systems.

SHIELD_ALIEN.name: Scream Suppressor
SHIELD_ALIEN.subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
SHIELD_ALIEN.description: This small extension to the ship's automated defense network appears to be its own autonomous organism. A small mouth in the centre of its flesh hungers for Pugneum. During combat, it seems to hijack the neurological array and prevent fear or pain from traumatising the rest of the ship's body.

SHIPGUN_ALIEN.name: Spewing Vents
SHIPGUN_ALIEN.subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
SHIPGUN_ALIEN.description: A mess of sacs and sphincters, these vents generate and expel globules of plasma. When fused to the weapon systems of the ship, these are super-heated and then expelled at high-pressure. Press SHIPFIRE to ask if the ship would direct its vents towards the current target.

SHIPLAS_ALIEN.name: Grafted Eyes
SHIPLAS_ALIEN.subtitle: Fused Organic Technology
SHIPLAS_ALIEN.description: A complex arrangement of membranes and lens, fused atop a high-energy laser array. Incineration awaits those that meet their stare. Press SHIPFIRE request the eyes gaze upon nearby targets.

CARGO_S_ALIEN.name: Neural Shielding
CARGO_S_ALIEN.subtitle: Hostile Probe Deflector
CARGO_S_ALIEN.description: A beautiful living weave of nanotubes, laced through the vessel's neural assembly. This structure can be energised as the ship deems fit, creating a field that blocks hostile cargo probes. Use the Quick Menu (QUICK_MENU) while a scan is in progress to ask that the ship might block the scan.

CHARGER_ALIEN.name: Chloroplast Membrane
CHARGER_ALIEN.subtitle: Sentient Vessel Node
CHARGER_ALIEN.description: An infusion of cyanobacteria fills the membrane, which rests just beneath the ship's translucent dermal layer. The membrane will recharge the Neural Assembly automatically when exposed to sunlight.

SHIPSCAN_ALIEN.name: Wormhole Brain
SHIPSCAN_ALIEN.subtitle: Sentient Vessel Node
SHIPSCAN_ALIEN.description: The wormhole brain permits the ship vision of systems far beyond its own experience. It consists of strands of neural matter, wrapped around a micro-singularity and tethered directly to the ship's visual cortex. Detailed economic and conflict data will become available on the Galaxy Map, should the ship permit it.

WATERLAND_ALIEN.name: Saline Carapace
WATERLAND_ALIEN.subtitle: Sentient Vessel Node
WATERLAND_ALIEN.description: A salty membrane encases the ship, dramatically increasing its natural buoyancy. The carapace will allow the vessel to float, making water landings possible.

TELEPORT_ALIEN.name: Grasping Tendrils
TELEPORT_ALIEN.subtitle: Sentient Vessel Node
TELEPORT_ALIEN.description: Filaments of sinew and neuron warp and weave across the ship, their complex geometry darting between the visible world and some unfathomable dimension beyond. These tendrils reach across time and space, searching out a long-distance link between the vessel and their target's Exosuit inventory.

T_BOBBLE_APOLLO.name: Apollo Figurine
T_BOBBLE_APOLLO.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_APOLLO.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of the Traveller Apollo. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_BOBBLE_ART.name: Artemis Figurine
T_BOBBLE_ART.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_ART.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of the Traveller Artemis. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_BOBBLE_ATLAS.name: Atlas Figurine
T_BOBBLE_ATLAS.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_ATLAS.description: A synthetic polymer adornment for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of an Atlas Interface. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_BOBBLE_NADA.name: Nada Figurine
T_BOBBLE_NADA.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_NADA.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of Priest Entity Nada. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_BOBBLE_NULL.name: -null- Figurine
T_BOBBLE_NULL.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_NULL.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of the Traveller -null-. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_BOBBLE_POLO.name: Polo Figurine
T_BOBBLE_POLO.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_POLO.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of Specialist Polo. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_BOBBLE_OCTO.name: Tentacled Figurine
T_BOBBLE_OCTO.subtitle: Starship Interior Adornment
T_BOBBLE_OCTO.description: A synthetic polymer companion for your starship's cockpit, fashioned in the likeness of a sea creature. Install to an Inventory Slot to decorate your ship's interior.

T_SHIP_RAINBOW.name: Chromatic Starship Trail
T_SHIP_RAINBOW.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_RAINBOW.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Precisely calibrated multi-chromatic injectors alter the Pulse Engine's output, turning the exhaust trail into a vibrant display of colour. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_DARK.name: Stealth Starship Trail
T_SHIP_DARK.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_DARK.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Baryon suppressors alter the Pulse Engine's output, giving a distinct black tint to its signature trail. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_RED.name: Cadmium Starship Trail
T_SHIP_RED.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_RED.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Cadmium injection nozzles add a bold red flair to the Pulse Engine's output. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_GREEN.name: Emeril Starship Trail
T_SHIP_GREEN.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_GREEN.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Emeril injection nozzles add a rich green flair to the Pulse Engine's output. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_GOLD.name: Golden Starship Trail
T_SHIP_GOLD.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_GOLD.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. Gold injection nozzles add a dazzling gold flair to the Pulse Engine's output. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_PIRATE.name: Sputtering Starship Trail
T_SHIP_PIRATE.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_PIRATE.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. A ramshackle ship exhaust nozzle, hand-assembled in an emergency by an outlaw. Has an occasional propensity to explode, but with no adverse effect on flight handling. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_ROGUE.name: Temporal Starship Trail
T_SHIP_ROGUE.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_ROGUE.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. A cosmic resonance chamber interacts with starship exhaust, modifying propulsion energy to leave a streak of temporal disturbances. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_PLASMA.name: Plasma Starship Trail
T_SHIP_PLASMA.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_PLASMA.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. A visual enhancement for the starship, replacing traditional exhaust jets with a plasma thruster and generating a dramatic plume of ionised matter. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

T_SHIP_ATLAS.name: Aeron Starship Trail
T_SHIP_ATLAS.subtitle: Starship Exhaust Override
T_SHIP_ATLAS.description: An exclusive Starship Exhaust Modifier. This engine modification injects the Starship exhaust trail with an arterial streak of crimson. Install this technology in your starship inventory to change the appearance of the engine exhaust trails.

LAUNCHER_SPEC.name: Advanced Launch System
LAUNCHER_SPEC.subtitle: Bespoke Landing Gear
LAUNCHER_SPEC.description: A custom-made launch control system for high-performance starships. Sensitive gyroscopes and specialised control circuits plot custom take-off routines for increased launch speed and efficiency. Specialised, deuterium-derived fuel is required to recharge thruster. Launch procedures require sufficient fuel levels before activation. Hold THRUST to take off from planet. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

SHIPJUMP_SPEC.name: Waveform Engine
SHIPJUMP_SPEC.subtitle: Highly Customised Starship Engine
SHIPJUMP_SPEC.description: A highly-tuned version of the conventional starship Pulse Engine. Wavefront occupancy has been pushed to the limit, creating a pulse experience that is both efficient and highly responsive. User is advised that Tritium is required to charge the drive. Tritium is abundant in near-space asteroid fields. Scan (SHIPSCAN) to search for tritium-rich asteroids. Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

HYPERDRIVE_SPEC.name: Frameshift Catapult
HYPERDRIVE_SPEC.subtitle: Illegally Modified Warp Drive
HYPERDRIVE_SPEC.description: This experimental drive augments conventional hyperdrive technology by distorting local geometry at the point of warp initialisation, boosting range and efficiency far beyond standard drives. User is advised to access Hyperdrive systems through the Galactic Map.

SHIP_LIFESUP.name: Pressurisation Capsule
SHIP_LIFESUP.subtitle: Starship Life Support Unit
SHIP_LIFESUP.description: A critical starship safety feature, vital for extra-orbital flight. The pressuration capsule is a dedicated unit that both ensures a breathable atmosphere and prevents the catastrophic explosion of unconventional cockpit designs.

SOLAR_SAIL.name: Vesper Sail
SOLAR_SAIL.subtitle: Advanced Engine Technology
SOLAR_SAIL.description: A high-performance solar sail, deployed automatically during flight. This advanced propulsion device generates an electric field within the sails themselves, allowing the starship to build momentum from the solar wind. Offers substantial gains in fuel efficiency and boost performance over conventional engine systems, as well as enabling photovoltaic recharge of the starship's launch systems.

LAUNCHER_ROBO.name: Anti-Gravity Well
LAUNCHER_ROBO.subtitle: Aeron Sub-Orbital Engine
LAUNCHER_ROBO.description: Gently detaches the starship from gravitational fields, lifting it toward the stars. The well hungers for pugneum or radiant shards, and must be sufficiently fueled before launch. Hold THRUST to take off from planet. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

SHIPJUMP_ROBO.name: Luminance Engine
SHIPJUMP_ROBO.subtitle: Repurposed Sub-Light Drive
SHIPJUMP_ROBO.description: Aligns the ship's electromagnetic emissions with A T L A S waves, providing basic propulsion and Pulse Jump capability. The sub-light drive hungers for tritium or radiant shards. Hold PULSEJUMP to engage Pulse Jump. Hold BOOST to initiate in-flight speed boost.

HYPERDRIVE_ROBO.name: Crimson Core
HYPERDRIVE_ROBO.subtitle: Interstellar Atlas Propulsion
HYPERDRIVE_ROBO.description: A raw optic organ, red and unblinking. Suspended above the ship's engines, it gazes down tunnels in spacetime, allowing FTL travel between star systems. Direct the core's attention to remote destinations via the Galactic Map.

SHIPSHIELD_ROBO.name: Aeron Shield
SHIPSHIELD_ROBO.subtitle: Radiant Defensive Barrier
SHIPSHIELD_ROBO.description: A defensive crimson cocoon, obfuscating the ship's physical form and providing protection from collision and laser fire. The core self-heals over time, but may be quickly replenished with catalytic elements or radiant shards.

SHIPGUN_ROBO.name: Sentinel Cannon
SHIPGUN_ROBO.subtitle: Sentinel Ship Gun
SHIPGUN_ROBO.description: Sentinel-grade weapons system, engineered for the singular purpose of annihilating rogue ships in violation of system regulations. Press SHIPFIRE to administer lethal force.

LIFESUP_ROBO.name: Pilot Interface
LIFESUP_ROBO.subtitle: Glass / Boundary Terminal
LIFESUP_ROBO.description: This device allows a pilot's brain to interface with the mind of the Sentinel Interceptor, granting the pilot access to ship control systems and external sensors. The enmeshing of the pilot's mind with that of the vessel is necessary to prevent rejection/consumption of the pilot by the ship's vestigial cockpit.

SCANBINOC1.name: Analysis Visor
SCANBINOC1.subtitle: Binocular Tagging Device
SCANBINOC1.description: Specialist Discovery and Survey unit. Augments standard Scanner capabilities by projecting detailed environmental data directly over the user's visor. Allows the identification of distant points of interest. The Visor will generate valuable data when used to study flora, fauna and minerals. Hold AIM to operate. Press ZOOM to zoom.

SCAN1.name: Scanner
SCAN1.subtitle: Topographic Survey
SCAN1.description: A Personal Surface Radar augmentation for the Multi-Tool. The Scanner releases a high-energy pulse that reveals any critical survival resources in the immediate area. Data is transmitted via the Exosuit directly into the user's visual nervous system. Press SCAN to activate a local scan.

UT_SCAN.name: Waveform Recycler
UT_SCAN.subtitle: Multi-Tool Upgrade
UT_SCAN.description: A powerful lateral processor inserted into the Multi-Tool Scanning System allows the device to recharge at a significantly improved rate. Increases potential scan frequency.

UT_SURVEY.name: Survey Device
UT_SURVEY.subtitle: Analysis Visor Upgrade
UT_SURVEY.description: A self-contained circuitry upgrade for the Analysis Visor, adding real-time terrain analysis to the scanning array. Toggle between Visor modes with SURVEYFILTERL/SURVEYFILTERR. Use Surveying Mode to detect hidden terrain resources.

UT_BUI_SCAN.name: Scan Harmoniser
UT_BUI_SCAN.subtitle: Multi-Tool Upgrade
UT_BUI_SCAN.description: An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units. Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities.

UT_BUI_SCAN2.name: Polyphonic Core
UT_BUI_SCAN2.subtitle: Autophage Resonance Key
UT_BUI_SCAN2.description: An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner that allows the device to detect and decode the cloaking signal of nearby Autophage units. Use SCAN to activate the Scanner. As its detector waveform passes over the local area, it will automatically reveal any nearby Autophage entities. In addition, this device can be used to locate Autophage gatherings. Use Locate Autophage Camp (FE_SELECT) to pinpoint a planetary gathering of Autophage.

UT_S10_SCAN.name: Resonance Amplifier
UT_S10_SCAN.subtitle: Echo Seed Detection Device
UT_S10_SCAN.description: An attachment for the Multi-Tool Scanner, designed by Specialist Polo for the detection of atlantideum-infused sentience echoes. On dissonant worlds, use the Analysis Visor (AIM) to locate sentience echoes. On arrival at an echo site, use SCAN to fully reveal nearby anomalies.

TERRAINEDITOR.name: Terrain Manipulator
TERRAINEDITOR.subtitle: Landscape Shaping Tool
TERRAINEDITOR.description: Advanced terraforming device. This module overloads existing multi-tool systems, allowing the user to reshape regions as they wish. Charged with metallic elements.

GROUND_SHIELD.name: Personal Forcefield
GROUND_SHIELD.subtitle: Defensive Shield Technology
GROUND_SHIELD.description: On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to overload the Multi-Tool, distorting the electromagnetic field around the user and creating a powerful personal shield. While this field offers substantial protection against incoming laser fire, the user is advised that the Multi-Tool cannot be used for other functions while powering the shield.

STEALTH.name: Cloaking Device
STEALTH.subtitle: Active Camouflage Unit
STEALTH.description: On activation, this module draws power from Exosuit Life Support systems to manipulate the gravitational field around the user, refracting the light and creating an active camouflage effect. This temporary effect can be used to escape unwanted hostile attention. WARNING: active camouflage will be aborted upon dramatic Exosuit manoeuvres such as jetpack activation, or by activating Multi-Tool weapons systems.

SCOPE.name: Combat Scope
SCOPE.subtitle: Weapon Precision Enhancement
SCOPE.description: A recoil-stabilising weapon scope for precise combat.

LASER.name: Mining Beam
LASER.subtitle: Mineral Extraction Laser
LASER.description: Multi-Tool Mining Beam powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK. Installs focusing optics within the Multi-Tool, allowing it to emit a high-energy beam. The beam is calibrated to excite molecules within common organic or geological objects, allowing it to operate as a highly effective mining device. WARNING: Destruction of flora, fauna or minerals may attract Sentinel attention.

STRONGLASER.name: Advanced Mining Laser
STRONGLASER.subtitle: Mining Beam Companion Unit
STRONGLASER.description: Replaces standard Mining Beam optics with high-grade Living Glass, allowing the beam to be effective against large and/or rare resource deposits. The lens adapts automatically to minute fluctuations in the beam waveform, minimising scatter and increasing device mining potential.

UT_MINER.name: Optical Drill
UT_MINER.subtitle: Material Gain Amplifier
UT_MINER.description: Wafer-thin lens arrays are arranged in a highly calibrated matrix, focusing the Mining Beam on an atomic level. This extra precision allows for highly efficient mining. Elements are extracted more efficiently, increasing the yield from items harvested with the Multi-Tool.

FISHLASER.name: Fishing Rig
FISHLASER.subtitle: Deployable Angling Device
FISHLASER.description: A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions. Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

S15_FISHLASER.name: Lost Angler's Rig
S15_FISHLASER.subtitle: Unique Angling Device
S15_FISHLASER.description: A versatile piece of angling equipment, enabling the user to fish in a variety of water conditions. This rig was once owned by the legendary Lost Angler. Access the fishing rig by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and cast your line into a body of water with ATTACK. With a fish hooked, press and hold ATTACK to haul in your catch.

GRAVITYGUN.name: Gravitino Coil
GRAVITYGUN.subtitle: Industrial Waste Manipulation Device
GRAVITYGUN.description: This remarkable technology transforms the Multi-Tool into a powerful kinetic manipulator, capable of attracting and repelling industrial waste via a localised magnetic field. Access the Gravitino Coil by pressing CYCLEWEAPON, and attract industrial waste with ALTATTACK. Magnetised objects can be launched from the Coil with ATTACK, or gently released with ALTATTACK.

BOLT.name: Boltcaster
BOLT.subtitle: Energy Projectile Weapon
BOLT.description: Generalist weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK. The Boltcaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to supercharge Metallic Elements, firing them as high-velocity projectiles capable of causing extreme damage.

UT_BOLT.name: Barrel Ioniser
UT_BOLT.subtitle: Boltcaster Upgrade
UT_BOLT.description: Inserts a powerful field ionisation device into the barrel of the Boltcaster, increasing projectile stability through the air. Improves device accuracy and allows the user to fire for longer periods without degrading combat performance.

UT_BOLTBOUNCE.name: Boltcaster Ricochet Module
UT_BOLTBOUNCE.subtitle: Boltcaster Upgrade
UT_BOLTBOUNCE.description: Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the Boltcaster, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces. Enables ricochet, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.

BOLT_SM.name: Boltcaster SM
BOLT_SM.subtitle: Boltcaster Companion Unit
BOLT_SM.description: Boltcaster shots deliver added physical damage upon impact. Grants additional kinetic energy to the user's ionised plasma distribution systems. Operates automatically once constructed within user's Multi-Tool inventory.

LASER_XO.name: Plasma Resonator
LASER_XO.subtitle: Mining Beam Upgrade
LASER_XO.description: A significant upgrade for the Mining Beam. Upgrades the Mining Laser's primary crystal chamber, boosting core beam energy while decreasing unwanted heat spill.

GRENADE.name: Plasma Launcher
GRENADE.subtitle: Explosive Grenades
GRENADE.description: High-impact projectile weapon. Launched plasma shells bounce off surfaces until their internal timer triggers a large explosion. Charged with Unstable Plasma. Careless use can result in damage to user. Press ALTATTACK to activate.

TERRAIN_GREN.name: Geology Cannon
TERRAIN_GREN.subtitle: Terrain Destruction Device
TERRAIN_GREN.description: Large-bore projectile launcher. Propels plasma shells designed for rapid ground excavation. Charged with Unstable Plasma. Warning: Explosive hole creation may also damage nearby organic matter. Press ALTATTACK to activate.

STUN_GREN.name: Paralysis Mortar
STUN_GREN.subtitle: Stun Grenades
STUN_GREN.description: Non-violent projectile weapon. Launched projectiles will incapacitate nearby targets with a burst of electrical energy. Effective against both biological and electronic entities. Charged with Unstable Plasma. Press ALTATTACK to activate.

RAILGUN.name: Blaze Javelin
RAILGUN.subtitle: Energy Beam Weapon
RAILGUN.description: Aggressive weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK. The Blaze Javelin delivers instantaneous damage on targets. Plasma charge process creates an ionised gas arc to propel projectiles at great speed. User will perceive destructive results simultaneous to the pull of the trigger.

UT_RAIL.name: Mass Accelerator
UT_RAIL.subtitle: Blaze Javelin Upgrade
UT_RAIL.description: Extends the firing chamber of the Blaze Javelin, allowing the internal particle accelerators to reach both greater mass and speed. Significantly improves weapon damage.

UT_RAIL_STUN.name: Waveform Oscillator
UT_RAIL_STUN.subtitle: Blaze Javelin Upgrade
UT_RAIL_STUN.description: Overloads the energy beam generated by the Blaze Javelin, causing it to deliver a power electrical charge at its point of impact. Will briefly stun any organic and inorganic entities that intersect the Blaze Javelin's beam.

SHOTGUN.name: Scatter Blaster
SHOTGUN.subtitle: Scatter Shot Projectile Weapon
SHOTGUN.description: Specialist close combat weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK. The Scatter Blaster reconfigures the Multi-Tool to heat and shatter Metallic Elements, firing them in a wide cone of destruction. Range is limited, but the shrapnel is highly effective at close range.

UT_SHOT.name: Shell Greaser
UT_SHOT.subtitle: Scatter Blaster Upgrade
UT_SHOT.description: Advanced self-lubricating components decrease friction within the Scatter Blaster, offering significant improvements to reload times.

SMG.name: Pulse Spitter
SMG.subtitle: Rapid Fire Projectile Weapon
SMG.description: Specialist rapid fire weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK. The Pulse Spitter redirects Multi-Tool optics to ionise inserted Metallic Elements. These projectiles are launched in a rapid-fire spread, bombarding potential targets with a wave of high-energy plasma.

UT_SMG.name: Amplified Cartridges
UT_SMG.subtitle: Pulse Spitter Upgrade
UT_SMG.description: Specialist harmonic resonators allow the Pulse Spitter to split inserted ammunition, effective manufacturing more shots from fewer materials. Increases weapon clip size.

UT_SMGBOUNCE.name: Pulse Spitter Ricochet Module
UT_SMGBOUNCE.subtitle: Pulse Spitter Upgrade
UT_SMGBOUNCE.description: Creates an antimatter field around the shots of the Pulse Spitter, causing them to be repelled by non-damaged surfaces. Enables ricochet, causing projectiles to bounce if they hit a target they do not damage.

UT_SMG_DOT.name: Impact Igniter
UT_SMG_DOT.subtitle: Pulse Spitter Upgrade
UT_SMG_DOT.description: A powerful combat upgrade for the Pulse Spitter. This module installs series of delicately calibrated fuel-injection nozzles within the firing chamber, which are used to initiate a controlled burn within its plasma projectiles. Causes targets hit by the Pulse Spitter to burn for a short while, causing additional damage.

FLAME.name: Incinerator
FLAME.subtitle: Short-Range Fire Delivery Unit
FLAME.description: Specialist high temperature weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON and fire weapon with ATTACK. The Incinerator focuses internal lasers onto the naturally-occuring exhaust gases generated by the Multi-Tool. Ignition results in a highly destructive, if short range, inferno.

CANNON.name: Neutron Cannon
CANNON.subtitle: Explosive Energy Weapon
CANNON.description: A high-energy weapon attachment for the Multi-Tool. The Neutron Cannon energises atmospheric particles before propelling them towards hostile targets, delivering significant area damage Access fire mode by pressing CYCLEWEAPON. Charge the weapon with ATTACK, then release to unleash a volley of ionised particles. While the cannon can deliver instantaneous single shots, longer charges will result in significant increases to the speed and volume of released particles.

UT_CANNON.name: P-Field Compressor
UT_CANNON.subtitle: Neutron Cannon Upgrade
UT_CANNON.description: A powerful upgrade to the Neutron Cannon. Additional resonance compressors allow significantly more energy to be routed through the cannon's central core, dramatically increasing operating power. Installation will allow a fully-charged Neutron Cannon to launch additional projectiles at higher speeds.

UT_STUNDMG.name: Voltaic Amplifier
UT_STUNDMG.subtitle: Damage Overload Module
UT_STUNDMG.description: A generalised upgrade for all Multi-Tool weapon systems, causing its projectiles to resonate dramatically upon impact with any appropriate electromagnetic field. Will significantly increase the damage dealt to any organic and inorganic entities that are currently stunned.

WEAPSLOT_DMG1.name: Short Circuit
WEAPSLOT_DMG1.subtitle: Damaged Multi-Tool Component
WEAPSLOT_DMG1.description: Multi-Tool subsystem critically damaged. Slot cannot be used until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Repairing will free slot up for general use.

WEAPSLOT_DMG2.subtitle: Damaged Multi-Tool Component
WEAPSLOT_DMG2.description: Multi-Tool subsystem critically damaged. Slot cannot be used until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Repairing will free slot up for general use.

WEAPSENT_DMG1.name: Sentience Resistor
WEAPSENT_DMG1.subtitle: Incomplete Sentinel Salvage
WEAPSENT_DMG1.description: This Multi-Tool is a piece of hybrid technology, a fusion of crude scrap and a deep, powerful energy - part salvage, part Sentinel, part something undefinable... This process of recycled fusion was incomplete when this tool was acquired. Use REPAIR to continue repair operations and free this slot for general use.

WEAPSENT_DMG2.subtitle: Incomplete Sentinel Salvage
WEAPSENT_DMG2.description: This Multi-Tool is a piece of hybrid technology, a fusion of crude scrap and a deep, powerful energy - part salvage, part Sentinel, part something undefinable...
