WEAPEASY_DMG4.description: Multi-Tool subsystem critically damaged. Slot cannot be used until damage is repaired. Use REPAIR to begin repair process. Repairing will free slot up for general use.

SUN_LASER.name: Solar Ray
SUN_LASER.subtitle: Alchemical Laser
SUN_LASER.description: A highly specialised addition to the Multi-Tool's mining capabilities, transforming terrain deposits into liquid sun. A powerful laser array amplifies local solar radiation, allowing for the rapid reconfiguration of nearby mineral ores.

SOUL_LASER.name: Animus Beam
SOUL_LASER.subtitle: Soul Extractor
SOUL_LASER.description: A unique overload to the Multi-Tool's standard mining laser. Beam frequency is modulated precisely in a feedback loop with the delta-waves generated by the impact target. Recordings of the target's experiences are thus etched into tiny fragments of metal and rendered as Fragmented Qualia. Readability of collected fragments is not guaranteed.

SENT_LASER.name: Hijacked Laser
SENT_LASER.subtitle: Repurposed High-Energy Beam
SENT_LASER.description: This Multi-Tool is made with material and methods known to no conventional manufacturer, its core a unfathomable array of impossible optics and glassy foam. Nonetheless, there is a layer of recogniseable technology. It shows signs of having been tampered with by an unknown craftsman, who has repurposed its scanner array into a high-powered mining laser. Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK.

ATLAS_LASER.name: Runic Lens
ATLAS_LASER.subtitle: Geometric Anomaly
ATLAS_LASER.description: The geometric heart of this ancient weapon is the Runic Lens. Its impossible geometry not only concentrates light into a high-powered Mining Laser, but can also warp the local electromagnetic field so as to render the user invisible. Powered by Carbon-based Elements. Fire the beam with ATTACK. Select its secondary cloaking function with CYCLEALTWEAPON and hold ALTATTACK to activate.

VEHICLE_ENGINE.name: Fusion Engine
VEHICLE_ENGINE.subtitle: Exocraft Power System
VEHICLE_ENGINE.description: A compact fusion core common to all Exocraft. Requires fuel to function.

VEHICLE_GRIP1.name: Drift Suspension
VEHICLE_GRIP1.subtitle: Exocraft Handling Modification
VEHICLE_GRIP1.description: Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components. Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to drift.

VEHICLE_GRIP2.name: Grip Boost Suspension
VEHICLE_GRIP2.subtitle: Exocraft Handling Modification
VEHICLE_GRIP2.description: Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components. Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to turn sharply.

VEHICLE_GRIP3.name: Hi-Slide Suspension
VEHICLE_GRIP3.subtitle: Exocraft Handling Modification
VEHICLE_GRIP3.description: Overhauls Exocraft handling values through a combination of software tweaks, pressure adjustments and the insertion of microgravity wells into key suspension components. Specifically tuned to increase the ability of the Exocraft to slide.

EXO_PROT_HOT.name: Thermal Buffer
EXO_PROT_HOT.subtitle: Exocraft Hazard Protection Unit
EXO_PROT_HOT.description: Sublimation cooling vents and high-thermal mass buffers are installed in all structural panels, keeping the Exocraft pilot at non-lethal temperatures even in the most overwhelming of firestorms. Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in scorched environments.

EXO_PROT_COLD.name: Megawatt Heater
EXO_PROT_COLD.subtitle: Exocraft Hazard Protection Unit
EXO_PROT_COLD.description: Installs a powerful heater into the Exocraft, keeping the cabin a habitable temperature even in the most freezing of conditions. Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in freezing environments.

EXO_PROT_TOX.name: Air Filtration Unit
EXO_PROT_TOX.subtitle: Exocraft Hazard Protection Unit
EXO_PROT_TOX.description: Double-vacuumed air filtration systems allow no trace of the planetary atmosphere into the Exocraft cabin without being thoroughly scrubbed. Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in toxic environments.

EXO_PROT_RAD.name: Neutron Shielding
EXO_PROT_RAD.subtitle: Exocraft Hazard Protection Unit
EXO_PROT_RAD.description: Highly-efficient control materials are inserted into the frame of the Exocraft, neutralising dangerous incoming energy waves. Entirely prevents all damage or energy drain while inside an Exocraft in radioactive environments.

EXO_RECHARGE.name: Icarus Fuel System
EXO_RECHARGE.subtitle: Solar Recharge Unit
EXO_RECHARGE.description: The Icarus system takes advantage of existing metal panelling, upgrading them into photovoltaic surfaces. This reactive coating generates energy during daylight hours, offsetting fuel consumption. Enables automatic engine recharging during the day.

EXO_REFINER.name: Mineral Processing Rig
EXO_REFINER.subtitle: Vehicle-Borne Refiner
EXO_REFINER.description: A large and powerful refiner unit, designed to be housed within the belly of a Colossus Exocraft. The unit is able to process the most complex recipes, but requires its own independent fuel source.

EXO_PLOUGH.name: Excavation Blade
EXO_PLOUGH.subtitle: Exocraft Demolition Attachment
EXO_PLOUGH.description: A obstacle demolition attachment for a terrestrial vehicle, compatible with the Colossus large Exocraft. The Excavation Blade allows the Colossus to collect a small number of resources from minerals and vegetation upon collision, and reduces grime and scratches to the Exocraft's paintwork.

VEHICLE_SCAN.name: Exocraft Radar
VEHICLE_SCAN.subtitle: Exocraft Scan Equipment
VEHICLE_SCAN.description: A large and complex field-based subspace radar. Due to their large power consumption and inherent subatomic instability, they are found only installed on Exocraft. Press QUICK_MENU to activate the Signal Booster.

VEHICLE_SCAN1.name: Radar Amplifier
VEHICLE_SCAN1.subtitle: Exocraft Signal Detection Upgrade
VEHICLE_SCAN1.description: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.

VEHICLE_SCAN2.name: Radar Power Resonator
VEHICLE_SCAN2.subtitle: Exocraft Signal Detection Upgrade
VEHICLE_SCAN2.description: Allows for additional building types to be acquired by the Exocraft Radar.

VEHICLE_SCOPE.name: Cyclops Scope
VEHICLE_SCOPE.subtitle: Exocraft Survey Device
VEHICLE_SCOPE.description: An enhancement to the Exocraft's navigational capabilities, attaching to the driver's visor display. Analyses surroundings and projects detailed data over the environment, identifying points of interest and generating valuable data when used to study flora, fauna and minerals. Hold AIM to operate.

VEHICLE_BOOST.name: Exocraft Boosters
VEHICLE_BOOST.subtitle: Exocraft Engine Upgrade
VEHICLE_BOOST.description: An efficient plasma injector coupled to the engine that allows short bursts of speed.

VEHICLE_LASER.name: Exocraft Mining Laser
VEHICLE_LASER.subtitle: Exocraft Mining Attachment
VEHICLE_LASER.description: A mining laser too cumbersome for handheld operation, they are found only installed on Exocraft.

VEHICLE_LASER1.name: Advanced Exocraft Laser
VEHICLE_LASER1.subtitle: Exocraft Mining Upgrade
VEHICLE_LASER1.description: Increases power of the Exocraft Mining Laser.

VEHICLE_GUN.name: Mounted Cannon
VEHICLE_GUN.subtitle: Exocraft Weapon Attachment
VEHICLE_GUN.description: Due to the energy requirements of this powerful weapon, they can only be fired from an Exocraft mount.

VEHICLE_FLAME.name: Mounted Flamethrower
VEHICLE_FLAME.subtitle: Exocraft Ignition Weapon
VEHICLE_FLAME.description: A mounted flamethrower specifically designed for the Exocraft. Causes extreme damage at close range. Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

SUB_ENGINE.name: Humboldt Drive
SUB_ENGINE.subtitle: Exocraft Power System
SUB_ENGINE.description: A thermally-efficient, inversion-proof reactor engine capable of powering the Nautilon even at extreme depths. Powered by Hydrothermal Fuel Cells.

SUB_GUN.name: Nautilon Cannon
SUB_GUN.subtitle: Submarine Weapon
SUB_GUN.description: A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Nautilon Submarine. A high-energy weapon system, it superheats a small body of water before launching it rapidly towards the intended target. Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

SUB_LASER.name: Tethys Beam
SUB_LASER.subtitle: Submarine Mining Laser
SUB_LASER.description: A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Nautilon Submarine. Fires a concentrated plasma beam towards the intended target, which is then ignited. Such a trigger mechanism allows the use of high-energy optical mining systems in a liquid medium.

SUB_MINER.name: Dredging Laser
SUB_MINER.subtitle: Nautilon Terrain Manipulator
SUB_MINER.description: Adds Terrain Manipulation capability to the laser systems of the Nautilon Submarine. Cooled by specially designed water intakes, it is specifically calibrated to carve through the complex geology of the sea floor.

SUB_BINOCS.name: High-Power Sonar
SUB_BINOCS.subtitle: Submarine Analysis Device
SUB_BINOCS.description: A high-detail sonar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard a Nautilon-class submarine to Analysis Visor levels, pinning to the HUD all information typically revealed by the Analysis Visor. Press SCAN to activate the High-Power Sonar.

SUB_RECHARGE.name: Osmotic Generator
SUB_RECHARGE.subtitle: Humboldt Drive Upgrade
SUB_RECHARGE.description: Installed into the drive system aboard the Nautilon Submarine. Captures energy by exploiting the saline gradient in deep water environments, allowing a slow recharge of the Humboldt Drive in the event of fuel emergencies.

MECH_ENGINE.name: Daedalus Engine
MECH_ENGINE.subtitle: Minotaur Power Unit
MECH_ENGINE.description: A compact reactor unit, this engine is the heart of the Minotaur. It is mounted on a gyroscope to prevent fuel incidents during rapid movement. Powered by conventional carbon-base fuels.

MECH_FUEL.name: Self-Greasing Servos
MECH_FUEL.subtitle: Motor Efficiency Upgrade
MECH_FUEL.description: An automatically-regulated lubricant dispenser fitted to the leg joints of the Minotaur reduce friction and encourage fuel-efficient motion. Significantly reduces fuel burn in the Minotaur's Daedalus Engine.

MECH_SCAN.name: Minotaur Radar Array
MECH_SCAN.subtitle: Minotaur Scan Attachment
MECH_SCAN.description: A high-detail radar device, capable of upgrading the scanner technology aboard the Minotaur to Analysis Visor levels. Press SCAN to activate a radar sweep, revealing additional points of interest that cannot be located via a Multi-Tool scanner. Use the Quick Menu to tune the radar to specific buildings.

MECH_BOOST.name: Ariadne's Flame
MECH_BOOST.subtitle: Minotaur Thruster System
MECH_BOOST.description: A series of agile, high-powered jet thrusters mounted to the rear of the rear of the Minotaur. Precise use allows the Minotaur to quickly and powerfully traverse all manner of terrain. Press and hold JUMP to activate. Limited in-flight control is possible.

MECH_LASER.name: Minotaur Laser
MECH_LASER.subtitle: Minotaur Mining Utility
MECH_LASER.description: A mounted laser system specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid. Enables conventional mining operations. Ineffective in combat scenarios.

MECH_LASER1.name: Precision Minotaur Laser
MECH_LASER1.subtitle: Advanced Minotaur Mining Laser
MECH_LASER1.description: An upgrade for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid's laser array system. Amplifies the power deployed by the mining beam, increasing mining speed and enabling the processing of difficult to mine raw materials.

MECH_GUN.name: Minotaur Cannon
MECH_GUN.subtitle: Heavy Mounted Weapon
MECH_GUN.description: A mounted cannon specifically designed for the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid. Designed primarily for damage against biological entities and inefficient when deployed as a mining device.

MECH_MINER.name: Minotaur Bore
MECH_MINER.subtitle: Minotaur Digging Laser
MECH_MINER.description: Adds Terrain Manipulation capability to the laser array of the Minotaur Heavy Exosuit Hybrid. A special mount allows the rapid deployment of a high-energy terrain excavator, without risking clogging the Minotaur's delicate joints and servos with dirt.

MECH_PROT.name: Environment Control Unit
MECH_PROT.subtitle: Exocraft Hazard Protection Unit
MECH_PROT.description: This powerful environmental neutralising system is plugged directly into the pilot as they enter the cockpit. The system is powered via the Minotaur's main engine and requires no additional input. Some minor pain may be noticed around the insertion site. Renders the Minotaur pilot impervious to all environmental hazards.

MECH_PILOT.name: Minotaur AI Pilot
MECH_PILOT.subtitle: Autonomous Control Unit
MECH_PILOT.description: A semi-autonomous artificial pilot plugin for the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. Installation allows the Minotaur to traverse planets itself and engage in combat or mining activities to support its primary operator. The AI pilot will always cede control to the primary operator when they enter the cockpit. Piloting routines are highly localised. It is incapable of developing emotional bonds nor exercising independent control of the Minotaur.

MECH_SENT_L_ARM.description: A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. When installed alongside a Minotaur Laser, it transforms the mining laser into a powerful combat upgrade with the ability to deal heavy damaged to stunned entities.

MECH_SENT_R_ARM.name: Hardframe Right Arm
MECH_SENT_R_ARM.subtitle: Minotaur Limb Replacement
MECH_SENT_R_ARM.description: A collection of salvaged components from a Sentinel Hardframe, reconditioned to fit the Minotaur Heavy Exocraft Hybrid. Use CYCLEWEAPON to cycle available weapon modes.

MAINT_FARM1.name: Soil De-Wormer
MAINT_FARM1.subtitle: Autonomous Agriculture Unit
MAINT_FARM1.description: A control unit for a brigade of tiny robots. These are directed to burrow through the soil and eliminate yield-depleting pests. Control unit maintenance is crucial to prevent accidental robot swarms.

MAINT_FARM2.name: Auto Sprinkler
MAINT_FARM2.subtitle: Autonomous Agriculture Unit
MAINT_FARM2.description: An automatic sprinkler system that tunes itself to the needs of the plants, deploying water as a fine mist, a heavy downpour, or anything in-between.

MAINT_FARM3.name: Light Balancer
MAINT_FARM3.subtitle: Autonomous Agriculture Unit
MAINT_FARM3.description: A bank of LEDs controlled by a photosensitive processing unit, designed to carefully deliver exactly the mix of red, green or blue light that the plant requires.

MAINT_FARM4.name: Auto-Propagator
MAINT_FARM4.subtitle: Autonomous Agriculture Unit
MAINT_FARM4.description: This advanced bank of lasers prunes and propagates plants as required, the cauterising light offering unequaled precision.

MAINT_FARM5.name: Nutrient Distributor
MAINT_FARM5.subtitle: Autonomous Agriculture Unit
MAINT_FARM5.description: A hybrid fabricator/distributor that tests the soil for missing nutrients, so that it can create and spray the perfect fertiliser.

MAINT_FUEL1.name: Fuel Inverter
MAINT_FUEL1.subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
MAINT_FUEL1.description: A piece of rechargeable power technology. The fuel inverter ensures an even flow of power to autonomous machines.

MAINT_FUEL2.name: Membrane Battery
MAINT_FUEL2.subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
MAINT_FUEL2.description: The membrane battery is an almost maintenance-free piece of rechargeable power technology. Nestled among in the machine's circuits, it supplies power safely and directly.

MAINT_FUEL3.name: Power Condenser
MAINT_FUEL3.subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
MAINT_FUEL3.description: A piece of rechargeable power technology. The power condenser harvests any heat energy wasted during the machine's operation, and uses it to generate extra power.

MAINT_FUEL4.name: Generator Coupling
MAINT_FUEL4.subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
MAINT_FUEL4.description: The generator coupling is an important piece of the machine's rechargeable power systems. Without it, the generator would fruitlessly spin, pumping power out into the void.

MAINT_FUEL5.name: Kinetic Dynamo
MAINT_FUEL5.subtitle: Chargeable Power Unit
MAINT_FUEL5.description: The kinetic dynamo takes a small initial charge and uses it to run power-harvesting systems that tap into the orbit of the planet. This frees autonomous machinery from frequent fuel inspections, allowing them to endure extremely long maintenance cycles.

MAINT_TECH1.name: Locking mechanism
MAINT_TECH1.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH1.description: A simple locking device, designed to keep out unauthorised pilferers. Damage has locked it permanently.

MAINT_TECH2.name: Magnetic Lock
MAINT_TECH2.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH2.description: An advanced locking device. A polarity incident has caused it to seal shut permanently.

MAINT_TECH3.name: Superconductive Lock
MAINT_TECH3.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH3.description: A highly advanced locking device. Damage to the circuits supplying the magnet has caused it to lock permanently.

MAINT_TECH4.name: Input terminal
MAINT_TECH4.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH4.description: A terminal designed to allow manual control of the device. Damage prevents it actually receiving any input.

MAINT_TECH5.name: Bio-input sensor
MAINT_TECH5.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH5.description: An advanced control unit, designed to allow device/flesh interaction. Damage prevents it functioning correctly. Interfacing while it is in this state is not advised.

MAINT_TECH6.name: Boiler Unit
MAINT_TECH6.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH6.description: A small boiler, generating heat to allow the device to function in difficult climates. A malfunction has resulted in a damaging boiler overflow.

MAINT_TECH7.name: Tiny motor
MAINT_TECH7.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH7.description: A very small motor, designed to power very small parts. It has corroded, and is full of very small rust.

MAINT_TECH8.name: Cooling system
MAINT_TECH8.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH8.description: A pump and heat exchange system designed to keep the device from overheating. It has itself overheated, and is no longer functional.

MAINT_TECH9.name: Output screen
MAINT_TECH9.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH9.description: A display terminal designed to communicate the device's status to the user. As the terminal is broken, the user cannot be made aware that the terminal is broken.

MAINT_TECH10.name: Tamper Prevention Device
MAINT_TECH10.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH10.description: A unit designed to destroy vital systems in the event that the device is tampered with by an unauthorised party. Unfortunately, it has itself malfunctioned and will continue to damage other systems until repaired.

MAINT_TECH11.name: Security Alarm
MAINT_TECH11.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH11.description: A small light/klaxon hybrid, designed to warn of unauthorised access to the device. Damage to the alarm has caused it to overload and short other nearby circuits.

MAINT_TECH12.name: Spring Casing
MAINT_TECH12.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH12.description: The casing for a high-compression spring. The casing has ruptured, causing the spring to shoot out and damage the rest of the device.

MAINT_TECH13.name: Thermoregulator
MAINT_TECH13.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH13.description: A control unit designed to keep temperatures even across the device. The sensor unit is damaged, causing it to vent or generate heat at inappropriate times.

MAINT_TECH14.name: Fuel Pump
MAINT_TECH14.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH14.description: A high-capacity pump, ensuring that fuel reaches every part of the device in all gravitational conditions. The filter is clogged with a strange substance, causing it to lose power.

MAINT_TECH15.name: Servo Arm
MAINT_TECH15.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH15.description: A small mechanical joint, used to correct small mechanical errors across the device. A malfunction is causing it to take functional components and push them into the wrong place, creating even more damage.

MAINT_TECH16.name: Solenoid
MAINT_TECH16.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH16.description: A relay switch, intended to aid the powering up of the device. The connectors have become corroded, and the solenoid is no longer functioning.

MAINT_TECH17.name: Pressure Chamber
MAINT_TECH17.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH17.description: A small pressurised chamber, designed to create the compressed gas necessary for the device to function. Cracks have appeared in the chamber, causing it to leak.

MAINT_TECH18.name: Master Circuit
MAINT_TECH18.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH18.description: The control circuit for all the other components in the device. Damage to this circuitry is fatal.

MAINT_TECH19.name: Power Distributor
MAINT_TECH19.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH19.description: The central power unit for the device. Damage to the unit means it is currently distributing all the power to one particular circuit, causing a dangerous short.

MAINT_TECH20.name: Load Balancer
MAINT_TECH20.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH20.description: A small unit designed to regulate the flow of power across the device. A malfunction is causing it to short, damaging other components.

MAINT_TECH21.name: Network Interface
MAINT_TECH21.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH21.description: A universal network interface, allowing the device to connect to a remote control centre. Damage to this interface is causing it to interpret background radiation as network signals, corrupting data in other circuits.

MAINT_TECH22.name: Safety Panel
MAINT_TECH22.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH22.description: The safety panel seals off potentially dangerous components in the event of a malfunction. An over sensitive trigger has caused it to activate, preventing the device from operating.

MAINT_TECH23.name: Alternator
MAINT_TECH23.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH23.description: The alternator generates and regulates power for the device. A strange corrosion seeps through it, preventing it from working.

MAINT_TECH24.name: Photovoltaic Panel
MAINT_TECH24.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH24.description: A small but efficient panel, designed to harvest light and convert it to power. However, the panel is now cracked and dusty, and can no longer be relied on.

MAINT_TECH25.name: Transmission Box
MAINT_TECH25.subtitle: Damaged Component
MAINT_TECH25.description: The gearing mechanism for the device. The lubricant that keeps it operational appears to have been replaced with an otherworldly green goo, and the gears are now stuck.
